notes.title: The Crusades Update: The Last Pre-Launch Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/e2ba5e59c70deb382069f8cf5ad3d79ea6f94e2f.jpg[/img]
[h1]BIG NEW STUFF[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Level Cap increased to 50![/b]
[*] [b]Crossbows![/b]
[list]
[*] Added 1H and 2H Crossbows.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/f9b9278f5363f81ae4f18ebb1e7a6b809abe6bb6.png[/img]
[*] [b]New Talent Tree - Aetherion[/b]
[*] [b]Main Menu Lobby[/b]
[list]
[*] Invite your friends and assemble your party from the main menu.
[*] You can now text chat in the main menu while in a party lobby.
[*] Clicking the '+' button on player slots in the main menu lobby now correctly opens the Steam invite menu.
[/list]
[*] [b]New NPCs in Town[/b] (including Sister Remiel replacing Brother Orrian)
[*] [b]New Multiplayer Behavior:[/b]
[list]
[*] When set to Public, selecting a level from the World Map will attempt to matchmake with other public games on the same map.
[*] If no match is found, it hosts a public game that others can join.
[*] Private mode remains unchanged and still allows inviting others.
[/list]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/afda9acd046a92e8ac6b10f07ee37a8ab46c23e5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/dd7e7a1ce68939bb8391c2de5308607005812bd4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/3bacf7970af4967a537d5f21644263fe4c362349.png[/img]

[h1]NEW ENDGAME: CRUSADES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Crusades are the new primary endgame activity, replacing existing difficulty levels, Invasions, and the Raid tab. They offer progressively challenging content and scaling rewards.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/1ff97392109a2105b44f4762e0922525df0893b8.png[/img]

[h2]Unlocking Crusades[/h2]
[list]
[*] Available after completing the campaign via the Crusade Obelisk in town.
[/list]

[h2]Progression[/h2]
[list]
[*] Crusades consist of 11 Tiers.
[*] Higher Tiers increase enemy level, health, damage, and grant base Magic Find.
[*] New maps unlock with each Tier progression. Act Boss maps become available from Tiers 8-11.
[/list]

[h2]Crusadium Currency[/h2]
[list]
[*] A new currency used to run Crusade maps and apply modifiers.
[*] [b]Earning Crusadium:[/b] Defeat bosses level 30+, defeat Crusade map bosses, and complete minidungeons. Higher Tier bosses award exponentially more Crusadium. Minidungeon bosses grant 50% of the normal Crusadium reward.
[*] [b]Using Crusadium:[/b] Spent to select maps and add modifiers. Modifiers cannot be added if the cost exceeds available Crusadium needed to also start the map.
[/list]

[h2]Maps[/h2]
[list]
[*] Select a specific map or choose "Random".
[*] Selecting a random map grants +25% Crusadium Reward and randomizes the boss (or both bosses if the "Additional Boss" mod is active).
[*] Bosses are otherwise determined by the specific map selected.
[*] Completing a map unlocks it permanently for selection across all unlocked Tiers.
[*] Changing the selected map retains any chosen modifiers.
[*] Changing the selected Tier resets all modifiers.
[*] Starting a map locks the configuration. Abandoning the map resets the Obelisk interface.
[/list]

[h2]Modifiers[/h2]
[list]
[*] Add up to 4 Player Mods (penalties) and 4 Enemy Mods (increased difficulty) per map.
[*] Each Tier increase requires adding one additional modifier (Player or Enemy) compared to the previous Tier to unlock the next one.
[*] Mod costs and the base map cost double with each Tier increase.
[*] The severity/effect of modifiers increases with higher Tiers.
[*] Mods whose effects don't inherently scale (e.g., "Enemies are immune to Fire") instead grant increased Pack Size.
[/list]

[h2]Running Maps[/h2]
[list]
[*] Bosses encountered behind fog doors allow one attempt reset if the player fails.
[/list]

[h1]TALENTS[/h1]
[list]
[*] Talent trees are now capped at 30 points. Further points must go to another tree.
[/list]
[h2]New Talent Tree: Aetherion[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/b01c110e19bb2866a3d79cc79031ed3548b2a30a.jpg[/img]
[h3]Tier 1[/h3]
[list]
[*] Wellspring: Mana Regen increased by 10%.
[*] Quickened Incantation: Spells gain 10% increased Cast Speed. If dual-wielding Focuses, this bonus is doubled.
[*] Scholar: Max Mana increased by 10%
[*] Arcane Duplication: Projectiles have a 15% chance to gain Lesser Wildshot.
[/list]
[h3]Tier 2[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mana Frenzy: On Spell Hit: 15% chance to gain mana Frenzy, increasing Mana Regen by 50% for 3 seconds.
[*] Arcane Momentum: Casting a Spell grants 1 stack of Momentum Charge. At 3 stacks, gain Arcane Momentum. Arcane Momentum grants 100% increased Cooldown Speed, 50% Attack and Cast Speed, and 50% Charge Speed for 4 seconds.
[*] Spell Sniper: Projectile Spells gain 20% increased damage, 35% increased range, and 50% increased speed.
[*] Aetherflow: Damaging skills consume 20% less Mana. 50% chance on Hit to inflict Arcane Resonance. Total Damage reduced by 20%.
[/list]
[h3]Super - Aetherion’s Barrage[/h3]
[list]
[*] For 10 seconds, Mana Regeneration, Cooldown Reduction, and Ability Charge Speed increased by 25%. Cooldown Reduction cap increased to 75%. Your Dodge Roll becomes a Blink.
[/list]

[h2]Kirkira Tree Rework[/h2]
[h3]Tier 1[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mystic Impact: Spells deal 15% more Resilience Damage.
[*] Cataclysmic Casting: Area Effects from damaging skills that cost Mana are 15% larger.
[*] The Severance: Gain Mana equal to your Stamina. Lose half of Stamina.
[*] Potent Mana: Spells gain additional base damage equal to 5% of your Maximum Mana.
[/list]
[h3]Tier 2[/h3]
[list]
[*] Annihilation: Area Effects are 35% larger and deal 20% more damage. Area bonus increased to 50% while wielding a Staff.
[*] Ultimate Arcanum: Damaging skills that cost Mana consume 20% more Mana and deal 40% more damage.
[*] Concentrated Spell: Area effects from damaging skills that cost Mana are 25% smaller and deal 40% more damage. Damage bonus increased to 50% while wielding a Staff.
[*] Familiar: Gain a familiar that floats around you and echoes your Spell Projectile casts at 30% damage. 1 second cooldown between spell casts.
[/list]
[h3]New Super - Singularity[/h3]
[list]
[*] Create a singularity that pulls in enemies and deals 100% spell damage per second for 6 seconds.
[/list]

[h2]Talent Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]VERNDARI[/h3]
[list]
[*] Hunter’s Mark: Damage per stack: 3% → 4%.
[*] Aspect of the Wolf: 20% → 40% chance for your Hits to Hit an additional time for 100% -> 30% of the damage.
[*] Aspect of the Razorcat: 20 → 25% chance on hit to Bleed the target for 100% of the damage inflicted and gain 1 stack of Feral Momentum.
[*] Verndari CDR Passive: 1% → 1.5% per point.
[/list]
[h3]EHTIRAS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Spellblade: 15% of damage you deal with Spells is stored in your melee weapon. Melee attacks deal double damage until stored damage is expended. While wielding a focus, 50% of damage you deal with spells is stored. [i]Dev note: This is unchanged for Focus + 1H Melee loadouts, but now works with 2H melee weapons if you also grab Innate Magic for the ability to cast Spells (at the 15% rate).[/i]
[*] Godcaller: On Hit: 30% chance to summon a lightning bolt that deals an additional 50 → 70% damage. (Previously reduced 100%->70%, now buffed)
[*] Arcane Resilience is now Arcane Barrier - Deals up to 50% Combined Weapon Damage as Spell Damage around you when destroyed.
[*] Focus implicit/explicit mods related to Ehtiras now grant Spell Damage (clarification or change from previous 'Focus Damage').
[/list]
[h3]CERRIDWEN[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mutual Mending: Added: While you are at Full Health, your Health Flasks heal your Pact Minion for an additional 50%.
[*] Master’s Aura: Gain an aura that causes nearby minions to deal 25% → 30% more damage and take 15% → 20% less damage.
[/list]
[h3]SENDATU[/h3]
[list]
[*] Talented Healer: Using your Health Flask also heals all nearby allies for 20% → 25% of their Maximum Health.
[*] Sendatu Magic Find Passive replaced with Wisdom (Boon Intensity + Mana).
[/list]
[h3]ASTAROTH[/h3]
[list]
[*] Unified Front:
[list]
[*] Your Melee Hits inflict a mark on the target which detonates when Hit by your Pact Forgeborne, increasing the Hit's damage by 30% → 35%.
[*] Your Pact Forgeborne's Hits also mark targets, which your Melee Hits can detonate to increase their damage by 30% → 35%.
[/list]
[/list]
[h3]VALKYRION[/h3]
[list]
[*] Pressure Points: While Unarmed, physical attacks deal additional Resilience Damage equal to 5% → 10% of your Critical Strike Chance. Maximum 10 additional Resilience Damage.
[/list]
[h3]ZABAOTH[/h3]
[list]
[*] Unyielding
[list]
[*] Old: Gain 5% Damage Resistance for each 100 Health you are missing, up to 40%.
[*] New: Gain 1% Damage Resistance for each 50 Health you are missing, up to 30%.
[/list]
[/list]
[h3]ORIAS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Heavy Shielding: Block bonus reduced 15% → 10%. Attack Speed penalty removed. Now adds a 10% movement speed penalty while blocking (stacks with the base 20% penalty from blocking with a shield).
[*] Reinforcement Talent (Orias tree): Resilience Damage reduction from Blocked Hits reduced 50% → 30%.
[/list]


[h1]SKILLS[/h1]

[h2]General Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Max 5 ultimates with the new level cap.
[*] Some skill requirements now read "Requires a martial weapon equipped," martial weapons include swords, axes, maces, bows, and crossbows.
[*] Changed unarmed heavy attack to a single strike.
[/list]

[h2]Reworks and Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]Charged Effect[/h3]
[list]
[*] When stacks of Charged are consumed, targets are now inflicted with [b]Electrified[/b], causing all incoming Hits to have +30% Critical Strike Chance for 4 seconds.
[*] The damage dealt by the lightning bolt when consuming Charged has been reduced by 50%.
[*] Consuming Charged no longer counts as a Hit.
[/list]
[h3]Freeze Mechanics[/h3]
[list]
[*] When a target becomes Frozen, instead of becoming immune to further Freezes, their threshold to become Frozen increases by 50%. This allows Freeze to continue being relevant in long encounters without trivializing combat.
[*] Stacking Chills now contribute to Freeze with the final value of the Chill after stacking instead of the initial stacking value.
[*] Example: With a 5% stacking Chill that caps at 25%, OLD: 5% + 5% + 5% + 5%, etc., would require 20 hits to Freeze. NEW: 5% + 10% + 15% + 20% + 25% + 25% = Freeze, total of 6 hits.
[/list]
[h3]Poison Rework[/h3]
[list]
[*] Each stack of Poison deals 25% Combined Weapon Damage over 5 seconds and has an independent duration from other stacks. No stack limit.
[/list]
[h3]New Effect: Wicked Resonance[/h3]
[list]
[*] At 3 stacks of Wicked Resonance, consume all stacks to inflict a random Curse on the target for 6 seconds. Avoids Curses already active on the target. Targets that die with at least 1 stack of Wicked Resonance apply a random Curse to a nearby target or Desecrated Ground.
[/list]

[h2]New Crossbow Skills[/h2]
[h3]Adaptive Configuration[/h3]
(This skill is available while wielding a 2H Crossbow or dual-wielding 1H Crossbows)
[list]
[*] Cycle between three distinct crossbow firing configurations. Switching configurations is instant and does not cost resources.
[*] [b]Arbalest Configuration:[/b] Fires bolts that pierce through enemies, dealing 100% combined weapon damage to all enemies hit.
[*] [b]Blast Configuration:[/b] Blast enemies in a cone in front of you. Enemies closer to you take more damage, up to 100% combined weapon damage.
[*] [b]Gatling Configuration:[/b] Rapidly fires bolts that deal 70% combined weapon damage.
[/list]
[h3]Explosive Bolt[/h3]
[list]
[*] Stamina Cost: 150
[*] Mana Cost: 0 → 25
[*] Cooldown: 6s → 8 seconds
[*] Fires an explosive bolt that deals 125% combined weapon damage and knocks back Allies and Normal and Elite enemies.
[/list]
[h3]Clip Skills[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]General Mechanic:[/b]
[list]
[*] Clip skills load a clip of magical bolts into your Crossbow. Clips have various effects which are applied to targets hit by your Crossbow in any Configuration and increase base Bolt damage by 150% spread out over the number of bolts in the clip (clips with more bolts have a lower bonus damage per bolt). Clip skills all have the same Stamina Cost and Cooldown, and Mana cost equal to (112.5 + 12.5 per bolt). Only one Clip can be active at a time, adding a new clip will overwrite an existing one. While dual-wielding 1H Crossbows, the number of bolts granted by a clip is increased by 25%.
[*] Mana Cost: 112.5 + 12.5 per bolt, Stamina Cost: 75, Cooldown: 3 seconds.
[/list]
[*] [b]Clip Options:[/b]
[list]
[*] Inferno Clip: Load a clip of 3 bolts imbued with fire and inflict Burn on impact, dealing 25% combined weapon damage per second for 3 seconds. Burn stacks up to 75% combined weapon damage per second.
[*] Frostbite Clip: Load a clip of 6 bolts imbued with ice and inflict 20% Chill on impact.
[*] Charged Clip: Load a clip of 6 bolts imbued with lightning and inflict Charged on impact.
[*] Poison Clip: Load a clip of 5 bolts imbued with 2 stacks of Poison.
[*] Cursed Clip: Load a clip of 3 bolts imbued with Wicked Resonance. Bolts inflict 1 stack of Wicked Resonance for 4 seconds.
[*] Desecrating Clip: Load a single bolt imbued with Desecrated Ground.
[*] Chaos Clip: Load a clip of 7 bolts imbued with Chaos, each bolt gains the effects of a random clip.
[*] Arcane Clip: Load a clip of 3 bolts imbued with Arcane Resonance. (Arcane Clip’s Mana Cost is increased by 50%).
[/list]
[/list]

[h2]New Skills[/h2]
[h3]Verndari's Apex (Super)[/h3]
[list]
[*] For 8 seconds, gain 50% Mana Efficiency, Stamina Efficiency, and Cooldown Speed. All hits inflict Hunter’s Mark.
[/list]
[h3]Electrifying Arrow[/h3]
[list]
[*] Projectile, Area Effect, Charge-Up
[*] Max Mana Cost: 100
[*] Max Stamina Cost: 100
[*] Cooldown: 5 seconds
[*] Charge up to increase radius and damage, up to 185% weapon damage. Inflicts Electrified for 4 seconds. Charge rate is affected by attack speed. Mana and Stamina Regeneration halted while channeling.
[/list]
[h3]Storm Spear[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Icon
[*] Spell, Projectile, Area Effect
[*] Mana Cost: 60 → 100
[*] Cooldown: 2 → 4 seconds
[*] Cast a bolt of lightning that creates a small storm on impact for 4 seconds. The storm deals 65% → 50% spell damage and 1 stack of Charged per second. (Damage corrected; tooltip previously read 65% but dealt 45%).
[/list]

[h2]Updated Skills[/h2]
[h3]Firebolt[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mana Cost: 70 → 80
[/list]
[h3]Lightning Nova[/h3]
[list]
[*] Damage: 75% → 60%.
[*] Now inflicts Electrified for 4 seconds.
[/list]
[h3]Lightning Aura[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now inflicts 1 stack of Charged.
[/list]
[h3]Lightning Orb[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now inflicts 1 stack of Charged with each damage tick.
[/list]
[h3]Storm Cyclone[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now inflicts 1 stack of Charged each second.
[/list]
[h3]Voltaic Thrust[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now inflicts Electrified for 4 seconds on melee targets.
[/list]
[h3]Thunder Step[/h3]
[list]
[*] Damage: 170% → 150%.
[*] Now inflicts Electrified for 4 seconds.
[/list]
[h3]Call Lightning[/h3]
[list]
[*] Damage: 200% → 150%.
[*] Now inflicts Electrified for 4 seconds.
[/list]
[h3]Thunderstrike Stance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Initial hit now inflicts Electrified.
[*] Melee hits while in stance inflict 1 stack of Charged.
[/list]
[h3]Stormbound Titan[/h3]
[list]
[*] Nova now inflicts 1 stack of Charged on all targets affected.
[*] [i]Dev note: Charged stacks will only be consumed to deal damage and inflict Electrified when applied by the player. Stormbound Titan cannot inflict Electrified on its own.[/i]
[/list]
[h3]Super: Blackflame Assassin Rework[/h3]
[list]
[*] Old: Blackflame lasts for 5 seconds and deals 20% Combined Weapon Damage per second per stack, stacks up to 20 times.
[*] New: Each stack of Blackflame deals 50% Combined Weapon Damage over 5 seconds and has an independent duration. No stack limit.
[/list]
[h3]Flame Aura[/h3]
[list]
[*] Burn per second increased 15% → 25%
[/list]
[h3]Shatter[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now works on Frozen enemies.
[/list]
[h3]Death Aura[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now consumes 5% → 10% Health per second
[*] Now grants 20 Shadow Offering per second
[*] Added the Shadow tag.
[/list]
[h3]Divine Legion[/h3]
[list]
[*] Health stat removed.
[*] Base Damage: 50 → 40
[*] Duration: 10s → 5s
[/list]
[h3]Wrath of Ehtiras[/h3]
[list]
[*] No longer Hits.
[/list]
[h3]Flurry / Flurry of Blows[/h3]
[list]
[*] Flurry of Blows now overrides Flurry.
[*] Damage per hit reduced 50% → 40%.
[*] Stamina Cost increased 100 → 125.
[/list]
[h3]Bladecrest[/h3]
[list]
[*] No longer Hits or deals Resilience Damage.
[*] Now takes a small moment to prime for damage.
[*] Damage 30% → 25%.
[/list]
[h3]Siphon Strike[/h3]
[list]
[*] Damage 235% → 225%.
[/list]
[h3]Leap Smash[/h3]
[list]
[*] Cooldown now correctly starts after landing.
[/list]

[h2]Poison Skills Rebalance[/h2]
[h3]Poison Nova Arrow[/h3]
[list]
[*] Cooldown: 3 → 2
[*] Mana Cost: 100 → 125
[*] Stacks: 2 → 8
[/list]
[h3]Poison Nova[/h3]
[list]
[*] Initial Damage: 30% → 50%
[*] Stacks: 2 → 10
[*] Cooldown: 4 → 2
[/list]
[h3]Poison Dagger[/h3]
[list]
[*] Initial Damage: 30% → 10%
[*] Stacks: 3 → 10
[/list]
[h3]Poison Trap[/h3]
[list]
[*] Activation Stacks: 4 → 10
[/list]
[h3]Viperfang Stance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Initial Stacks: 3 → 6
[*] Stacks on Melee Hit: 1 → 3
[/list]
[h3]Envenom[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mana Cost: 150 → 125
[*] Cooldown: 12 → 6
[*] Stacks: 1 → 2
[/list]
[h3]Miasma[/h3]
[list]
[*] Stacks per Second: 1 → 5
[/list]
[h3]Sporebolt[/h3]
[list]
[*] Initial Stacks: 1 → 3
[*] Stacks per Second: 1 → 3
[/list]
[h3]Toxic Aura[/h3]
[list]
[*] Stacks per Second: 2 → 5
[/list]
[h3]Venombolt[/h3]
[list]
[*] Initial Damage: 50% → 25%
[*] Stacks: 1 → 15
[/list]
[h3]Toxic Rain[/h3]
[list]
[*] Stacks per Second: 2 → 8
[*] Mana Cost: 200 → 125
[*] Stamina Cost: 150 → 125
[*] Cooldown: 10 → 3
[/list]
[h3]Outbreak[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mana Cost: 200 → 175
[*] Radius: 325 → 350
[/list]
[h3]Festering Plague[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mana Cost: 200 → 125
[*] Poisons deal 20% → 50% more damage for 5 → 4 seconds
[/list]

[h2]Curse/Shadow Skills Rebalance[/h2]
[list]
[*] Desecrated Ground now resets duration after each added Curse.
[/list]
[h3]Abyssal Path[/h3]
[list]
[*] Damage increased 100% → 150% Spell Damage, increased area to match visuals, fixed Desecrated Ground not spreading curses.
[/list]
[h3]Blight Arrow[/h3]
[list]
[*] Shadow Offering per second 5 → 15.
[/list]
[h3]Netherscythe[/h3]
[list]
[*] Melee hits now inflict 1 stack of Wicked Resonance per scythe.
[/list]
[h3]Hex[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mana Cost 110 → 60, Damage 70% → 150% Spell Damage.
[/list]
[h3]Necrosis[/h3]
[list]
[*] Damage per second 50% → 65%, Shadow Offering per second 10 → 20, Duration 10 → 6 sec.
[/list]
[h3]Shadow Tether Rework[/h3]
[list]
[*] No longer Hits.
[*] Damage increased 100% → 135% per second.
[*] Doubled tick rate for smoother application.
[*] Now has the Spell tag.
[*] Now requires a Staff or Focus.
[*] Updated description to clarify it consumes 50 Shadow Offering per second (no functional changes to cost).
[/list]
[h3]Shadowbolt[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mana Cost 25 → 30, Damage 50% → 60%, Shadow Offering on cast 10 → 20.
[/list]
[h3]Void Rain[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mana Cost 150 → 100.
[/list]
[h3]Batswarm[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mana Cost 40 → 35
[*] Shadow Offering Cost 0 → 20.
[*] Now inflicts Wicked Resonance
[/list]
[h3]Dissolution (Legendary)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduces base duration of Necrosis 25% → 15%.
[/list]
[h3]Netherblood Nova[/h3]
[list]
[*] Shadow Offering Cost 75 → 150, Mana Cost 150 → 175, now inflicts a random Curse on hit.
[/list]

[h1]WEAPONS[/h1]
[h2]Ranged Weapon Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Bows and Crossbows now have damage falloff starting at 3000 units.
[list]
[*] Damage scales down linearly to 1% of the original damage at 6000 units or beyond.
[*] [i]Dev note: For reference, most spells have a range of 1500. This is mostly to prevent sniping the Temple of Fire boss effectively from the arena entrance. 3000 units is roughly the distance from where you spawn in Town to the nearest Training Dummy.[/i]
[/list]
[*] Headshot damage for bows and crossbows reduced from +100% to +50%.
[/list]
[h2]Shield Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Blocking with a Shield now decreases move speed by 20%.
[/list]

[h1]ITEMS[/h1]
[h2]New Crafting Item: Echo Shards[/h2]
[list]
[*] Empty Echo Shards can now drop from bosses (drop rate significantly reduced/rarity increased).
[*] Echo Shard: Destroys an item with 4 explicit mods and randomly preserves one of the mods in a filled Echo Shard, which can apply the mod randomly to another item.
[*] Filled Echo Shards randomly overwrite an explicit mod on an item with the stored mod. If the level of the stored mod is higher than the level of the equipment it is applied to, the level of the mod will be reduced to match.
[*] Only mods retrieved from 2H weapons can be applied to other 2H weapons (Only 2H Echo Shards can be used on 2H Weapons).
[*] Echo Shards can now be used directly on equipped items.
[/list]

[h2]General Item Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Equipment and Runestones now roll at the level of either your character or the enemy, whichever is lower.
[*] [b]Sanctified Weapon implicit/mod:[/b] Resilience damage bonus reduced 50% → 25%.
[/list]

[h2]Unique Item Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]Thunderlord's Crown[/h3]
[list]
[*] Gain the effects of Godcaller at 50% damage. Godcaller hits 1 additional nearby enemy.
[/list]
[h3]Stormblade[/h3]
[list]
[*] Gain the effects of Godcaller at 50% damage.
[/list]
[h3]Aetherblast Arc[/h3]
[list]
[*] Proc chance on Crit increased from 15% to 20%.
[/list]
[h3]Bilerazor[/h3]
[list]
[*] Poison Stacks: 2/4 → 5/10
[/list]
[h3]Venomwood[/h3]
[list]
[*] All normal arrows inflict 1 Poison Stack.
[*] Fully charged arrows create a poison nova that inflicts 2 Poison Stacks.
[/list]
[h3]Ushiwakamaru[/h3]
[list]
[*] Melee attacks inflict 2 Poison Stacks.
[/list]
[h3]Vessel of the Caustic Fang[/h3]
[list]
[*] Poison Stacks: 1 → 2
[/list]
[h3]Plaguebringer[/h3]
[list]
[*] Targets that die with at least 5 Poison Stacks inflicted by you spread 1/3 → half of their Poison Stacks to nearby targets.
[/list]
[h3]Vicious Drakeblade[/h3]
[list]
[*] Vicious Spin inflicts 2 → 5 Poison Stacks.
[/list]
[h3]Light Gatherers[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now triggers on non-critical hits instead of on-crit. Grants 1% Super Charge per hit.
[/list]
[h3]The Bloodwaltz[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now triggers its effect on non-critical hits instead of critical hits.
[/list]

[h1]LOOT[/h1]
[h2]Gamble Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Magic Find now scales Gamba drops.
[*] [b]Legendary Gamble Option:[/b] Added a super high gold cost gamble option that only produces legendaries.
[/list]
[h2]Other Loot Changes[/h2]
[list]

[h2]Critical Strike Chance & Damage[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Critical Strike Chance Mod Scaling:[/b]
[list]

[*] NEW: 3% + 0.1% per level
[/list]
[*] [b]Critical Strike Damage Mod Scaling:[/b]
[list]
[*] OLD: 0.5% per level
[*] NEW: 3% + 0.1% per level
[*] At level 30, these mods now provide 6%, down from 15%.
[/list]
[*] Critical Strike Chance and Damage bonuses on the talent tree now provide 2.5% → 3.5% per point.
[*] Critical Strikes now deal 10% → 20% increased Resilience Damage per Critical Stage.
[list]
[*] [i]Dev note: Rebalancing Crit so it no longer eclipses other builds in both raw DPS and utility. Crit Chance now requires heavier investment to exceed 100%. Crit builds remain strong for on-crit effects and stuns, but other builds can stay competitive in overall damage. Hoping this fosters more diverse and meaningful build choices. This also provides some design room to make on-crit effects more powerful.[/i]
[/list]
[/list]

[list]

[h1]INFLUENCE[/h1]
[h2]General Influence Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] All influence mods are now 30% more likely to roll than non-influence mods.
[list]
[*] [i]Dev note: Due to an oversight, influence mods that were already able to roll on an item (for example, resistance mods) were twice as likely (100% higher) to roll as any other mod, while influence mods that were newly added to the pool (1H Melee Damage, etc.) had the same likelihood to roll as normal mods. This change sets the likelihood of all influence mods to be 30% higher than base mods. This is a nerf to some influences and a buff to others, and makes the overall system significantly more consistent with probabilities.[/i]
[/list]
[*] Breaking Influenced items now has a 30% chance if it would grant an item to grant a Sphere of Influence.
[*] Reduced the chance for Spheres of Influence to drop from bosses by 50%.

tags.feature: Clip Skills

Clip skills load a clip of magical bolts into your Crossbow. Clips have various effects which are applied to targets hit by your Crossbow in any Configuration and increase base Bolt damage by 150% spread out over the number of bolts in the clip (clips with more bolts have a lower bonus damage per bolt). Clip skills all have the same Stamina Cost and Cooldown, and Mana cost equal to (112.5 + 12.5 per bolt). Only one Clip can be active at a time, adding a new clip will overwrite an existing one. While dual-wielding 1H Crossbows, the number of bolts granted by a clip is increased by 25%.
Inferno Clip: Load a clip of 3 bolts imbued with fire and inflict Burn on impact, dealing 25% combined weapon damage per second for 3 seconds. Burn stacks up to 75% combined weapon damage per second.
Frostbite Clip: Load a clip of 6 bolts imbued with ice and inflict 20% Chill on impact.
Charged Clip: Load a clip of 6 bolts imbued with lightning and inflict Charged on impact.
Poison Clip: Load a clip of 5 bolts imbued with 2 stacks of Poison.
Cursed Clip: Load a clip of 3 bolts imbued with Wicked Resonance. Bolts inflict 1 stack of Wicked Resonance for 4 seconds.
Desecrating Clip: Load a single bolt imbued with Desecrated Ground.
Chaos Clip: Load a clip of 7 bolts imbued with Chaos, each bolt gains the effects of a random clip.
Arcane Clip: Load a clip of 3 bolts imbued with Arcane Resonance. (Arcane Clip’s Mana Cost is increased by 50%).
New Skills
Verndari's Apex (Super)
For 8 seconds, gain 50% Mana Efficiency, Stamina Efficiency, and Cooldown Speed. All hits inflict Hunter’s Mark.
Electrifying Arrow
Storm Spear

notes.title: The Divine Update: Ascend Your Arsenal
notes.content:
Fellow Knights,

As we stand on the threshold of a new era, I am thrilled to present to you "The Divine Update," a testament to our unyielding pursuit of greatness. This update ushers in a realm of new gameplay enhancements, new skills blessed by the divine, and a treasure trove of crafting items to forge our destiny. We've refined our combat with the addition of lock-on for precision strikes and a crafting inventory which will allow us to fill our bags with even more spoils of war.

Embark on this journey with the divine as your guide. Harness the power of Divine Fury, explore the depths of our enhanced abilities, and stand united as we face the challenges ahead. May your blades strike true and your resolve be unbreakable.

Adventure awaits, fellow knights. To battle, to glory, and beyond.

Yours in valor,
Aeromir

(Also here's a [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/e/2PACX-1vSQonffWp4DGaS4YTYJwaoSGSczNRWSHfezANEtJXKLcSEbcelmCLvsUYhhIovu-J-SS65-d_ouqkrW/pub]Google Doc of these notes[/url] for more convenient reading ːsteamthumbsupː)

[h1]NEW[/h1]
[h2]4 New Crafting Items[/h2]
[b]Weapon Sigil[/b] - Increases the quality of a weapon by 1%, increasing its base damage by the same amount. Max 10% quality.
[b]Armor Sigil[/b] - Increases the quality of armor by 1%, increasing implicit mod levels by 1. Max 10% quality.
[b]Favored Weapon Sigil[/b] - Increases the quality of a weapon by 1%, increasing its base damage by the same amount. Max 20% quality.
[b]Favored Armor Sigil[/b] - Increases the quality of armor by 1%, increasing implicit mod levels by 1. Max 20% quality.

[h2]Lock-On[/h2]
Players can now lock-on to enemies. (Default: Mouse Thumb Button/Right Thumbstick Button)

[h2]Out of Combat Regeneration[/h2]
Players and Companions now regenerate resources and cooldowns quickly while out of combat. No more need to stop and Meditate.

[h2]Crafting Inventory[/h2]
A new special inventory has been added next to the normal inventory. This inventory can house any number of crafting items and features an Auto Transfer button to quickly move all crafting items from your normal inventory into the crafting inventory. This new inventory is account-wide and accessible by all characters. Crafting items can be transferred between each inventory by shift-clicking. A new binding has been added to the Input menu to transfer all items at a key press (default: Comma).

[h2]Action Bar Menu[/h2]
You can now quickly set the skill in an action bar slot by right clicking the slot and selecting any of your available skills from the new menu.

[h2]Inspect[/h2]
You can now inspect your allies' gear by right-clicking their party portrait and selecting the new Inspect option.

[h2]Universal Penance[/h2]
Companions now use your Penance count

[h2]Graphics API Options[/h2]
You can now swap between DX11, DX12, and Vulkan from the Video Settings menu (requires restart).

[h3]Misc.[/h3]
New binding for Sort Inventory (Default: S)
New binding for Break Mode (Default: B)
New FPS Cap options (90, 180)
New statline for Base Damage on stat readout

[h1]CHANGED[/h1]
Red Loot Crystals now drop Weapon Sigils and Armor Sigils
Favored Sigils have a chance to drop from any Boss
Penance can now drop from any Boss

[h1]SKILLS[/h1]
[h2]NEW SKILLS[/h2]
[b]Divine Strike[/b]
Skill Tags: Melee, Strike, Divine
Requires a Sword, Axe, or Mace equipped
Usable While Unarmed
Strike all enemies in range for 150% melee weapon damage. Generates 1 Divine Fury.
Mana Cost: 40
Stamina Cost: 40
Cooldown: 2 seconds

[b]Righteous Flamespear[/b]
Skill Tags: Spell, Area Effect, Divine
Summon a righteous spear at the target location that deals 185% Combined Weapon Damage to nearby targets and Ignites them for 25% of the damage dealt. Generates 1 Divine Fury.
Mana Cost: 125
Cooldown: 4 seconds

[b]Hammer of Conviction[/b]
Skill Tags: Projectile, Divine
Requires a Sword, Axe, or Mace equipped
Usable While Unarmed
Throw a divine hammer that inflicts 250% Combined Weapon Damage and Heavy Resilience Damage. Generates 1 Divine Fury on hit.
Mana Cost: 80
Cooldown: 6 seconds
Range: 1,500

[b]Judgment Strike[/b]
Skill Tags: Melee, Strike, Boon, Aura, Divine
Requires a Sword, Axe, or Mace equipped
Strikes all enemies in range for 300% melee weapon damage and adds Heavenly Strength to your Divine Aura for 6 seconds, increasing Total Damage by 15%.
Mana Cost: 50
Stamina Cost: 50
Divine Fury Cost: 3
Cooldown: 1 seconds

[b]Sanctuary[/b]
Skill Tags: Boon, Aura, Divine
Adds Sanctuary to your Divine Aura for 6 seconds, increasing Physical and Corruption Resistance by 15%.
Mana Cost: 100
Divine Fury Cost: 3
Cooldown: 1 seconds

[b]Holy Storm[/b]
Skill Tags: Melee, Area Effect, Divine
Requires a Sword, Axe, or Mace equipped
Usable While Unarmed
Spin and burst with divine energy to deal 250% weapon damage to all enemies around you in a large area.
Mana Cost: 60
Stamina Cost: 60
Divine Fury Cost: 3
Cooldown: 1 seconds

[b]Smite[/b]
Skill Tags: Projectile, Spell, Area Effect, Charge-Up
Requires a Staff or Focus equipped
Call down a divine projectile which blasts nearby enemies for 125% spell damage. Generates 1 Divine Fury if you hit at least 1 target. Charge up to reduce the delay of the projectile.
Mana Cost: 50
Cooldown: 0.8 seconds
Range: 2,000

[b]Radiant Arsenal[/b]
Skill Tags: Spell, Projectile, Divine
Requires a Focus or Staff equipped
Summon 4 radiant armaments. Recast to fire a radiant armament at the closest available target in range. Armaments deal 100% Spell Damage on impact.
Mana Cost: 100
Divine Fury Cost: 3
Cooldown: 1 seconds

[b]Holy Arrow[/b]
Skill Tags: Projectile, Area Effect, Charge-Up, Divine
Requires a Bow equipped
Charge up and fire an arrow that bursts with divine energy on impact. Charge increases explosion radius and damage, up to 100% weapon damage. Generates 1 Divine Fury if you hit at least 1 target. Charge rate is affected by attack speed.
Max Mana Cost: 100
Max Stamina Cost: 50
Cooldown: 1.5 seconds

[b]Summon Divine Legion[/b]
Skill Tags: Minion, Summon, Divine
Requires a Staff or Focus equipped
Summon a member of the Divine Legion to fight for you. Divine Legionnaires have a 30% chance on hit to generate 1 stack of Divine Fury for you. If you have Divine Fury when you cast this skill, all stacks of Divine Fury will be consumed to summon 1 additional Legionnaire per stack. Legionnaires are ethereal, they cannot be targeted and do not physically block foes.Hold Skill Modifier (default: Left Alt) while casting to dismiss.
Mana Cost: 150
Cooldown: 5 seconds

[b]Celestial Volley[/b]
Skill Tags: Projectile, Area Effect, Divine
Requires a Bow equipped
Fire a marking arrow that calls down a hail of divine arrows where it impacts, dealing 40% weapon damage per second to all enemies in the area and inflicting Searing Brand for 6 seconds, causing Hits on the target from any source to sear them, dealing 10% of your weapon damage. If you have Divine Fury when you cast, all stacks will be consumed to increase volley area by 33% and Divine Brand damage by 10% additional weapon damage per stack consumed. Lasts for 3 seconds.
Mana Cost: 60
Stamina Cost: 60
Cooldown: 4 seconds

[b]Divine Quiver[/b]
Skill Tags: Divine
Requires a Bow equipped
For 8 seconds, all arrows inflict 1 stack of Piercing Brand. When applied, Piercing Brand inflicts 10% weapon damage per stack. Max 10 stacks.
Divine Fury Cost: 3
Cooldown: 6 seconds

[b]Shield of Faith[/b]
Skill Tags: Divine
Imbue yourself or an ally with a shield, granting them 50% damage reduction for 4 seconds. Upon expiring, the shield explodes, inflicting 200% combined weapon damage to nearby enemies. Hold to target allies.
Divine Fury Cost: 3
Cooldown: 10 seconds

[b]Divine Lance[/b]
Skill Tags: Spell, Projectile, Area Effect, Channeling, Charge-Up, Divine
Requires a Staff equipped
Cast a radiant lance that pierces through enemies in a straight line, dealing up to 125% Spell Damage and marking enemies with a Radiant Brand. If an enemy is already marked with Radiant Brand, Divine Lance instead consumes the brand to generate 1 Divine Fury.
Initial Mana Cost: 50
Max Charge Mana Cost:50
Range: 2,000

[b]Lightbringer's Angelic Sealing Exalted Ray[/b]
Skill Tags: Spell, Area Effect, Divine
Requires a Staff equipped
Unleash the heavens' wrath with a celestial beam of divine retribution, dealing 215% Spell Damage, heavy Resilience Damage, and inflicting all targets with Exalted Seal. Exalted Seal causes the next hit on the target from any source to deal 50% Spell Damage and break the seal.
Mana Cost: 150
Divine Fury Cost: 3
Cooldown: 4 seconds

[b]Divine Intervention[/b]
Skill Tags: Divine
Instantly revive a fallen ally and restore them to full health. Usable once per combat.
Divine Fury Cost: 3
Cooldown: 5 seconds

[b]Radiant Aegis[/b]
Skill Tags: Divine
Requires a Shield equipped
Your next 3 blocks or parries within 6 seconds block an additional 10% damage and generate 1 Divine Fury. Max 6 stacks.
Mana Cost: 125
Cooldown: 5 seconds

[b]Radiant Stance[/b]
Skill Tags: Melee, Stance, Divine
Usable While Unarmed
Deliver a series of 4 rapid blows. Enter Radiant Stance for 5 seconds, causing your melee hits to mark enemies with a Radiant Brand. If an enemy is already marked with Radiant Brand, hits instead consume the brand to generate 1 Divine Fury. Only one Stance can be active at a time.
Mana Cost: 100
Stamina Cost: 100
Cooldown: 6 seconds

[b]Exalted Fist[/b]
Skill Tags: Melee, Strike, Boon, Aura, Divine
Usable While Unarmed
Strikes all enemies in range for 280% unarmed damage and adds Divine Alacrity to your Divine Aura for 6 seconds, increasing Cooldown Recovery Speed by 15%.
Mana Cost: 40
Stamina Cost: 40
Divine Fury Cost: 3
Cooldown: 1 seconds

[b]Divine Immolation[/b]
Skill Tags: Boon, Aura, Divine
Adds Divine Immolation to your Divine Aura for 6 seconds, causing you to deal damage around yourself and allies equal to 20% combined weapon damage per second. Generates 500% threat. Damage scales with Boon Intensity.
Mana Cost: 100
Divine Fury Cost: 3
Cooldown: 1 seconds

[b]Windforce Sweep[/b]
Skill Tags: Melee, Area Effect
Usable While Unarmed
Deliver a fierce roundhouse kick that deals 135% unarmed damage to nearby targets, inflicts Hindered, reducing their attack and movement speed by 25% for 4 seconds, and knocks back Basic and Elite enemies.
Mana Cost: 50
Stamina Cost: 100
Cooldown: 4 seconds

[b]Crushing Sweep[/b]
Skill Tags: Melee, Area Effect
Usable While Unarmed
Deliver a crushing roundhouse kick that deals 165% unarmed damage and heavy Resilience damage to nearby targets.
Stamina Cost: 150
Cooldown: 4 seconds

[h2]SKILL REWORKS[/h2]
[b]Hallow Weapons Rework[/b]
Renamed to Sanctify Weapons
Now usable with Bows
Added the Divine Skill Tag
Call upon the divine to bless your weapons with overwhelming power. For 6 seconds, Physical Hits deal 50% more Resilience Damage and have a 30% chance to generate 1 stack of Divine Fury.

[b]Divine Hammer Rework[/b]
Added the Divine Skill Tag
Cooldown: 0.25s -> 5s
Now consumes all available Divine Fury to summon 1 Divine Hammer per stack at once
No longer destroys hammers on Meditation
Damage: 85% -> 65% Primary Weapon Damage
Consumes all available Divine Fury to summon 1 divine hammer per stack that spirals around you. Deals 65% Primary Weapon Damage as Spell Damage on hit. Generates 300% threat. Each hammer lasts 10 seconds.

[b]Consecration[/b]
New effect added: While standing in your Consecration, you have a 30% chance when you gain a stack of Divine Fury to gain an additional stack of Divine Fury.
Added the Divine tag.

[b]Blood Rage[/b]: Now ends when exiting combat

[b]Shockwave[/b]: Now usable while moving

[b]Shillelagh[/b]
Mana Cost: 150 -> 125
Primal Charge on hit: 4 -> 5

[h1]NEW ICONS[/h1]
Venombolt
Lacerating Strike
Shadowbolt
Blood Rage
Ice Knife
Summon Bear
Ironhide
Kirkira's Resolve
Earthwarden Stance
Leap Smash
Abyssal Path
Cursed Weapon
Blood Rage
All Shout skills

[h2]KIRKIRA[/h2]
[b]Shatterspell [/b]removed
New T1 Talent: [b]Wellspring [/b]- Mana Regen increased by 10%.

[b]Balanced[/b]: Resilience Damage received is reduced by 10% -> 15%.
[b]Kensai[/b]: Now enables the use of any skill that is Usable While Unarmed.

[h1]IMPROVED[/h1]
Massive performance increase (thanks to your boy finally learning a thing or two about Unreal Engine)
Summon Spider and Summon Greater Spider now use the new spider model
Skills now cost 500 gold (down from 1000)
Significant performance optimizations for River Valtorin (Finally)

Improved Headshot detection for arrows

notes.title: The Companions Update
notes.content:
[h1]COMPANIONS[/h1]
A new NPC, Vangela, has come to Town! She will help you create and manage Companions, new AI-controlled allies with all the same customization options as you. Create your perfect combat partner, or the perfect full squad! 

[h2]Companion Customization[/h2]
[list]
[*]Can equip [b]any gear they meet level requirements for[/b]
[*][b]All Talents[/b]
[*][b]Full Utility Flask Customization[/b]
[/list]
[h2]Companion AI[/h2]
Companions are versatile allies capable of using:
[list]
[*]Any skill, including Supers and defensive abilities like Block, Guard, Crimson Rush, Riposte, and Blinks
[*]Health Flasks
[*]Utility Flasks, with dynamic decision making based on current flask effects and combat situations (conservative during normal encounters, all-out during boss fights)
[*]Dodge Rolls
[/list]
[h2]Misc. Companion Info[/h2]
[list]
[*]You can use (Shift + 1/2/3/4) to quickly control new tabbed menus (Equipment, Talents, Flasks)
[*]Companions in your party will scale up enemy health just as in normal multiplayer (about +80% additional health per ally)
[*]Companions do not generate any additional loot, but they will pick up their own Health Flask, Utility Flask, and Super Orb drops
[*]Magic Find on Companions has no effect, but it is effective to run Magic Find yourself and have your Companions do the killing
[*]Companions will teleport to you on meditation or if they are far away when combat starts
[*]Companions can be resurrected on death
[*]Companions will attempt to resurrect you at the end of combat if necessary
[*]You can toggle a Companion's aggression in Town by right-clicking on their party portrait. This only works while in Town.
[*]All companions created by Hardcore characters will also be Hardcore. Hardcore characters can only recruit Hardcore Companions.
[/list]

[h1]ENEMIES[/h1]
The original spider enemy has been replaced with a new model

[h1]FIXED[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed enemies becoming faster than normal after becoming frozen
[*]Spire of Teurok will now spawn with a usable projectile skill that can benefit from its effect
[*]Fixed skills sometimes becoming unusable in Town after talking to a merchant
[/list]

notes.content:
[h1]NEW[/h1]
[h2]Transmogrification[/h2]
A new NPC in Town, Mystara, will now transmog your items to any other appearance you've collected for 100 gold per piece.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/2e0a1a453ca020f08daf2a2896eccf5f77591f72.png[/img]

[h1]Utility Flask Overhaul[/h1]
[h2]More Flask Points[/h2]
Characters are now awarded an additional Flask Point every 5 levels instead of every 10. Characters will now have a typical maximum of [b]7 Flask Points[/b] at level 30, up from 4.

Binder will now display a floating flask over his head when you have Flask Points to spend.

Almost every Flask Effect has been rebalanced, and [b]11 brand new effects [/b]have been added.

[h2]1-Point Effects[/h2]
[table]
[tr]
    [th]Flask Effect[/th]
    [th]Description[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
    [td]Lesser Regen Mana[/td]
    [td]+15 Mana Regeneration for 4 seconds[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
    [td]Lesser Regen Stamina[/td]
    [td]+15 Stamina Regeneration for 4 seconds[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
    [td]Lesser Regen Health[/td]
    [td]+15 Health Regeneration for 4 seconds[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
    [td]Lesser Vampire[/td]
    [td]Gain Lesser Vampire for 4 seconds, causing Hits to restore 10 Health over 5 seconds.[/td]
[/tr]

notes.title: Major Melee Rebalancing (Buffs), Gamepad Improvements, Utility Flask Buffs
notes.content:
[h1]NEW[/h1]
A new NPC has come to Town! Arena Granny will show you any arena leaderboards you desire.

New loot chest model.

[h1]GAMEPAD IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
[list]
[*] The cursor can now be properly controlled with a gamepad.
[*] While sprinting out of combat, the camera will now rotate towards the direction the player is moving, reducing the need to manually rotate the camera.
[*] Added camera zoom slider to pause menu.
[*] Significantly improved roll directional reading from gamepad.
[/list]
[h1]FLASKS[/h1]
New characters can now choose "Regen Mana" or "Regen Stamina" to be applied to their Utility Flask when created.

[h2]FLASK OPTIONS[/h2]
Instant resource restore options have been removed.
Fortune options have been removed.

[b]Regen Mana[/b]: +10 -> +25 Mana Per Second
[b]Regen Stamina[/b]: +10 -> +25 Stamina Per Second
[b]Regen Health[/b]: +10 -> +25 Health Per Second

[b]Greater Regen Mana[/b]: +20 -> +50 Mana Per Second
[b]Greater Regen Stamina[/b]: +20 -> +50 Stamina Per Second
[b]Greater Regen Health[/b]: +20 -> +50 Health Per Second

[b]Lesser Protection[/b]: 10% -> 15% damage reduction
[b]Protection[/b]: 20% -> 30% damage reduction
[b]Greater Protection[/b]: 30% -> 50% damage reduction

[b]Greater Vampire[/b]: 30 -> 35 Health restore per hit

[b]Mercy[/b]: Points required 2 -> 1
[b]Bottled Lightning[/b]: Points required 3 -> 2

[h1]SKILLS[/h1]
Improved 2H Melee Heavy Attack animation timing.
Increased standard 2H Melee attack animation speed by 10%.

[b]Storm Cyclone[/b]
Damage: 120% -> 40% Combined Weapon Damage per second
[i]Dev Note: Somehow this AoE skill got balanced as a single target spell. Oops.[/i]

[b]Wrath of Ehtiras[/b]
Mana Shield component removed
Duration: 10 -> 8 seconds

[b]Savage Strike[/b]
Damage: 200% -> 250%
New animations

[b]Serrated Dagger[/b]
Stamina Cost: 75 -> 50
Mana Cost: 0 -> 25

[b]Poison Dagger[/b]
Stamina Cost: 75 -> 50
Mana Cost: 0 -> 25

[b]Wolf Form's Lycan Howl[/b]
Hinder Duration: 3s -> 4s

[b]Lacerating Strike[/b]
Damage: 135% -> 95%
Stamina Cost: 100 -> 75
Cooldown: 0s -> 1s

[b]Chilling Strike[/b]
Chill: 30% -> 50%
Damage: 150% -> 125%
New animations
[i]Dev note: Now you can freeze enemies with 2 hits![/i]

[b]Bane Strike[/b]: New animation

[b]Enduring Strike Rework[/b]
[list]
[*] Enduring Strike is now Siphon Strike
[*] Added the Shadow Skill Tag
[*] Strike with your weapon for 235% melee weapon damage to a single target. Regain 75 Health over 5 seconds on hit.
[*] Mana Cost: 80
[*] Stamina Cost: 80
[*] Shadow Offering Cost: 100
[*] Cooldown: 5s
[/list]
[b]Ground Smash[/b]: Damage: 150% -> 250%

[b]Cursed Weapon[/b]
Mana Cost: 80 -> 75
Shadow Offering Cost: 25 -> 35

[h1]TALENTS[/h1]
[h2]ALCAEUS[/h2]
[b]Alert [/b]removed.

[b]New T1 Talent: Crippling[/b]
Melee Hits inflict Hindered, slowing the target's movement and attack speed by 10% for 3 seconds.

[b]Bloodfury Rework[/b]
OLD: Gain 3% bonus attack speed for 4 seconds on Critical Hits. Max 10 stacks.
NEW: Gain 3% bonus attack speed for 1 second on Critical Hits. Max 20 stacks. Stacks fall off faster as they accumulate.

[b]Exerted Strikes[/b]
Now adds base damage based on Bonus Maximum Stamina (from gear and bonuses) instead of Maximum Stamina (grand total).

[b]Precision Fighter Rework[/b]
Renamed to [b]Precision[/b]
Damaging skills that cost Stamina consume 20% less Stamina.

[b]Focused Impacts[/b]
Damage bonus: 30% -> 40%

[b]Elusive Rework[/b]
Every 5 seconds, gain Elusive, causing your next dodge roll to be free and recover 30% faster. Reduces threat generation by 50%.

[h2]ZABAOTH[/h2]
[b]Voracious [/b]removed.

[b]Overpowering[/b]
Moved from T2 to T1
Resilience Damage Bonus: 25% -> 15%

[b]New T2 Talent: Unyielding[/b]
Gain 5% Damage Resistance for each 100 Health you are missing, up to 40%.

[b]Blood Frenzy[/b]
Attack Speed Bonus: 10% -> 15%

[b]Vengeful[/b]
Total Damage per stack: 3% -> 10%
Max Stacks: 5 -> 3

[b]Brutal[/b]
Damage bonus: 30% -> 40%

[h2]EHTIRAS[/h2]
[b]Mana Shield [/b]removed.

[b]New T2 Talent: Arcane Resilience[/b]
For every 100 Mana spent, increase your damage resistance to the next hit by 10%, up to a max of 50%.

[b]Innate Magic[/b]
Non-caster weapons contribute 100% -> 30% of base damage to Spells.

[b]Runeskin[/b]
1% -> 2% of your Maximum Stamina is added to Physical Resistance.
1% -> 2% of your Maximum Mana is added to Magic Resistance.

[h1]LOOT[/h1]
[b]New Legendary Helmet: Truestrike Crest[/b]
Your Critical Strike Chance is 100%. Your Critical Strikes deal no extra damage.

[b]New Legendary Shield: Arcane Aegis[/b]
While in combat, 75% of spent mana is stored as potential energy, up to 50% of your Maximum Mana. Dodge rolls and Heavy Attacks consume all stored energy to create a shield which blocks damage.

[b]Hexsteel Gauntlets[/b]
100% -> 30% of base damage added to Spells

[h1]BOSS-EXCLUSIVE LOOT[/h1]
All bosses now have some legendaries exclusively attainable by slaying them.

Castle:
Spire of Teurok
Vessel of The Serrated Claw

Icewastes:
Frostcrag
Frostshard Core

Forest:
Swarmcaller
Venomwood

Cave:
Tectonic Step
Boulder Fauld

Temple of Fire:
Firestorm
Armor of the Avatar

Fort Ironhold:
Orias' Advance
The Ordained

Ironhold Interior:
Magefiend Grasp
Voice of Resonance

Ironhold Dungeon:
Ferocious Sabatons
Warlord's Helm

The Giant Mine:
Shatterwall
Blast Dagger

Kharabad City - Eastern Desert City:
Giant's Girdle
Ruin

River Valtorin:
Legplates of the Avatar
The Ice Star

Avatar's Reach:
Helmet of the Avatar
Thunderlord's Crown

Wythmere City:
Soulbound Aegis
Rite of Infernal Blood

[h1]ENEMIES[/h1]
Reduced the movement speed of ranged enemies.

[b]Kharabad Boss[/b]
Modified slam attacks to now deal damage instantly in a small area when the slam hits, and increased the distance at which the line of explosions start to create a small safe zone around him. This changes the dodge timing for melee characters to be more intuitive (dodging the actual slam) instead of waiting for the delayed explosions.

[h1]IMPROVED[/h1]
[list]
[*] Massively improved gamepad support and fixed numerous bugs related to gamepad use.
[*] Improved the radial menu design.
[*] New loot pickup UI animations.
[*] New stat lines for total Resource Cost Reduction for mana and stamina.
[*] Pact minions that occlude your character can now be seen through.
[*] Further improved multiplayer level traveling.
[*] River Valtorin water ripples are back!
[*] Bosses now have unique SFX on hitstun.
[*] Pact minions now have unique SFX when spawned.
[*] Updated some translations.
[/list]
[h1]CHANGED[/h1]
Reduced the XP reward from quests.

[h1]FIXED[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed the tutorial never showing up.
[*] Fixed meditation options being inaccessible.
[*] Fixed minions aggroing to shrines.
[*] Fixed Whirlwind inflicting multiple hits on startup.
[*] Fixed Wythmere Boss not resetting properly.
[*] Fixed "Respawn Nearby" not working on Kharabad and Wythmere maps.
[*] Fixed Whirlwind not benefitting from effects that target Area Effects.
[*] Fixed animations for Shockwave.
[*] Fixed Chill effects lasting forever.
[*] Fixed physical animation when hitting an enemy not working.
[*] Fixed Korean translation not working.
[/list]

notes.title: Boss Music Update, Heavy Attack Overhaul, Enemy Rebalancing, New Astaroth Super
notes.content:
[h1]ENEMIES[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]All bosses now have their own unique soundtrack(!!)[/b]
[*] Increased loot quality from Act Bosses and Raid Bosses.
[*] Reduced the intensity of Ignites inflicted by Temple of Fire enemies.
[*] Ignites from different enemy sources now all contribute to a single stack (reducing spell effect clutter).
[*] Reduced the movement speed of some enemies.
[*] Added SFX and Screen VFX when Poison affects the player.
[*] Removed the Frost Aura ability from an Icewastes enemy and replaced it with a Chill on hit effect.
[*] Removed the Demon Wolf enemy.
[/list]

[h1]SUPERS[/h1]
[b]Astaroth's Idol [/b]is now [b]Astaroth's Endurance[/b]
Entangle with an allied target. While Entangled and within 1000 range, the Entangled ally gains Astaroth's Endurance, regenerating 5% of maximum health per second, reducing damage taken by 20%, and increasing Total Damage by 20%. Lasts for 8 seconds.

[b]Sendatu's Crown Rework[/b]
Create an area that applies Brutality, Precision, Lethality, Haste, and Undying Will to allies in range. Lasts for 10 seconds.

[h1]SKILLS[/h1]
Increased hitstop on all melee skills.

All Melee Heavy Combos been replaced with a single heavy attack. Damage multiplier increased from 2x to 2.5x. Removed Heavy Attack Vulnerability.
[i]Dev note: The old heavy combo system was bad. "Don't use it or you'll die" bad. This new system is a great way to capitalize on hitstuns.[/i]

[b]Shield Slam[/b]
Damage: 25x -> 10x Shield Implicit Level
Stamina Cost: 75 -> 125
Cooldown: 6s -> 8s

[b]Shield Throw[/b]
Damage: 20x -> 6x Shield Implicit Level
Cooldown: 5s -> 6s

[b]Shield Charge[/b]
Damage: 20x -> 8x Shield Implicit Level
Stamina Cost: 75 -> 100
[i]Dev Note: These were really strong, and made stronger by the earlier change to make shields have double strength implicits.[/i]

[b]Dark Grasp [/b]has been renamed [b]Shadow Grasp[/b].

[h1]IMPROVED[/h1]
Added XP values to the XP bar

Reduced the visual intensity of Ethereal Chains

[h1]FIXED[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed Chill effects stacking higher than intended
[*] Fixed Arc Slash not dealing Resilience Damage
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes caused enemies to become immortal
[*] Fixed MTX purchases not starting
[/list]

notes.title: Multiplayer Networking Fixed! (Finally), Temple of Fire Quest Fix
notes.content:
NEW
When disconnected from your party, you will receive a Reconnect Prompt at the main menu to quickly rejoin them.

IMPROVED
[b]Massively [/b]improved multiplayer connectivity
[i]Dev note: There was a strange bug with River Valtorin that caused crashes on ANY attempt to travel to the level with multiple players. Strangely enough the fix was to remove the pretty water ripple effects. Game dev is weird sometimes. Hopefully the ripples will return soon.[/i]

Improved load time on initial start up

FIXED
Fixed The Fire Temple quest being impossible to complete. Use the "Clear Current Quest" option in the pause menu and reacquire the quest from Binder in Town.

notes.title: The Temple of Fire Update
notes.content:
[h1]CAMPAIGN[/h1]
Troll Lair has been replaced with the [b]Temple of Fire[/b]. New enemies and Act Boss.

The following maps have brand new bosses:
[list]
[*] Avatar's Reach (New Act Boss)
[*] Fort Ironhold
[*] Ironhold Dungeon
[*] Ironhold Interior
[/list]
Forest and Icewastes maps now have all new enemies.

[h1]INFINITE HIGH ARENA[/h1]
Completing Act 2 High Arena will unlock the Infinite High Arena. This map is similar to the normal Infinite Arena with the addition of non-Act bosses being added to EVERY wave and Act Bosses on every 5th wave. New leaderboards have been added for this mode.

Arena and Infinite Arena can now spawn any non-Act Boss.

All Arenas now select enemies from a random map for each wave.

[h1]GAMEPLAY[/h1]
Dying during a boss fight which contains a fog door will allow you to respawn just outside the fog door when your entire party falls.

Reduced jump height by 30%.

All new elite enemies can now be spawned by Loot Crystals.

Minidungeons can now spawn any non-Act Boss.

[h1]SKILLS[/h1]
New Cerridwen Super: [b]Summon Cyclops[/b]

[b]Necrosis[/b]
Added Shadow Skill Tag
Now Generates 5 Shadow Offering each time it deals damage.

[b]Blight Arrow[/b]
Added Shadow Skill Tag
Now Generates 5 Shadow Offering each time it deals damage.

[h1]LOOT[/h1]
Chests now have a 10% chance to roll as 1 of 5 special reward chests with the same rewards as their minidungeon counterparts. These chests are now colored appropriately as well.

Loot Filter: New setting for Minimum Implicit Mod Tier

[h1]ENEMIES[/h1]
Troll enemies have been replaced with Cyclops that come in 3 variations: Base, Frost, and Poison

The 3 original bosses have been removed (Cannon, Spider, Rampage).

[h1]MISC[/h1]
New world map art
Added a new slider for Spell Effect Notification Text Size under Gameplay Settings

[h1]FIXED[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed loads of jank with the horse.
[*] Fixed a bug with Wrath of Ehtiras doing $#@%loads more damage than intended.
[*] Fixed a bug where wave rewards in Infinite Arena were selecting from a small pool of legendaries instead of the normal global legendary pool.
[/list]

notes.title: The Shadow Update
notes.content:
[h1]NEW BOSSES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Stonefrost Warden - Icewastes Maps
[*]Terraclaw - Cave Maps
[*]Netherfiend Sorcerer - Castle Maps
[/list]
All new bosses can spawn in Arena.

[h1]New Skill Tags[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Shadow[/b] - Skills that interact with the new Shadow Offering resource.
[*][b]Curse[/b] - Debuffs applied by Shadow skills.
[/list]
[h1]NEW MECHANICS[/h1]
[h2]Shadow Offering[/h2]
Skills that cost Shadow Offering will first draw from your accumulated Shadow Offering, any leftover cost will be collected from your Health.

[h2]Desecrated Ground[/h2]
Enemies standing on this area grant 6 Shadow Offering on Hit. Absorbs nearby Curses and applies them to all nearby enemies.

[h2]Freeze[/h2]
[list]
[*] All Chills applied to a target now contribute to Freeze.
[*] When the total amount of Chills applied to a target reaches 100%, the target becomes Frozen.
[*] Frozen targets immediately take 50% combined weapon damage and are stunned and unable to move for 2 seconds.
[*] Freeze can only occur on a target once.
[/list]
[h1]NEW SKILLS[/h1]
[h2]CURSES[/h2]
[h3]Torment[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/c15d012d72ee798f8427126b9d991550763e4b64.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Skill Tags:[/b] Spell, Projectile, Shadow, Curse
[*][b]Effect:[/b] Curse the target with Torment, causing it to take damage over time equal to 40% Combined Weapon Damage per active Curse on the target per second. Lasts 4 seconds.
[*][b]Mana Cost:[/b] 100
[*][b]Shadow Offering Cost:[/b] 50
[*][b]Cooldown:[/b] 8 seconds
[*][b]Range:[/b] 1,500
[/list]

[h3]Ethereal Chains[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/2db2f5b94c73bc37d51b776f673900401eb329bd.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Skill Tags:[/b] Spell, Projectile, Shadow, Curse
[*][b]Effect:[/b] Curse the target with Ethereal Chains, reducing the target's Movement Speed by 25% for 4 seconds.
[*][b]Mana Cost:[/b] 100
[*][b]Shadow Offering Cost:[/b] 50
[*][b]Cooldown:[/b] 8 seconds
[*][b]Range:[/b] 1,500
[/list]

[h3]Vulnerability[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/b2d65ce641499de369bb64aab7ca3ff4a34c728d.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Skill Tags:[/b] Spell, Projectile, Shadow, Curse
[*][b]Effect:[/b] Curse the target with Vulnerability, causing it to take 15% more damage from all sources for 4 seconds.
[*][b]Mana Cost:[/b] 100
[*][b]Shadow Offering Cost:[/b] 50
[*][b]Cooldown:[/b] 8 seconds
[*][b]Range:[/b] 1,500
[/list]

[h3]Enfeeble[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/2ecf9a036b2d7e63dc85f9478f7d11f1fc309dc5.png[/img]

[*][b]Skill Tags:[/b] Spell, Projectile, Shadow, Curse
[*][b]Effect:[/b] Curse the target with Enfeeble, causing it to deal 15% reduced damage for 4 seconds.
[*][b]Mana Cost:[/b] 80
[*][b]Shadow Offering Cost:[/b] 40
[*][b]Cooldown:[/b] 8 seconds
[*][b]Range:[/b] 1,500
[/list]

[h3]Deathmark[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/74d7f5128367a130865d945c1812af610388d0aa.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Skill Tags:[/b] Spell, Projectile, Shadow, Curse
[*][b]Effect:[/b] Curse the target with Deathmark, causing it to die at 15% or less Health.
[*][b]Mana Cost:[/b] 100
[*][b]Shadow Offering Cost:[/b] 50
[*][b]Cooldown:[/b] 8 seconds
[*][b]Range:[/b] 1,500
[/list]

[h2]OTHER SKILLS[/h2]
[h3]Shadowbolt[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/b6bd7f8ad18d23c4c3dc43b84f4c10c49fe80026.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Skill Tags:[/b] Spell, Projectile, Shadow
[*][b]Requires:[/b] a Staff or Focus equipped

[*][b]Mana Cost:[/b] 25
[*][b]Cooldown:[/b] 0.3 seconds
[*][b]Range:[/b] 1,500
[/list]

[h3]Hex[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/d7d4bf7e81c63c4c546443ed681db7ae1d5a9bba.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Skill Tags:[/b] Spell, Projectile, Shadow

[h3]Void Rain[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/5d89f54a3a1d2eef7e36d6978c941b934010fe3c.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Skill Tags:[/b] Spell, Area Effect, Shadow
[*][b]Requires:[/b] a Staff or Focus equipped
[*][b]Effect:[/b] Conjure a cloud of void-infused energy that rains down, dealing 40% Spell Damage per second for 8 seconds and creating Desecrated Ground.
[*][b]Mana Cost:[/b] 150
[*][b]Shadow Offering Cost:[/b] 50
[*][b]Cooldown:[/b] 4 seconds
[/list]

[h3]Cursed Weapon[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/4d4569bc5d96d2cae03da26b98a6dc469ed33cf5.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Skill Tags:[/b] Shadow

[*][b]Shadow Offering Cost:[/b] 50
[*][b]Cooldown:[/b] 8 seconds

[h3]Shadow Tether[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/c6e2c84d70512dd36801ec4444b4f3e108025413.png[/img]

New Tooltips: Simplified some skill descriptions and moved descriptions for common effects such as Poison into additional tooltips.

notes.title: The Primal Update
notes.content:
[h1]NEW[/h1]
[list]
[*]New Boss - Verdant Terror: This new plant-themed boss will always spawn on Forest maps, and has a chance to spawn in Arena and Invasions.

[i]Dev note: This boss is very different from existing bosses and will likely need some tweaking. It utilizes large crowd control effects, area denial, poison, and a unique lash attack that pulls the target. Please send any feedback on this boss to me in Discord and good luck.[/i]
[*]Neutral Dodge now initiates a quick backstep with fewer i-frames and faster recovery.
[*]Improved Two-Handed Melee Heavy Attack animation timings.
[*]New Starting Weapon Loadout - Primal: Start with two Focuses that utilize the new Primal Generator and Spender skills.
[/list]
[h1]SKILL TAGS[/h1]
[list]
[*]Primal - Skills that generate or spend Primal Charge.
[*]Transformation - Skills that transform your character or are granted by a transformation.
[/list]
[h1]Primal Skills[/h1]
All Primal skills are either Primal Charge generators or spenders. Spender skills have no weapon requirements as these are powered by your accumulated Primal Charge. Primal Charge can only be gained while in combat and caps at 100 stacks. Generators can roll randomly on gear, but Spenders must be purchased from the Skill Merchant.

[h1]Transformation Skills[/h1]
Gain "Animus Lock" for three seconds after entering a transformation: "The rush of feral instincts from your recent transformation demands you hold onto this form. Cannot change form."

Instant cast spells may be cast while transformed, as long as your normal form meets the weapon requirements for the skill. This includes most buffs, Shouts, Entanglements, Auras, Toggles like Bladecrest and Bloodrage, Blinks, Consecration, Flame Dash, Phase Shift, and probably a few more. Visiting the Skill Merchant while transformed and pressing the "Current Usable" button will show you all skills usable while transformed with your current equipment. Traps cannot be cast while transformed.

[h1]NEW SKILLS[/h1]
[h2]Bear Form[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/26b702feb94b556ab32b06f2b03b2b9547474c4c.png[/img]
Transformation, Primal
Toggle. While active, you are a bear. Gain 50% Total Damage, 30% Damage Reduction, and generate 500% more Threat, but lose the ability to Dodge. Gain Animus Lock for three seconds after casting, disabling your ability to change form again.
Cost: 30 Mana/second while in combat

[h2]Bear Form Abilities:[/h2]
[h3]Swipe[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/968a73b08416bd01d270e46030e34fe71b081cb0.gif[/img]
Melee, Strike, Transformation, Primal
Swipe with your powerful claws. Hits grant 10 Primal Charge.

[h3]Maul[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/b8b1901a3178ee9989d6c0d54cb2f1444502344a.gif[/img]
Melee, Strike, Transformation, Primal
Viciously maul enemies with your claws, dealing 180% combined weapon damage and bleeding all targets for the same amount. Grants one stack of Grizzly Wrath for each target hit. Grizzly Wrath increases Total Damage by 10% per stack for 15 seconds. Additional stacks do not reset duration. All stacks are lost when exiting Bear Form.
Primal Charge Cost: 20
Stamina Cost: 150

[h3]Ursine Slam[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/7ff4144a8a4b5540884fdd55644a32b7e35fb938.gif[/img]
Area Effect, Transformation, Primal
Slam the ground with your claws, dealing 150% Combined Weapon Damage to all nearby targets.
Stamina Cost: 150
Primal Charge Cost: 25
Cooldown: 8 seconds

[h3]Ironhide[/h3]
Transformation, Primal
Gain one stack of Ironhide. While you have Ironhide, incoming attacks will consume one stack to block the attack, as with a shield. Uses your equipped shield if you have one, and otherwise reduces incoming damage by 25%. Successful blocks generate 15 Primal Charge and return 50% of the incoming damage to the attacker. All stacks are lost when exiting Bear Form, if your block is ever broken, or by attempting to Dodge Roll. Max 5 stacks.
Mana Cost: 30
Cooldown: 1 second

[h2]Wolf Form[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/9afced210496ca630ad7faee7d0cb3d15c987c9e.png[/img]
Transformation, Primal
Toggle. While active, you are a werewolf with increased attack speed. Gain Animus Lock for three seconds after casting, disabling your ability to change form again.
Cost: 30 Mana/second while in combat

[h2]Wolf Form Abilities:[/h2]
[h3]Swipe[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/ed0c9f25f4e00273930e044ac8b9a7abba7f316f.gif[/img]
Melee, Strike, Transformation, Primal
Swipe with your powerful claws. Hits grant 10 Primal Charge.

[h3]Feral Slash[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/324b0ae66f5bdcfc844f7dc0ff688e6b1406b160.gif[/img]
Melee, Strike, Transformation, Primal
Swipe viciously, dealing 175% combined weapon damage. On hit, gain 30% Attack Speed for 3 seconds.
Primal Charge Cost: 50
Stamina Cost: 150

[h3]Wolf Rush[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/5ed6064962679156518da58c65b62fad29c0ccda.gif[/img]
Melee, Mobility, Transformation, Primal
Quickly dash forward. On colliding with an enemy, attack for 150% combined weapon damage. Generates 10 Primal Charge per target hit. Can interrupt current action.
Stamina Cost: 75
Cooldown: 4 seconds

[h3]Lycan Howl[/h3]
Transformation, Shout
Let forth a frightening howl, hindering all nearby enemies, reducing their attack and movement speed by 25% for 3 seconds.
Mana Cost: 125
Cooldown: 8 seconds

[h1]OTHER NEW SKILLS[/h1]
[h2]Sporebolt[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/d55938ab611e8f1bb47fe8f735c0737dff045e48.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/5adbff67e9460b54fa723551b297f74b53262951.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/2952289f1d54ee1b3e3830815e177629dc0a6eb6.png[/img]
Spell, Projectile, Area Effect, Primal
Cast a poisonous seed pod that deals 20% Spell Damage and creates a toxic area on impact that inflicts targets with 1 stack of Poison per second. Poison deals 10% Spell Damage per second per stack. Max 20 stacks. Generates 10 Primal Charge.
Mana Cost: 75

[h2]Thornbolt[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/830a966d6d78e1da2ca051956608d782b7a5887a.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/029f21f0af7552d5bc4ad2b47ce4bf57041ea7b9.png[/img]
Spell, Projectile, Primal
Cast a viciously thorned seed pod that deals 125% Spell Damage. Generates 8 Primal Charge.
Mana Cost: 50

[h2]Insect Swarm[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/577bc368f80fec9bf34b57e941f631c4123a80c8.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/4d4292323cdf6eb7ba9eb2d68b5a55401f410632.png[/img]
Spell, Projectile, Area Effect, Primal
Summon a swarm of insects upon your foes, dealing 40% combined weapon damage to all targets in its path. Generates 4 Primal Charge on cast and 2 Primal Charge per target hit.
Mana Cost: 45

[h2]Twister[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/5345d9fa705eb372817ea24c7bb99ccb03e65fe1.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/48ab3a272c9d5ed9e4380f29b5b793dd76d413d5.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/605a2aeecc0ce5d81fd980c95fdfdd016ebf89fa.png[/img]
Spell, Projectile, Area Effect, Primal
Cast out a twister that deals 60% Spell Damage to all targets hit. Generates 5 Primal Charge on cast and 2 Primal Charge for each enemy hit.
Mana Cost: 100

[h2]Shillelagh[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/f4493e5615a9e6d2763002806bb2c76a199aa302.png[/img]
For 6 seconds, all Melee Hits generate 4 Primal Charge. Instant cast.
Mana Cost: 150
Cooldown: 8 seconds

[h2]Storm Cyclone[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/02ad1b750c94c6f58634cd6965e5b951ac99d3d1.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/ea84c19b27c3a2ad1c4ea563a223b465c255aa04.png[/img]
Spell, Area Effect, Primal
Call up a powerful lightning-infused cyclone for 5 seconds that chases nearby enemies and deals 120% Combined Weapon Damage to all nearby targets each second.
Primal Charge Cost: 30

notes.title: Wildshot Overhaul, New Quiver Skill
notes.content:
[h1]THE BIG CHANGE[/h1]
Additional projectiles from Wildshot effects can no longer shotgun targets.

[h1]WILDSHOT[/h1]
Wildshot now exists as 2 new effects:

[b]Lesser Wildshot [/b]- Projectile skills fire 2 additional projectiles and deal 15% less damage.

[b]Wildshot [/b]- Projectile skills fire 4 additional projectiles and deal 35% less damage.

The original Wildshot Flask Effect now applies the new Wildshot.

A new Flask Effect "[b]Lesser Wildshot[/b]" is now available for 2 Flask Points.

[h1]SKILLS[/h1]
[b]New Skill: Arcane Quiver[/b]
Toggle. While active, all arrows are imbued with arcane energy and apply 1 stack of Arcane Resonance to the target for 6 seconds. 3 stacks of Arcane Resonance causes the target to unleash the resonating arcane energy in a burst that deals 125% spell damage and applies 1 stack of Arcane Resonance to all nearby targets.

Cost per Arrow: 70 Mana

[b]Magic Missiles [/b]in the same Wildshot volley will no longer home in on the same target.

[b]Divine Hammer[/b]
Projectile tag removed.
Primary Weapon Damage: 60% -> 85%

[h1]ITEMS[/h1]
[h2]Verndari Firing Gloves Rework[/h2]
[b]OLD AND BUSTED[/b]
Granted skill always has Wildshot. No other skills can benefit from Wildshot. Resource costs of granted skill increased by 50%.

[b]NEW HOTNESS[/b]
Granted skill always has Lesser Wildshot. Resource costs of granted skill increased by 30%.

[i]Dev Note: Wildshot will override the Lesser Wildshot provided by this item. While you have Wildshot or Lesser Wildshot from a Flask Effect, the resource cost increase is disabled.[/i]

[h2]Verndari Volley Grips Rework[/h2]
[b]OLD AND BUSTED[/b]
Wildshot now adds 4 projectiles to the granted skill.

[b]NEW HOTNESS[/b]
Lesser Wildshot instead applies the effects of Wildshot to the granted skill.

[h2]Will of the Wild Rework[/h2]
Fully Charged Arrows have Lesser Wildshot. While you have Lesser Wildshot, Fully Charged Arrows have Wildshot.

notes.title: The Forgeborne Awakening
notes.content:
[i]In the depths of ancient forges, a transformation stirs. Constructs—once mere machines of steel and gears—now arise as Forgeborne, behemoths of stone and metal, their very essence imbued with arcane and elemental might. No longer confined to the rigidity of their mechanical origins, they pulse with the untamed forces of the elements. The Forgeborne represent a new pinnacle of mystical craftsmanship. These formidable entities are not just creations; they are evolutions. In the crucible of magic and metallurgy, they have found a new state of being, transcending their functional past to become true champions of elemental power.[/i]

[h1]CHANGED[/h1]
The Construct Tag has been replaced with Forgeborne. All previous references to Constructs now refer to Forgeborne.

[h1]SKILLS[/h1]
[b]Construct Power Mech [/b]has been replaced with [b]Forge Flamebound Titan[/b]
[b]New Pact Effect[/b]: Gain Level 2 Fire Weapon Enchant - Physical Hits Ignite for 10% of the damage inflicted.

[b]Construct Vanguard Mech [/b]has been replaced with [b]Forge Frostbound Titan[/b]
[b]New Pact Effect[/b]: Gain Level 2 Ice Weapon Enchant - Physical Hits apply a 4% Chill for 3 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times.

[b]New Skill: Forge Stormbound Titan[/b]
Forge a Stormbound Titan to fight for you. Hold Skill Modifier (default: Left Alt) while casting to dismiss.

[b]Pact Effect[/b]: Gain Level 2 Lightning Weapon Enchant - Physical Hits have a 30% chance to chain lightning to 2 additional targets for 20% of the damage.

All 3 new Titans have a [b]unique nova attack [/b]with a 6 second cooldown.

[i]Dev Note: All 3 new Titans are also using the new AI Behavior system that is driving the slew of new enemies from the Frontiers update. They should still look and behave mostly like the old mechs, but this new system makes it quick and easy to add new special abilities and unique behavior, and allows for skills like the new Invoke Pact. notes.title: The Frontiers Update
notes.content:
[h1]NEW[/h1]
[h2]MAPS[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fort Ironhold
[*] Ironhold Dungeon
[*] Castle Interior
[*] The Giant Mines (New enemies and boss)
[*] Kharabad City (New enemies and boss)
[*] River Valtorin (New enemies and Act Boss)
[*] Wythmere City (New enemies and Act Boss)
[/list]
[h2]QUESTS[/h2]
New quests have been added. Head to Town to start the new journey.

[h2]GAMEPLAY[/h2]
[h3]Invasion Overhaul[/h3]
Invasions are now activated from the Obelisk in Town. The Obelisk also allows you to manually set your Invasion level based on the highest level of Invasion you've completed. Maps are no longer randomly invaded. The Obelisk will unlock after defeating the Act 4 Boss on Commander difficulty.

[h3]Difficulty Unlocks[/h3]
Both Captain and Commander difficulties are unlocked after completing the campaign on Normal difficulty. All enemies above Normal difficulty are level 30.

[i]Dev Note: The campaign is now long enough that new characters are level 30 upon completing it on Normal. Now it's up to you to determine what level of challenge you want instead of having to complete Captain difficulty first.[/i]

[h3]New Random Event - Mini-Dungeon[/h3]
Completing any random encounter has a small chance to spawn a portal to a mini dungeon with its own boss and treasure room. Every treasure room contains 4 chests, 1 of which contains a specific type of guaranteed loot. The type of loot is indicated by the color of the portal:

Blue: 2 Pieces of Enchanted Equipment
Orange: 1 Piece of Legendary Equipment
Red: 25 Runestones and 5 Favored Runestones
Yellow: 50 bags of Gold
Green: 10 of each non-Favored crafting item, chance for Favored crafting items

[h3]Other Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Spell Effect Notification - Popup texts now alert you when buffs and debuffs are applied. On by default. Can be toggled in Gameplay settings.
[*] New Skill Bar art and layout
[*] Items can now be sold at The Gambler
[*] A new Shrine type "Fortune" can now spawn - Increases Magic Find by 100% for 30 seconds.
[*] Added a "Reset" button to the Flask menu
[*] Added icons for equipment type and skill to tooltips
[*] Gloves and Belt filters have been added to the stash filter list
[*] New charge up meter art changes when you're charging a mana or stamina skill.
[*] New circular charge meter added to center screen.
[*] New options to toggle charge meters and adjust size of center meter.
[*] Added a Wave emote
[*] Castle maps are no longer eligible for Invasions
[/list]
[h3]FLASKS[/h3]
New Flask Effect "Fortune" - Increases Magic Find by X% for 4 seconds.
[list]
[*] [b]Lesser Fortune [/b](1 point) - 25% Magic Find
[*] [b]Fortune [/b](2 points) - 50% Magic Find
[*] [b]Greater Fortune [/b](3 points) - 75% Magic Find
[/list]
[h2]ITEMS[/h2]
[h3]NEW LEGENDARIES - Global[/h3]
[b]Sendatu's Fury - 1H Sword[/b]
Bladecrest projectiles grant 1 stack of Divine Resonance on hit. At 20 stacks or after 3 seconds, the effect bursts, dealing 5% combined weapon damage per stack to all nearby targets. Damage area increases with stacks. Damage doubled while wielding two Sendatu's Fury.

[b]Sendatu's Grace - 1H Sword[/b]
Bladecrest projectiles grant 1 stack of Divine Resonance on hit. At 20 stacks or after 3 seconds, the effect bursts, casting (Brutality/Haste/Precision/Lethality/Undying Will) on you and nearby allies at 1% increased Boon Intensity per stack. Bonus increased to 2% per stack while wielding two Sendatu's Grace.

[i]Dev Note: The boon assigned to Sendatu's Grace is randomly rolled. Dual-wielding two Sendatu's Grace with different boons will apply both.[/i]

[h1]BALANCE[/h1]
Enchant costs reduced by 50%.

[h2]TALENTS[/h2]
[h3]VERNDARI[/h3]
[b]New Talent: Aspect of the Razorcat [/b]- 20% chance on hit to Bleed the target for 100% of the damage inflicted and gain 1 stack of Feral Momentum. Killing a target grants 1 stack of Feral Momentum. Feral Momentum increases movement speed by 5% per stack for 6 seconds, up to 5 stacks.

[b]Wildshot [/b]talent removed.

[b]Aspect of the Wolf Rework[/b]
Old Version: On hit, manifest the Aspect of the Wolf for 5 seconds. Aspect of the Wolf gives your Hits a 30% chance to hit an additional time. After losing Aspect of the Wolf, you cannot gain it again for 5 seconds.

New Version: 20% chance for your Hits to Hit an additional time. Hits with arrows count as Melee Hits.

[i]Dev Note: The second half of this talent is unchanged. Aspect of the Wolf now causes arrows to proc the effects of Berserker Sash and Arcane Weapon, which are Melee Hit effects. You'll still need Innate Magic in order to cast Arcane Weapon with a bow equipped.[/i]

[h3]KIRKIRA[/h3]
[b]New Talent: Familiar [/b]- Gain a familiar that floats around you and echoes your Projectile spell casts at 50% damage. 0.5 second cooldown between spell casts.

[b]Innate Magic [/b]moved to Ehtiras.

[b]Greater Heightened Spell[/b] renamed to [b]Ultimate Arcanum[/b].

[h3]EHTIRAS[/h3]
[b]Innate Magic [/b]added from Kirkira.

[b]Bottled Lightning [/b]removed.

[h3]SENDATU[/h3]
[b]High-Capacity Flask [/b]renamed to [b]Oversized Flask[/b].

[h3]ASTAROTH[/h3]
[b]Rapid-Delivery System [/b]renamed to [b]Diffusive Flask[/b].

[h3]ZABAOTH[/h3]
[b]Mighty Warrior [/b]renamed to [b]Brutal[/b].
[b]Catastrophic Impacts [/b]renamed to [b]Destructive[/b].
[b]Revenge [/b]renamed to [b]Vengeful[/b].

[h2]ITEMS[/h2]
[b]The Ordained [/b]no longer requires the caster to be within Consecration for allies to benefit from the Blessed effect. This adds more value for ranged support builds.

[h2]SKILLS[/h2]
[h3]Whirlwind[/h3]
Movement speed penalty removed.
Players can no longer avoid hits from enemies by Whirlwinding inside the enemy character model.

[b]Blizzard [/b]now only applies On Hit effects on the initial blast, not every damage tick.

[h2]ENEMIES[/h2]
Act 1 Boss damage reduced by 15%.

[h1]IMPROVED[/h1]
[list]
[*] Gold rewards from quests significantly increased.
[*] Quests to kill Act Bosses now reward an Absolution on completion.
[*] Talents that can be allocated now have a fancy glowy effect.
[*] Enemy AI improved (Fireflies and other ranged enemies will now strafe you, attempt to maintain their distance from you, and reposition to target you around obstacles)
[*] Training Dummies no longer activate the combat state
[*] Improved Visibility of NPC names
[*] New Heartbeat sound at low health
[*] New tooltips for Captain and Commander difficulties detailing the changes of each
[/list]
[h2]Lighting and Clouds Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Town
[*] Act 1 Castle
[*] Avatar's Reach (New clouds)
[*] Forest (Day and Night, new Rain and clouds)
[*] Icewastes (Day and Night, Clouds, Snow, Aurora)
[/list]
[h2]NEW ICONS[/h2]
[h3]SKILLS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Blackflame Assassin Super
[*] Feast
[*] Bat Swarm
[*] Summon Blood Leshen
[*] Summon Zombie Warrior
[*] Construct Power Mech
[*] Construct Vanguard Mech
[*] Frost Aura
[*] Lethality Aura
[*] Lightning Aura
[/list]
[h3]TALENTS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Orias - Adamantine
[*] Orias - Reinforcement
[/list]
[h2]ACHIEVEMENTS[/h2]
[list]
[*] Invasion Expert: Defeat a Level 75 -> 60 Invasion
[*] Invasion Master: Defeat a Level 100 -> 70 Invasion
[*] New Achievements for each of the new quests.
[*] New Achievement icons for all quests.
[/list]
[h1]FIXED[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed Verndari Firing Gloves and Verndari Volley Grips not working with Rapid Fire
[*] Fixed Damaging Auras that are granted by Devotion benefitting from Heightened Spell and Ultimate Arcanum
[*] Fixed enemies spawning in walls
[*] Fixed Ehtiran Interrogators not working with Melee hits
[*] Fixed Focused Impacts not applying to some spells
[*] Restored the sound of firing an arrow to Rapid Fire
[*] Fixed Song of Ice being unable to drop in some circumstances
[*] Fixed Spire of Teurok not working with charge-up projectile skills like Fireball and Blizzard
[*] Fixed Blizzard and Fireball not benefitting from Spell Sniper
[*] Fixed an interaction with Blinks and Dash
[*] Fixed Mana Frenzy showing incorrect numbers on Spell Effect tooltip
[*] Potential fix for some chat spam
[*] Fixed Protection Flask Effects being permanent
[*] Fixed Greater Protection Flask Effect granting only 20% damage resistance instead of 30%
[*] Fixed Backstab breaking skill use on kill
[*] Fixed Chain Lightning effects from Lightning Quiver arrows not damaging the first enemy on the chain when the arrow collided with the environment
[/list]
[h1]REMOVED[/h1]
Photo Mode
