notes.title: Upcoming Frontiers Update & Price Increase
notes.content:
Knights,

It's with a blend of enthusiasm and gratitude that I present to you the details of another massive update: [b]The Frontiers Update[/b]. Before diving into the novel features, I want to address an imminent change: [b]the price of the game will be increasing soon[/b]. This adjustment reflects the extensive content and features I've added, and it's based on your invaluable feedback that I've been able to enhance our game's value.

[h1]What's Inside the Frontiers Update[/h1]

    [b]Maps Galore[/b]: Embark on journeys to new destinations such as Fort Ironhold, Ironhold Dungeon, The Giant Mines, Kharabad City, and more, as well as new unique enemies and bosses. This update adds 2 new Acts to the campaign.

    [b]Invasion Overhaul[/b]: Say goodbye to random map invasions! With the new Obelisk in Town, you can trigger Invasions and customize your Invasion level.

    [b]Revamped Gameplay Mechanics[/b]: From a redesigned skill bar to new item filters and more streamlined selling methods, I've worked diligently to smooth out the gameplay for you.

    [b]Discover the "Fortune" Flask Effect[/b]: Boost your chances of finding rare treasures and redefine your exploration strategies.

    [b]New Global Legendaries[/b]: The all-new Sendatu's Fury and Sendatu's Grace add new support and damage options for Bladecrest users.

    [b]Talent Transformations[/b]: Multiple talent trees have undergone major talent changes, both new and refined, to offer diverse choices and challenges.

    [b]Immersive Enhancements[/b]: With improved lighting, new skill icons, new sound FX, and more, I've aimed to make the environment even more engaging.

    [b]Fixes, Tweaks & More[/b]: Numerous bugs have been addressed to further improve the overall gaming experience.

[h1]Why the Price Increase?[/h1]

This update, a product of countless hours of work and passion, showcases many additions and improvements. In light of the expanded content and features, I believe it’s time to adjust the price to better reflect the game's value. The price will increase to $20 next week when the update goes live.

[h1]Let's Connect[/h1]

Make sure to join the [url=https://discord.gg/u5yq67Z]Discord[/url]! Your feedback drives this game's evolution. 

[h1]A Sincere Thank You[/h1]

It's thanks to each of you that I'm motivated to push the boundaries of game development. My hope is that you'll relish the content of The Frontiers Update as much as I've enjoyed crafting it for you. Lots more updates to come.

Warm regards,

Aeromir

notes.title: Efficiency Rework, Aspect of the Wolf Rework, Absolution Reward
notes.content:
[h1]NEW[/h1]
Quests that require completing Avatar's Reach now reward an Absolution on completion in all difficulties.

Added a skill preview to the character creation menu.

[h1]BALANCE[/h1]
[h2]STATS[/h2]
[h3]Resource Efficiency Rework[/h3]
[list]
[*] Lower Mana Cost is now Mana Efficiency
[*] Lower Stamina Cost is now Stamina Efficiency
[*] Scaling for these mods has been decreased to 5.5 at level 30, down from 7.
[*] Mana Efficiency and Stamina Efficiency lower the cost of skills, with diminishing returns.
[/list]

Formula: Final Resouce Cost = Base Cost / (1 + (Total Efficiency / 100))

[i]Dev Note: Efficiency points on the talent tree are now stronger than before and provide a strong baseline for characters wanting more access to expensive abilities. Previously, 10 points into either Lower Mana Cost or Lower Stamina Cost would net 10% lower cost of abilities. Now those 10 points get you 20 Efficiency, which is equivalent to 16.67% lower cost. Taking another 10 points for 40 Efficiency is equivalent to 28.57% lower cost. You can already see the diminishing returns kicking in a bit, but this is still much stronger than before. Efficiency hard caps at 100, which is equivalent to 50% lower cost, but this now takes significantly more investment to reach. There is now also a second source of Stamina Efficiency on the tree to match the two sources of Mana Efficiency.[/i]

[h2]TALENTS[/h2]
[h3]VERNDARI[/h3]
Bow Critical Damage passive has been removed.
Stamina Efficiency passive has been added.

[b]Aspect of the Wolf Rework[/b]
"On hit, manifest the Aspect of the Wolf for 5 seconds. Aspect of the Wolf gives your Hits a 30% chance to hit an additional time. After losing Aspect of the Wolf, you cannot gain it again for 5 seconds.

Bow passive talent bonuses also apply while a melee weapon is equipped. Melee passive bonuses also apply while a bow is equipped."

[i]Dev note: The second half of this talent is unchanged.[/i]

[h3]ORIAS[/h3]
[b]Adamantine [/b]- Damage Reduction: 20% -> 15%

[h3]SKILLS[/h3]
All lightning skills have had their resilience damage normalized. This was an increase for some skills and a decrease for others.

[b]Voltaic Thrust [/b]- Damage: 100% -> 175% combined melee weapon damage

[b]Serrated Dagger [/b]- Damage: 60% -> 85% combined weapon damage

[h1]FIXED[/h1]
Fixed Chain Lightning effects sometimes proccing on-hit effects when they shouldn't.

Potential Fix for traps causing crashes.

Fixed Volatile Patronage's effect not working with combined weapon damage.

notes.title: The Legendary Update
notes.content:
This update brings 103 new Legendaries to the game. All new legendaries will be listed here. After this section, it's all spoilers. Good hunting, knights! 












[h1]NEW LEGENDARIES - 103[/h1]
[h2]HELMETS - 14[/h2]
[b]Voice of Resonance [/b]- Gain the effects of Broad Influence.

[b]Visage of Death[/b] - Grants the Death Aura skill: Drains the life of you and enemies around you. Lose 5% of your maximum life each second to deal equal damage + 30% combined weapon damage to all enemies in aura range.

[b]Warlord's Helm [/b]- Shout skills granted by this helmet taunt nearby enemies and increase your Health Regeneration by 10 for 4 seconds.

[b]Thunderlord's Crown [/b]- Chain Lightning effects gain 1 additional chain.

[b]Verndari Scouting Mask [/b]- Hunter's Mark now also increases damage from all sources other than you at 50% effectiveness.

[b]Verndari Hunting Cowl [/b]- When the current target of your Hunter's Mark dies, Hunter's Mark jumps to a nearby target.

[b]Volatile Patronage [/b]- Each active Boon you grant on a target has a 10% chance each second to detonate the granted Nova skill at the target's location.

[b]Rite of Infernal Blood [/b]- Non-Pact Summons now take Ignite damage equal to 10% of their Max Health per second and deal 300% of the damage taken to nearby enemies.

[b]Tactician's Reign [/b]- Each stack of Aggravating Shout reduces the amount of damage you take by 2%.

[b]Devotion [/b]- Aura skills granted by this item cost no mana. You cannot use any other Aura skills.

[b]Conflagration [/b]- Enemies that die while affected by a Burn inflicted by you spread the Burn to nearby targets at 33% strength.

[b]Plaguebringer [/b]- Targets that die with at least 5 Poison stacks inflicted by you also inflict nearby enemies with 1 Poison stack for every 3 existing stacks.

[b]Rite of Demonic Transference [/b]- Your shouts also affect your minions outside shout range. Shouts affect your minions as if you have +75% Boon Intensity.

[b]Eyes of The Endless [/b]- Blood Rage will not damage you while you are below (25-50%) Max Health.

[h2]CHESTS - 12[/h2]
[b]Breakneck Vestments [/b]- Grants the Flurry of Blows skill.

[b]Radiant Vestments [/b]- Grants the Sun Soul Technique skill.

[b]Eternal Vestments [/b]- Grants the Calamitous Strike skill.

[b]Robe of Sacrifice [/b]- 20% of damage taken from hits is transferred to your Pact Minion. Transferred damage is increased by 100%.

[b]The Blood Cage [/b]- Lifesteal effects heal 30% faster. Health regained on hit reduced by 15%.

[b]Scorn [/b]- Grants the Rebuke skill.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/9133d0ab05b49d9516638e41a2b2bc7cb9d429ec.png[/img]
Rebuke
Passive: Hits against you have their damage stored, up to 30% of your combined Stamina and Health.

Activation: Rebuke nearby enemies with a vicious burst of light, dealing all stored damage to enemies in the area.

[b]Plate of the Mad Titan [/b]- Strength of Zabaoth is replaced with Mad Titan's Wrath while you are wielding a 2H Melee weapon.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/36f474030f74fd75b03f26ed6c556ac2c19a94c5.png[/img]
Mad Titan's Wrath
Manifest the strength of the Mad Titan. For 10 seconds, manifest a copy of your 2H Melee weapon in your off hand. Total Damage increased by 50%, Attack Speed increased by 50%, and you take 20% more damage.

[b]Robes of the Phoenix Lord [/b]- Grants the Ash Ritual skill.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/5e5f27a02774edbf95871a3d305adf6ee220c5ac.png[/img]
Ash Ritual
Passive: When you kill an enemy that is affected by your Burn or Ignite, grant 1 stack of Ash Ritual. Max 20 stacks.

Activation: Offer your own flesh and the ash of your enemies to the Phoenix Lord. Consume at least 10 Ash Ritual stacks to assume the Mantle of the Phoenix Lord for 0.5 seconds per stack. While Mantled, your Total Damage is increased by 25%, Attack Speed increased by 25%, your Hits Ignite for 10% of the damage dealt, and you lose 3% of your Max Health each second.

[b]The Festering [/b]- Grants the Festering Plague skill.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/03dba76c6bea0f6e42b8bce5e7949ae275dd2ba5.png[/img]
Festering Plague - For 5 seconds, all existing Poisons inflicted by you deal 20% more damage and deal 20% of their damage each tick to nearby targets.

[b]Blessed Aegis [/b]- Grants the Glorious Shout skill.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/c72d08cd04ae0e2ca5a043469606dae1f81c5cca.png[/img]
Glorious Shout - Shout and inspire nearby allies with Brutality, Lethality, Precision, Undying, and Haste for 6 seconds. Instant Cast.

[b]Earthwarden Vestments [/b]- Grants the Earthwarden Stance skill.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/30114d6d7ed3dca2c2f910042ef0c73060efe735.png[/img]
Earthwarden Stance - Smash the ground, dealing 150% unarmed damage to nearby targets and inflicting heavy Resilience Damage. Enter Earthwarden Stance for 6 seconds, increasing your Resilience Damage with Physical attacks by 50%, decreasing your damage taken by 30%, and doubling your threat generation. Your attack speed is reduced by 15% and you cannot benefit from lifesteal abilities. Only one Stance can be active at a time. Unarmed requirement cannot be bypassed.

[b]Battle Robes of the Magus [/b]- Grants the Arcane Weapon skill.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/5228680f7c76fa0b457d667aac90056989dc9653.png[/img]
Arcane Weapon - Envelope your melee weapons in arcane energy for 6 seconds. Melee Hits inflict 1 stack of Arcane Resonance. 3 stacks of Arcane Resonance cause the target to unleash the resonating arcane energy in a burst that deals 100% spell damage and applies 1 stack of Arcane Resonance to all nearby targets.

[h2]GLOVES - 11[/h2]
[b]Magefiend Grasp [/b]- 25% of your spell damage is stored. Your Minions' attacks deal double damage until the stored damage is expended.

[b]Hexsteel Gauntlets [/b]- Base damage of equipped melee weapons is also added to your Spells if it is not already.

[b]Verndari Firing Gloves [/b]- Granted skill always has Wildshot. No other skills can benefit from Wildshot. Resource costs of granted skill increased by 30%.

[b]Verndari Volley Grips [/b]- Wildshot now adds 4 projectiles to the granted skill.

[b]Stalwart Grips [/b]- You parry all attacks within the parry window. Parries reduce damage by an additional 5%.

[b]Blooddrinkers [/b]- Hits that inflict Bleed restore 5 health over 5 seconds.

[b]Firestarters [/b]- When a target reaches 75% Burn, they Superheat and take 150% Spell Damage per second for 3 seconds, consuming the Burn. Superheated targets cannot gain Burn.

[b]Light Gatherers [/b]- Gain 15% more Super Energy from Super Orbs.

[b]Ehtiran Interrogators [/b]- Physical Hits apply Spell Weakness for 6 seconds, causing targets to take 20% more damage from your Spells.

[b]Blackblood Handlers [/b]- Envenom inflicts 1 additional stack of Poison on Critical Hits, and 2 additional stacks of Poison on Supercritical Hits.

[b]Demolitionist Mitts [/b]- Traps deal 15% more damage and have 25% larger area.

[h2]BELTS - 12[/h2]
[b]Bladesash [/b]- You ignore weapon requirements for Fan of Knives.

[b]Boulder Fauld [/b]- You ignore weapon requirements for Rockfist Stance.

[b]Secrets of Summoning Vol. I [/b]- Gain the effects of Volatile Summoning. If you already have Volatile Summoning allocated, it deals double damage.

[b]Secrets of Summoning Vol. II [/b]- Gain the effects of Forbidden Knowledge.

[b]Flameband [/b]- Your Burn effects last 20% longer.

[b]Sash of the Mountain [/b]- (Max Health/Max Mana/Max Stamina) increased by (5-10%).

[b]Trapper's Tools [/b]- You ignore weapon requirements for Trap skills.

[b]Giant's Girdle [/b]- Max Resilience increased by 10%.

[b]Hidden Remedy [/b]- Gain the effects of High-Capacity Flask.

[b]Prolonging Agent [/b]- Your Utility Flask gains the Increased Duration Flask Effect.

[b]Charismatic Wrap [/b]- You ignore weapon requirements for the granted Aura skill.

[b]Berserker Sash [/b]- Melee Hits restore 5 Health over 5 seconds while you are affected by Blood Rage.

[h2]BOOTS - 12[/h2]
[b]Kindlestep [/b]- Triples the width of Flame Dash.

[b]Crippling Steeltoes [/b]- Shield Charge reduces enemy damage output by 15% for 5 seconds.

[b]Elessar Striders [/b]- Gain 2 charges of Ranger's Agility. Dodging will consume 1 charge if available to dodge as if you had the Dash talent. Regain 1 lost charge every 5 seconds.

[b]Boots of Dimensional Travel [/b]- Blink skills create a portal for 5 seconds that allies can use to blink to your destination location. Spatial Instability duration increased by 50%.

[b]Tectonic Step [/b]- Earthquake pulls in nearby enemies.

[b]Indomitable Greaves [/b]- Your movement speed cannot be changed. Mobility skills have 25% longer cooldowns.

[b]Ferocious Sabatons [/b]- After hitting with Ruthless Charge, gain Haste for 3 seconds, increasing your Attack Speed by 10%.

[b]Swiftsteps [/b]- Gain the effects of Elusive.

[b]Resolute Greaves [/b]- Duration of Crowd Control effects on you is reduced by 30%.

[b]Forceful Tramplers [/b]- Gain Brutality for 4 seconds when you hit an enemy with Leap Smash.

[b]Feeding Frenzy [/b]- Feast has 50% increased effect when used on targets below 50% health.

[b]Subjugation Garb [/b]- Summons deal 50% increased damage with their first attack.

[h2]AMULETS - 5[/h2]
[b]Chain of Enchanting [/b]- Equipment drops from enemies are 50% more likely to be Enchanted.

[b]Chain of Renown [/b]- Equipment drops from enemies are 50% more likely to be Legendary.

[b]Chain of Wealth [/b]- Gold drops give 100% increased Gold.

[b]Chain of Crafting [/b]- Crafting Items drop 50% more often from enemies.

[b]Chain of Chance [/b]- Gamba drops give 50% increased Gamba.

[h2]RINGS - 6[/h2]
[b]Gambler's Ring [/b]- Gamba drops give 25% increased Gamba.

[b]Ring of Affluence [/b]- Gold drops give 50% increased Gold.

[b]Artisan's Ring [/b]- Crafting Items drop 25% more often from enemies.

[b]Circle of Influence [/b]- Equipment is 100% more likely to be influenced by this item's influence.

notes.title: Soulsplitter Buff, Fixes
notes.content:
[h1]BALANCE[/h1]

[h2]SKILLS[/h2]
[b]Fireball [/b]- Burn % now scales with charge amount.
[b]Flame Dash [/b]- Now inflicts 10% Burn per second. Tooltip updated for clarity.

[i]Dev Note: The tooltip for Flame Dash stated that it was dealing 40% damage per second and had no mention of Burn. What it was actually doing was attempting to inflict a flat 20% Burn (non-stacking) twice per second, so Flame Dash was dealing half of the intended damage and if a target already had a higher % Burn, Flame Dash was completely ineffective. This change allows Flame Dash to build on existing Burns as originally intended.[/i]

[h2]TALENTS[/h2]
[b]Ehtiras - Soulsplitter[/b]: Now applies Greater Spell Weakness, causing targets to take 40% more damage from your spells, up from 25%.

[b]Spell Weakness[/b] damage bonus: 25% -> 20%

[list]
[*] Fixed Tier 2 and 3 Enfeeble Enchants applying at Tier 1 strength.
[*] Fixed Construct Spidermine doing more damage than intended to targets through chain lightning.
[*] Fixed Tranquility not being removed in some situations.
[*] Fixed being able to maintain the effects of certain area buffs after leaving the area.
[/list]

notes.title: New Skill: Shield Minions, Overcharge Core Rework, Minion Buffs and Fixes
notes.content:
[h2]NEW SKILL[/h2]
[b]Shield Minions[/b]: Shield all of your minions. Reduces damage taken by 75% for 1.5 seconds. Casts instantly.
No Mana or Stamina Cost
Cooldown: 7s

This skill is available exclusively from the Skill Merchant and will not randomly roll on items.

[h2]TALENTS[/h2]
[b]Overcharge Core Rework [/b]
[list]
[*] Constructs explode on death, dealing base damage equal to 100% of their maximum health to nearby targets.
[*] Constructs that are already designed to explode on death add 100% of their maximum health in base damage to the explosion.
[/list]
[h2]BALANCE[/h2]
[b]All minions have had their damage increased by 10%.[/b]

[b]Spider Mines [/b]now Hit with their initial explosion.

[b]Summon Zombie Warrior [/b]- Pact Effect Attack Speed bonus: 10% -> 15%.

[b]Avatar of Lightning[/b]
[list]
[*] No longer deals increased damage based on remaining number of chains.
[*] No longer deals damage to the initial target.
[/list]
[b]Avatar of Fire [/b]- Ignite damage on Hit: 50% -> 30%

[b]Reave[/b]
[list]
[*] Mana Cost: 0 -> 100
[*] Stamina Cost: 125 -> 100
[/list]

[h2]ENEMIES[/h2]
Doubled the amount of gold dropped by all Goblin enemies.

[h2]RAID[/h2]
Enemy health increased by 30%.
Wizard Ice Shard persistent damage reduced to 10% against minions.

[h2]FIXES[/h2]
Fixed [b]Summon Bear[/b]'s slam doing more damage than intended to some enemies.

Fixed Health Regen from Utility Flasks not applying to Pact Minions with [b]Mutual Mending[/b].

Fixed being unable to use Health Flasks at full health with [b]Mutual Mending[/b].

[b]Fixed some Spell Effects that were intended to stack, but were not stacking[/b]. This likely affected many effects, but most notably of these are Flask Effects with Regen. These should now stack effectively now as intended.

MISC
Added helpful tooltips to the Influence and Enchant crafting menus.
Small improvements to the Crafting Menu UI.

notes.title: Massive Update - Part 1: Balance
notes.content:
Go make some food, grab a drink, and enjoy the largest patch notes in Rune Knights history. Also make sure to read [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1101400/view/3407555623445962379]PART 2[/url] of the patch notes for Talent changes and other updates.

Quick note: Existing characters might look a bit weird due to the new customization system and models. Visit the Hairdresser just behind where you spawn in Town to update your character's appearance.

If you get lost in the sauce, come get some help in our Discord: https://discord.gg/AAN6TCsmnH

[h1]EQUIPMENT CHANGES[/h1]
[h2]NEW GEAR SLOTS - GLOVES AND BELT[/h2]
These 2 new gear slots both provide new skills, for a new total of 8. The action bar has been redesigned to show 5 keys at once, and pressing Ctrl (your Modifier key is configurable in Hotkey settings, and you can change between hold and toggle behavior in Gameplay settings) switches your Q, E, and R skills to your 6th, 7th, and 8th skills. All skills can be moved freely with drag and drop.

Gloves roll double strength offensive implicits.

[h2]ENCHANTS[/h2]
Enchants imbue an armor piece with special effects. Enchants cannot be applied to Legendary items, jewelry, or belts.

[b]Weapon Enchants [/b]- For Physical Weapons and Shields. You can buy Level 1 Enchants for 1H Weapons and up to Level 2 Enchants for 2H Weapons from Binder.

[list]
[*] [b]Fire [/b]- Physical Hits Ignite for X% of the damage inflicted
[*] [b]Ice [/b]- Physical Hits apply a X% Chill for 3 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times.
[*] [b]Lightning [/b]- Physical Hits have a 30% chance to chain lightning to 2 additional targets for X% of the damage.
[*] [b]Blood [/b]- Physical Hits restore X Health over 5 seconds.
[*] [b]Enfeeble [/b]- Physical Hits reduce the target's damage by X% for 3 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times.
[*] [b]Sunder [/b]- Physical Hits increase damage taken by the target by X% for 3 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times.
[*] [b]Serrated [/b]- Physical Hits Bleed for X% of the damage inflicted.
[*] [b]Toxic [/b]- Physical Hits apply X stack(s) of Poison.
[/list]

[b]Skill Enchants [/b]- For Armor (excluding belts and jewelry) and Caster Weapons. These enchants affect the skill granted by the item. Can buy level 2 Enchants for Staffs and Level 1 Enchants for Focuses and Armor from Binder. 

[list]
[*] [b]Increased Area [/b]- Increases the size of non-aura area effects of this skill by X%.
[*] [b]Reduced Cooldown [/b]- Reduces the cooldown of this skill by X%.
[*] [b]Reduced Resource Cost [/b]- Reduces resource costs of this skill by X%.
[*] [b]Increased Duration [/b]- Increases the duration of the effect of this skill by X%. (Note: Poison's duration cannot be increased.)
[/list]

Enchanted Gear can drop from bosses, and these dropped enchants are significantly stronger than those craftable at Binder.

[h2]ORDER INFLUENCE[/h2]
Items can drop with influence from one of the world's Knight Orders. Items with these influences roll mods under the order's influence more often than normal, can roll implicit and explicit mods that are normally impossible to roll, and roll mods affected by the influence one tier higher than normal, however, mods that are not under the order's influence are rolled one tier lower.

Influence can also be added to equipment with a new item called a [b]Sphere of Influence[/b]. Binder can use a [b]Sphere of Influence [/b]to add the influence of any Knight Order to an item. [b]Spheres of Influence [/b]are available as a quest reward for all quests, and can drop from any boss.

[h2]FLASKS REWORK[/h2]
The original Flask has been split into 2 Flasks: [b]Health Flask [/b](Default: 1 or D-Pad Down) and [b]Utility Flask [/b](Default: 2 or D-Pad Up). [b]Health Flasks [/b]always heal for 30% of your Maximum Health. [b]Utility Flasks [/b]can be heavily customized with many different effects using Utility Flask Points. All level 1 characters start with 1 Utility Flask Point and gain an additional point at levels 10, 20, and 30. Visit Binder in Town to customize your Utility Flask. New drops will refill Health and Utility Flasks separately, and killing enemies will slowly refill both Flasks.

The "Flask Target" function has been removed.

Hotkey customizations may need to be reapplied.

[h1]NEW ENEMIES[/h1]
[h2]LOOT GOBLINS[/h2]
Each encounter on Invasion maps has a 10% chance to spawn a loot goblin. Loot goblins are cowardly hoarders who flee at the first sign of danger. Goblins will flee to other nearby encounters and spawn as many enemies as they can in their wake to protect themselves and their horde.

[b]Crafting Goblin [/b]- 10 Runestones, lots of crafting items
[b]Legendary Gear Goblin [/b]- 1 Legendary Gear Piece
[b]Enchanted Goblin [/b]- 2 Enchanted Gear Pieces
[b]Gamba Goblin [/b]- 5 Gamba Currency drops

[h2]GAMBLING[/h2]
A new merchant has come to town. The Gambler will allow you to exchange Gamba currency in exchange for a random item of your choice. Items from The Gambler can roll Influenced, Enchanted, Legendary, or with very high mod tiers. Regular equipment rules apply (Legendary items still cannot be enchanted).

[h2]SHRINES[/h2]
Each encounter on randomly generated maps has a 10% chance to spawn a Shrine. Shrines apply a powerful buff to all allies for 30 seconds when destroyed. 

[h1]25 NEW SKILLS[/h1]
[b]Blood Leshen Pact Summon [/b]- Summon a blood leshen to fight for you. Attacks from range. Hold Left Alt while casting to dismiss.
Pact Effect: You and all minions restore 10 Health over 5 seconds on Hit. Minion duration increased by 10%.
Requires a Staff or Focus equipped

[b]Summon Greater Spider [/b]- Summon a greater spider to fight for you. Cannot be pushed by enemies. Hold Left Alt while casting to dismiss.
Mana Cost: 500
Cooldown: 8s

[b]Summon Greater Zombie [/b]- Summon a greater zombie to fight for you. Cannot be pushed by enemies. Hold Left Alt while casting to dismiss.
Mana Cost: 500
Cooldown: 8s

[b]Bat Swarm [/b]- Summon a swarm of bats upon your foes, dealing 35% combined weapon damage to all targets in its path. Damage scales with Minion Damage instead of Bonus Damage.
Mana Cost: 40
Cooldown: 0.75s
Range: 1500
Requires a Staff or Focus equipped

[b]Fulfill Pact [/b]- Entangle with your Pact Minion and attempt to fulfill the pact between you. While Entangled and within 1000 range, you transfer 10% of your maximum health per second to your Pact Minion. Sustaining this transfer without interruption for 10 seconds fulfills the pact, granting your minion Pact Vigor. Pact Vigor increases Total Damage, Attack Speed, and Movement Speed by 30%. Pact Vigor lasts for 5 seconds after the transfer is stopped. Activate again to disentangle.
Requires a Staff or Focus equipped

[b]Necrosis [/b]- Cast necrotic energy that consumes your foes life. Deals 50% spell damage per second for 10 seconds.
Mana Cost: 150
Cooldown: 2s
Requires a Staff or Focus equipped

[b]Arcane Bolt [/b]- Cast a bolt of arcane energy that applies 1 stack of Arcane Resonance to the target for 6 seconds. 3 stacks of Arcane Resonance causes the target to unleash the resonating arcane energy in a burst that deals 100% spell damage and applies 1 stack of Arcane Resonance to all nearby targets.
Mana Cost: 70
Cooldown: 0.75s
Requires a Staff or Focus equipped

[b]Arcane Nova [/b]- Create an arcane nova around you which applies 2 stacks of Arcane Resonance to all targets for 6 seconds. 3 stacks of Arcane Resonance causes the target to unleash the resonating arcane energy in a burst that deals 100% spell damage and applies 1 stack of Arcane Resonance to all nearby targets.
Mana Cost: 250
Cooldown: 3s
Requires a Staff equipped

[b]Call Lightning [/b]- Call down lightning that deals 250% spell damage to a large area after a short delay.
Mana Cost: 200
Cooldown: 8s
Requires a Staff equipped

[b]Fire Quiver [/b]- Toggle. While active, all arrows are imbued with fire and inflict Burn on impact, dealing 15% combined weapon damage per second for 3 seconds. Burn stacks up to 75% combined weapon damage per second.
Mana Cost: 20 Mana per Arrow

[b]Lightning Quiver [/b]- Toggle. While active, all arrows are imbued with lightning and create chain lightning on impact, dealing 30% combined weapon damage to up to 2 additional targets.
Mana Cost: 35 Mana per Arrow

[b]Arcane Nova Arrow [/b]- Fires an arrow that explodes with arcane energy, dealing 150% weapon damage to all nearby targets.
Mana Cost: 150
Stamina Cost: 75
Cooldown: 8s

[b]Toxic Rain [/b]- Fire a marking arrow that calls down a hail of toxic arrows where it impacts, inflicting 2 stacks of Poison per second to all enemies in the area. Lasts for 3 seconds.
Mana Cost: 200
Stamina Cost: 150
Cooldown 10s

[b]Blight Arrow [/b]- Fires an arrow that inflicts a deadly blight on the target which deals damage over time. Deals 60% weapon damage damage per second for 10 seconds.
Mana Cost: 130
Stamina Cost: 130
Cooldown: 10s

[b]Hook Chain [/b]- Throw a chain and latch onto the first enemy hit, dealing 150% combined weapon damage. If the target is a Normal or Elite enemy, they are pulled to you. If the target is a Boss, you are pulled to them.
Stamina Cost: 75
Cooldown: 5s
Range: 2500

[b]Hallow Weapons [/b]- Call upon the divine to bless your weapons with overwhelming power. Melee attacks deal 50% more Resilience Damage for 6 seconds.
Mana Cost: 150
Cooldown: 10s
Requires a Sword, Axe, or Mace equipped.

[b]Arc Slash [/b]- Spin and deal 150% melee weapon damage to all nearby enemies.
Stamina Cost: 130
Cooldown: 2.5s
Requires a 1H Sword, Axe, or Mace equipped

[b]Poison Trap [/b]- Spawn a Poison Trap. On activation, applies 4 stacks of Poison to nearby targets and covers the area in toxic miasma for 7.5 seconds. Enemies within the miasma receive 1 additional stack of Poison per second. Max 1 Poison Trap. Trap becomes armed after 2 seconds. Hold Left Alt while casting to dismiss.
Mana Reservation Cost: 200
Cooldown: 5s
Requires a Focus or Staff equipped

[b]Emberlash Stance [/b]- Deliver a vicious uppercut, dealing 200% unarmed damage and igniting targets for the same damage over 5 seconds. Enter Emberlash Stance for 8 seconds, causing your melee hits to Ignite the target for 20% of the damage dealt over 5 seconds. Only one Stance can be active at a time.
Mana Cost: 100
Stamina Cost: 100
Cooldown: 4s
Only usable while Unarmed

[b]Viperfang Stance [/b]- Quickly dash forward and strike an enemy. Deals 100% unarmed damage and inflicts 5 stacks of Poison. Enter Viperfang Stance for 6 seconds, causing your melee hits to inflict 1 stack of Poison. Can interrupt current action. Only one Stance can be active at a time.
Mana Cost: 100
Stamina Cost: 100
Cooldown: 4s
Only usable while Unarmed

[b]Rockfist Stance [/b]- Smash the ground, dealing 100% unarmed damage to nearby targets and inflicting heavy Resilience Damage. Enter Rockfist Stance for 6 seconds, increasing your Resilience Damage by 30% and decreasing your damage taken by 15%. Only one Stance can be active at a time.
Mana Cost: 100
Stamina Cost: 100
Cooldown: 4s
Only usable while Unarmed

[b]Thunderstrike Stance [/b]- Strike a target for 125% unarmed damage and create chain lightning that deals 65% unarmed damage to up to 4 additional targets. Enter Thunderstrike Stance for 6 seconds, causing your melee hits to create chain lightning for 30% of the inflicted damage to up to 2 additional targets. Only one Stance can be active at a time.
Mana Cost: 100
Stamina Cost: 100
Cooldown: 4s
Only usable while Unarmed

[b]Snowstorm Stance [/b]- Slam the ground with a savage rush of cold, dealing 75% unarmed damage to nearby targets and Chilling them 20% for 3 seconds. Enter Snowstorm Stance for 8 seconds, causing your melee hits to inflict a stacking 5% Chill on the target for 2 seconds. Chill stacks up to 5 times. Only one Stance can be active at a time.
Mana Cost: 100
Stamina Cost: 100
Cooldown: 4s
Only usable while Unarmed

[b]Phase Shift [/b]- Phase violently between dimensions, dealing 100% combined weapon damage to nearby targets. You gain Phased, causing you to ignore enemy collision and increase your movement speed by 50% for 1.5 seconds. When you lose Phased, you deal damage again.
Mana Cost: 125
Cooldown: 6s

[b]Bestow Favor [/b]- Cast an orb that bestows all the effects of your Utility Flask to all allied players in an area on impact. Consumes 1 Utility Flask use.
Mana Cost: 75
Cooldown: 1s
Requires a Staff or Focus equipped

[h2]NEW LEGENDARIES[/h2]
10 New Legendaries added to the global drop pool

[h2]CHARACTER CUSTOMIZATION[/h2]
A new merchant has come to town. The Hairdresser will allow you to change your character's appearance for free.

Characters now have many more customization options.

Gear now comes in many new styles.

[h2]MINIMAP UPGRADE[/h2]
Fog of war has been added.
Pressing Tab (default) will toggle a large minimap showing the whole area you've explored.

[h2]EQUIPMENT LOCKING[/h2]
Ctrl + Shift click to toggle equipment's lock state. While locked, it cannot be affected by crafting items, offered for trade, sold, or broken.

[h1]BALANCE[/h1]
[h2]RESISTANCE REWORK[/h2]
Enemies now have natural resistance penetration equal to their level, and enemy damage has been rebalanced around net 0 resistance. Resistance mods now grant 0.3% resistance per mod level.

[b]Dev comment[/b]: In easy terms, this means that if you have 30% resistance, level 30 enemies will hit you for exactly the intended amount. 20% resistance against level 30 enemies will cause their damage to you to be increased by 10%, and 40% resistance against the same enemies will decrease their damage to you by 10%. This solves a few issues: Glass cannon builds are now more viable, as 0% resistance against level 30 enemies creates a 30% increase in their damage to you (the previous system would punish this with a 300% increase in damage). It's no longer possible for a single resistance mod to overcap you and feel like a portion of the mod is wasted. Tank builds now have more room for expression in their stats instead of being limited to the same 75% cap that most other builds were required to meet.

[h2]STATS OVERHAUL[/h2]
[b]Enhancement has been removed. [/b]
Mods now roll in tiers, which provide a bonus or penalty to mod level. Gear dropped by stronger enemies is more likely to have higher tier mods. High tier mods can also roll via crafting items, but the chance is far less likely. New crafting items have been added which increase the likelihood of high tier mods.

[b]Existing mods on gear will be reset to the gear's level (max 30).[/b]

[h2]NEW CRAFTING ITEMS[/h2]
Favored Crafting Items - Favored versions of existing crafting items function similarly to their non-favored counterparts, but with massively increased chances for exceptional outcomes.
[list]
[*] [b]Favored Runestone[/b]
[*] [b]Favored Fool's Gamble[/b]
[*] [b]Divine Will has been renamed to Favored Twist of Fate[/b]
[*] [b]Favored Crescendo[/b]
[/list]
These drop exclusively from boss-type enemies. Chance to drop is increased massively in Captain (50% increase) and Commander (100% increase) difficulties.

[b]Course Correction Rework [/b]- Shuffles mod tiers among existing stats. Randomly lowers the tier of a single mod by 1.
[b]Course Correction [/b]can now be purchased from the Merchant in Town (again).

[h2]BOWS[/h2]
Removed the 2 variations of bows (high damage/slow attack speed variant and low damage/high attack speed variant) and replaced them with a single improved version.

[h2]SHIELDS[/h2]
Max Shield Block % now increases with Equipment Level. 18% max at level 1, 35% max at level 30.
Shield implicits now roll naturally at double strength. Modifying the implicit with crafting items will reset it to normal values.

[h2]MODS[/h2]
Boot implicit mods no longer roll at double strength. Movement Speed mod scaling has been increased to compensate.

[b]Health Regen, Lower Mana Cost, Lower Stamina Cost, and Minion Health are no longer available without influence.[/b]

Health Regen can now only roll as an implicit mod. [b]Existing Health Regen explicit mods will be randomly rerolled.[/b]

Cooldown Reduction scaling reduced by roughly 50%.

[h2]ITEMS[/h2]
[b]Swarmcaller Rework [/b]- Applies Horde to Summon Spider when granted by this item.
[b]Viscera Rework [/b]- Melee hits restore 7.5 Health over 5 seconds. Lifesteal effects heal 10% faster.
[b]Decimator Rework [/b]- Sunder now causes targets to take 10% increased damage from all sources. Maximum Sunder stacks becomes 1.
[b]Spire of Teurok [/b]- Proc chance reduced from 50% to 40%. Additional projectile damage reduced from 50% to 40%.
[b]Stormblade [/b]- Chain lightning effect now chains 2 times, down from 4. Dual wielding now increases chance to proc Godcaller to 40%, down from 60%.
[b]Hellfire Sanctuary [/b]- Shield now blocks 50% of damage from the next hit.
[b]Meteor Forge Rework [/b]- Ignites nearby targets for 35% weapon damage per second for 3 seconds.
[b]Song of Fire [/b]- Casting Firebolt causes your next Frostbolt within 1 second to explode and Burn nearby enemies for 10% spell damage per second for 2.5 seconds.
[b]Song of Ice [/b]- Casting Frostbolt causes your next Firebolt within 1 second to burst with cold, Chilling nearby enemies for 10% for 1 second.
[b]The Ordained [/b]- Renamed to [b]Tempest Oath[/b]. Blessed effect removed.

[b]Penance [/b]- Price reduced from 200 to 150 gold.
[b]Absolution [/b]- Price reduced from 6000 to 4000 gold.

[h2]ENEMIES[/h2]
[b]Summoner Elite [/b]enemy: Summons now disapparate after making an attack.

[h2]SKILLS[/h2]
[b]Using skills now disables dodging until the cast completes.[/b]

[b]Default Melee Attacks [/b]- Tapping now initiates light attacks that can be used while moving. Holding now initiates a heavy attack combo that deals increased damage and resilience damage, especially on the last hit of the combo. During this combo, you are more vulnerable, and receive 50% increased Resilience Damage. 1-hand melee, 2-hand melee, dual wielding, shield melee, and unarmed melee all have access to both light and heavy attacks. Heavy attack damage bonuses also apply to projectiles from Bladecrest and the Wrath of Ehtiras super.

Summon Skills - Holding Left Alt while casting will now dismiss all minions of that type. (Previously Left Ctrl)

[b]Pact Warrior Minions[/b]
[list]
[*] Mana cost removed.
[*] Now cost 1 Health Flask use to summon.
[*] Can now be targeted with Entanglements.
[/list]

[b]Non-Pact Warrior Minions[/b]
[list]
[*] No longer reserve mana.
[*] No longer have a max summon amount.
[*] Now last for a base duration of 5 seconds.
[*] Now have a cooldown of 8 seconds.
[*] Nearly all minions have had their health increased by between 250-300%, damage increased by 50-100%, movement speed increased by 25%, and mana cost increased by 50-100%.
[/list]

[b]Vanguard Mech [/b]Pact Effect: Now reduces damage taken by 10%.
[b]Power Mech [/b]Pact Effect: Now increases Total Damage by 10%.

[b]Construct Spidermine[/b]: Construction speed doubled.
[b]Construct Turret[/b]: Construction speed doubled. Attack speed significantly increased.

[b]Bloodthief Rework [/b]- For 6 seconds, Hits restore 10 Health over 5 seconds.
Mana Cost: 100 -> 150
Cooldown: 2.0 -> 8.0

[h2]BOONS[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]All Boons have had their base bonus values reduced by 30%.[/b]
[*] [b]All Boon skills have had their mana cost reduced by 30%.[/b]
[/list]

[b]Empowered [/b]- Renamed to [b]Brutality[/b]. All related skills have been renamed to match (Empowering Aura is now Brutality Aura, etc.)
[b]Quickened [/b]- Renamed to [b]Haste[/b].
[b]Undying Will [/b]- [b]No longer affects resistances or max resistances[/b]. Now reduces damage taken by a flat 10%. Boon Intensity Effectiveness reduced from 100% to 50%.

[h2]NEW BOONS[/h2]
[b]Precision [/b]- Critical Strike Chance increased by 15%. 100% Boon Intensity Effectiveness.
[b]Lethality [/b]- Critical Strike Damage increased by 15%. 100% Boon Intensity Effectiveness.

Shout, Aura, and Entanglement skills have been added for both of these new Boons.

[h2]BLINK SPELLS[/h2]
[list]
[*] Blink spells no longer put other Blink spells on a cooldown.
[*] All Blink spells now have: Gain 1 stack of Spatial Instability for 5 seconds. Spatial Instability increases the mana cost of Blink skills by 50% per stack and loses 1 stack every 5 seconds.
[/list]

[b]Blink[/b]: Mana Cost reduced from 125 to 100.

[b]Frostblink[/b]: Mana Cost reduced from 175 to 150. Damage reduced from 100% to 50% combined weapon damage.

[b]Thunder Step[/b]: Damage reduced from 200% to 100% combined weapon damage.

[b]Summon Bear[/b]
[list]
[*] Taunt cooldown increased from 10 to 15 seconds.
[*] Nova damage reduced by 50%.
[*] Damage reduction removed.
[/list]

[b]Explosive Arrow Rework[/b]
Renamed [b]Witchfire Arrow[/b]
Charge up to increase explosion radius and damage, up to 100% weapon damage. Deals heavy Resilience Damage and Ignites targets for up to 35% weapon damage per second for 6 seconds. Charge rate is affected by attack speed. Mana and Stamina Regeneration halted while channeling.
Max Mana Cost: 125
Max Stamina Cost: 125
Cooldown: 12s

[b]Seeker Barrage Rework[/b]
Fires an arrow that shatters into a hail of seeker arrows. Creates 1 seeker arrow for each enemy in range. Each arrow deals 100% weapon damage.
Mana Cost: 100
Stamina Cost: 100
Cooldown: 5s
(Tip: Try firing this one into the air instead of directly at your targets.)

[b]Barbaric Stomp Rework[/b]
Renamed Earthquake
Stomp the ground with brutal force, dealing 50% combined weapon damage to nearby targets and creating an earthquake for 8 seconds that deals 15% combined weapon damage per second. Deals heavy Resilience Damage.

[b]Ground Smash Rework[/b]
Charge up a powerful slam that deals up to 150% weapon damage and increases Resilience Damage taken by targets by 20% for 8 seconds. Damage and area scale with charge. Disables movement while charging.
Max Stamina Cost: 175
Cooldown: 12s

All Nova skills now share a new animation.

All Shout skills that apply Boons have had their mana cost increased from 100 to 150.

[b]Rapid Fire[/b]: Damage increased from 75% to 80% Weapon Damage. Stamina Cost increased from 30 to 40.

[b]Rain of Arrows[/b]: Damage per second decreased from 150% to 100% Weapon Damage. Stamina cost increased from 125 to 150.

[b]Concussive Arrow[/b]: Velocity increased by 50%.

[b]Ice Nova Arrow[/b]: Damage reduced from 125% to 75% weapon damage.

[b]Whirlwind[/b]: Damage per tick reduced from 140% to 65% combined weapon damage. Stamina cost per second increased from 150 to 175.

[b]Fireball[/b]: Impact damage reduced from 200% to 175% Weapon Damage when fully charged.

[b]Leap Smash[/b]: Stamina cost reduced from 150 to 130. Damage reduced from 200% to 75%. Now reduces damage taken by 15%.

[b]Block [/b]- No longer drains mana while wielding a focus. Players now receive Resilience Damage while blocking, but the amount is reduced by your shield's Block %.

[b]Bestow Mercy [/b]- Now affects all allied players in an area on impact. Shield now blocks 50% of damage from the next hit.

[b]Bestow Vitality [/b]- Now affects all allied players in an area on impact. No longer applies Flask Effects.

[b]Shield Slam [/b]- No longer affects resistances or max resistances. Now reduces damage taken by 10%.

[b]Rooting Arrow [/b]- Root duration decreased from 3.5 to 3 seconds.

[b]Frostbolt [/b]- Chill duration decreased from 2.5 to 2 seconds.

[b]Ice Storm [/b]- Chill amount reduced from 40% to 30%.

[b]Lightning Nova [/b]- Mana Cost increased from 125 to 150. Damage decreased from 125% to 75% spell damage.

[b]Flame Nova [/b]- Mana Cost increased from 100 to 150.

[b]Magic Missile [/b]- Improved homing behavior.

[b]Vicious Spin [/b]- Damage decreased from 300% to 200% combined weapon damage. Cooldown increased from 2 to 2.5 seconds. Stamina cost increased from 150 to 175. Bleed amount reduced from 100% to 25% of the damage dealt.

[b]Fan of Knives [/b]- Damage increased from 100% to 130% combined weapon damage. Stamina Cost increased from 125 to 150.

[b]Sinister Flare [/b]- Mana cost increased from 100 to 150.

[b]Backstab [/b]- Damage increased from 1000% to 1200% while behind target.

[b]Reave [/b]- Damage decreased from 300% to 250% primary weapon damage. Reave duration increased from 2 to 5 seconds. Cooldown increased from 4 to 8 seconds.

[b]Flame Slash [/b]- Ignite damage reduced from 100% to 75% per second. Mana and Stamina Costs increased from 100 to 125. Cooldown increased from 3 to 5 seconds.

[b]Blizzard [/b]- Chill amount reduced from 50% to 30%. Damage per second reduced from 125% to 50% Spell Damage. Max Mana Cost increased from 200 to 250.

[b]Spectral Claw [/b]- Damage reduced from 100% to 60% weapon damage.

[b]Thunderbolt [/b]- Mana Cost increased from 50 to 65.

[b]Shockwave [/b]- Stamina Cost increased from 100 to 150. Damage reduced from 150% to 125% combined weapon damage. Explosion radius reduced by 30%.

[b]Flurry [/b]- Damage per hit reduced from 75% to 65%.

[b]Flurry of Blows [/b]- Damage per hit reduced from 75% to 65%.

[b]Runic Serration [/b]- Mana cost increased from 100 to 125. Bleed amount decreased from 40% to 30%.

[b]Serrated Dagger [/b]- Initial damage increased from 50% to 60% combined weapon damage.

[b]Envenom [/b]- Mana cost increased from 125 to 150.

[b]Voltaic Thrust [/b]- Cooldown increased from 2 to 4 seconds. Max chains reduced from 4 to 3.

[b]Consecration [/b]- Damage per second reduced from 60% to 30% combined weapon damage.

[b]Frost Shield [/b]- Chill amount reduced from 25% to 20%. Chill duration reduced from 3 to 2 seconds.

[b]Ruthless Charge [/b]- Shield now blocks 50% of damage from the next hit. Shield duration increased from 1 to 2 seconds.

[b]Savage Strike [/b]- Damage reduced from 400% to 200% combined weapon damage.

[b]Calamitous Strike [/b]- Shield now blocks 50% of damage from the next hit.

[b]Mystic Arrow [/b]- Reduced Damage from 200% to 100% weapon damage. Reduced cooldown from 8 to 2 seconds. Reduced Mana Cost from 80 to 65. Increased Stamina Cost from 50 to 65. Added the Area Effect tag.

[b]Summon Zombie Warrior [/b]- Now heals via the Blood Pools mechanic instead of instantly. Heal amount reduced from 10% to 5% of Max Health on hit.

[b]Summon Zombie [/b]- Now heals via the Blood Pools mechanic instead of instantly. Heal amount reduced from 10% to 5% of Max Health on hit.

[b]Glorious Entanglement [/b]- Now also applies Lethality and Precision.

[b]Avatar of Ice [/b]- Chill amount reduced from 30% to 25%. Chill duration reduced from 3 to 2 seconds. Mana cost increased from 100 to 150.

[b]Avatar of Fire [/b]- Mana cost increased from 100 to 150.

[b]Avatar of Lightning [/b]- Mana cost increased from 100 to 150. Chains to 2 targets, down from 3.

[b]Destructive Wave [/b]- Damage reduced from 300% to 200% weapon damage. Mana Cost increased from 150 to 200. Fixed Destructive Wave dealing less resilience damage at low health instead of more as intended.

[b]Super: Wardship of Orias [/b]- Damage reduction increased from 30% to 40%.

[b]Super: Divine Arrow [/b]- Damage reduced from 1000% to 500% weapon damage.

[list]
[*] Flat % damage reduction cannot exceed 75%.
[*] Reduced the effect of Chill on Attack Speed.
[*] Crowd Control effects now receive duration adjustments based on level advantage. 2% increased duration for each level the caster is above the target. 2% reduced duration for each level the caster is below the target. 
[/list]

Blood Pool is now removed at full life.

[list]

[*] [b]Lesser Protection [/b](1 point): Receive 10% less damage for 4 seconds.
[*] [b]Protection [/b](2 points): Receive 20% less damage for 4 seconds.
[*] [b]Greater Protection [/b](3 points): Receive 30% less damage for 4 seconds.
[/list]

[list]
[*] [b]Lesser Vampire [/b](1 point): Your potions grant Lesser Vampire for 4 seconds, causing Hits to restore 10 Health over 5 seconds.
[*] [b]Vampire [/b](2 points): Your potions grant Vampire for 4 seconds, causing Hits to restore 20 Health over 5 seconds.
[*] [b]Greater Vampire [/b](3 points): Your potions grant Greater Vampire for 4 seconds, causing Hits to restore 30 Health over 5 seconds.
[/list]

[b]Mutual Mending [/b]Removed.

Hook Chain - Throw a chain and latch onto the first enemy hit, dealing 150% combined weapon damage.
Hallow Weapons - Call upon the divine to bless your weapons with overwhelming power.
Arc Slash - Spin and deal 150% melee weapon damage to all nearby enemies.
Poison Trap - Spawn a Poison Trap.
Emberlash Stance - Deliver a vicious uppercut, dealing 200% unarmed damage and igniting targets for the same damage over 5 seconds.

Gear now comes in many new styles.
Fog of war has been added.

Ctrl + Shift click to toggle equipment's lock state.

Lethality - Critical Strike Damage increased by 15%.

notes.title: Massive Update - Part 2: Talents and More Changes
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1101400/view/3365896692475968184]PATCH NOTES PART 1[/url]

[h1]TALENTS[/h1]
[h2]ZABAOTH[/h2]
[b]Berserker [/b]removed.
[b]Blood and Sweat [/b]removed.
[b]Warlord [/b]removed.
New T1 Talent - [b]Blood Frenzy[/b]: Attack Speed increased by 10% while you are recovering from a Lifesteal effect. 
New T1 Talent - [b]Voracious[/b]: Maximum health stored by Lifesteal effects increased by 20%.
New T2 Talent - [b]Eternal[/b]: Hits restore 5 Health over 5 seconds. Lifesteal is not removed at full health.
[b]Revenge Rework [/b]- Gain 1 stack of Revenge when hit by an enemy, increasing Total Damage by 3%. Max 5 stacks.
[b]Catastrophic Impacts [/b]- Size increase reduced from 30% to 15%.

[b]Hulking Rework[/b]
[list]
[*] Renamed Overwhelming
[*] Physical attacks deal 25% more Resilience Damage.
[/list]

[h2]CERRIDWEN[/h2]
[b]Volatile Minions Rework[/b]
[list]
[*] Renamed to Volatile Summoning
[*] Summons create an explosion on spawn that deals 35% of their attack damage to nearby targets.
[/list]

[b]Horde Rework[/b]
[list]
[*] Non-Pact Summon skills spawn 2 minions with 65% health and damage.
[*] Moved to T2.
[/list]

[b]Mutual Mending Rework[/b]: Using your Health and Utility Flasks also applies the effects to your Pact Minion.

[b]Symbiosis [/b]removed.
[b]Recruiter [/b]removed.
[b]Forbidden Knowledge [/b]moved to T1.
New T1 Talent - [b]Compelled Movement[/b]: Minions gain 15% increased movement speed.
New T2 Talent - [b]Chains of Domination[/b]: Minion duration increased by 10%.
New T2 Talent - [b]Swift Summoning[/b]: Reduces cooldown of minion skills by 15%.
New T2 Talent - [b]Master's Aura[/b]: Gain an aura that causes nearby minions to deal 25% more damage and take 15% less damage.

[h2]ASTAROTH[/h2]
[b]Salvager [/b]removed.
[b]Meticulous Animator [/b]removed.
[b]Trap Mechanic [/b]removed.
[b]Trap Specialist [/b]removed.

Received [b]Improved Flask [/b]from Sendatu tree.

New T2 Talent - [b]Rapid Delivery System[/b]: Using your Utility Flask also applies the effects to all nearby allies.
New T2 Talent - [b]Marshal[/b]: Melee Hits increase all Minion's Total Damage, Damage Resistance, and Movement Speed by 5% for 4 seconds. Stacks up to 4 times.
New T2 Talent - [b]Overcharge Core[/b]: Constructs explode on death, dealing 100% of their attack damage to nearby targets. Constructs that are already designed to explode on death gain 30% increased area of effect with their explosion.
[b]Super, Astaroth's Idol [/b]- Now applies Precision and Lethality in addition to its existing effects.

[b]Ingenuity [/b]- Now grants "You ignore weapon requirements for Construct skills." in addition to its existing effect.
[b]Armor Plating [/b]- Damage Reduction decreased from 25% to 10%. Movement Speed penalty removed.

[h2]EHTIRAS[/h2]
[b]Runeskin [/b]- Now grants 1% of Max Mana as Magic Resistance and 1% of Max Stamina as Physical Resistance.
[b]Mana Shield [/b]- Now stores 75% of mana spent (down from 100%). Shield now blocks 50% of Resilience Damage. Added a UI element to track remaining shield amount.
[b]Soulsplitter [/b]- Spell Weakness duration increased from 4 to 6 seconds.

[b]Mana Shield and Spellblade effects are now cleared on Meditation.[/b]

[h2]KIRKIRA[/h2]
[b]Cataclysmic Casting [/b]- Size increase reduced from 30% to 15%.

[b]Innate Magic Rework [/b]- You can use Spells which require a Focus. While wielding a Focus, you can use Spells which require a Staff.

[h2]VERNDARI[/h2]
Passive Cooldown bonus reduced from 2% to 1% per point.

[h2]VALKYRION[/h2]
[b]Diamond Soul [/b]removed.

New T2 Talent: [b]Chaos Fist [/b]- While Unarmed, your Hits have a 100% chance to apply a random enchantment.

Mystic - [b]Ki Stance [/b]skill renamed [b]Sun Soul Technique[/b].

[b]Brawler[/b]
[list]
[*] Now grants 0.3% All Resistance per level (down from 1.5%).
[*] Fixed the description stating it granted 5% Bonus Damage per level when it actually granted 2% per level.
[*] Now grants 3% Bonus Damage per level (up from 2%).
[/list]

[b]Monk[/b]
[list]
[*] Now grants 0.5 Stamina Regen per level (down from 0.7).
[*] Now grants 1% Critical Strike Chance per level (up from 0.5%).
[/list]

[h2]ALCAEUS[/h2]
Alcaeus Super, [b]Fury of Alcaeus[/b], has been replaced with a new Super: 
[b]Blackflame Assassin [/b]- For 10 seconds, Hits apply Blackflame and your dodge becomes a Shadow Dash that does not halt stamina regen and can be used while attacking. Blackflame lasts for 5 seconds and deals 20% Combined Weapon Damage per second per stack, stacks up to 20 times.

[b]Eviscerator[/b]: Now grants 2H swords or axes a 15% proc chance. Now works with bows while you have Aspect of the Wolf.

[h2]SENDATU[/h2]
New T1 Talent: [b]High-Capacity Flask [/b]- Max Health Flask uses becomes 4.

[b]Improved Flask[/b]
[list]
[*] No longer applies Increased Duration to your Flask.
[*] Moved to Astaroth T1.
[/list]

[b]Gift of Wisdom[/b]
[list]
[*] Now adds 20% Boon Intensity, in addition to its existing effect.
[*] Moved to T2.
[/list]

[b]Talented Healer Rework[/b]
Using your Health Flask also heals all nearby allies for 20% of their Maximum Health.

[h2]ORIAS[/h2]
[b]Weapons Training [/b]removed.
[b]Bulwark [/b]removed.
[b]Powerful Build [/b]- Moved to T1. Now adds 15% of Stamina as Health, down from 50%. No longer increases threat generation.
[b]Shield Boss [/b]- Moved to T2. Renamed Shield Spikes.

New T1 Talent - [b]Intimidating[/b]: Enemies taunted by you take 10% more damage from you.
New T2 Talent - [b]Reinforcement[/b]: Blocked hits inflict 50% less Resilience damage. Threat generation increased by 150%.

[h2]RAID[/h2]
Enemy health has been significantly decreased. 
Wizard - Number of crystals spawned when entering phase 2 now scales with Raid Difficulty level.

[b]Dev note [/b]- Raid has been an endurance mode that heavily favors defensive and self sustaining builds. This change pivots Raid from a stratospheric stat-check a "learn the mechanics and have at least a competent build" experience. These changes should make the Raid much more accessible for a variety of builds and solo play.

[h2]INFINITE ARENA[/h2]
A merchant will now spawn every 5 waves.
Infinite Arena will now show your current position on the leaderboards if you are outside the top 5.
[h1]UI[/h1]
The menu containing game information has been renamed "Compendium".
Compendium now has a Search function.

[h1]ANTI-CHEAT[/h1]
Anti-cheat has been modified to close the game when a cheat program is detected, instead of closing the detected program. A window will also be displayed showing the detected process.

[h1]MULTIPLAYER[/h1]
The previous main menu lobby functionality has been removed. This system was cool but presented a lot of bugs. It may return in the future.

You can now invite friends to your active game (or join a friend in an active game) with the Steam Friends interface.

[h1]MISC[/h1]
[list]
[*] Character's skills are now shown at the main menu.
[*] Players now spawn in Town with full Super Charge and Flasks.
[*] Mobility skills now have 90% reduced cooldown and no Mana or Stamina costs while out of combat.
[*] "Damage While Wielding a Focus" has been renamed "Focus Damage".
[*] "Damage While Wielding a Shield" has been renamed "Defender Damage".
[*] Phasing in has been removed.
[*] The previous influence crafting system has been removed.
[*] Dodging with the Sprint/Roll input now activates the roll on button release instead of button down. There is a 0.75 second window from button press to activate the dodge. The dedicated Dodge Roll input still activates dodge roll immediately on button down.
[*] Stats Overlay default hotkey changed to apostrophe.
[*] Photo Mode is now accessible from the pause menu.
[*] Toggle Mouse now only works outside of combat to ensure Left Alt functions properly for skills.
[*] Improved reliability of teleports.
[*] Players can now reset their invasion level from the World Map.
[*] Floating Damage Number Options - Players can now toggle Floating Damage Numbers on enemies and themselves in Gameplay Settings.
[*] Meditation regeneration speed increased.
[*] Added a reminder icon when you have unspent Flask Points.
[*] Aura Skill mana costs now update properly on tooltip.
[*] Multiple actions can now be bound to the same key.
[*] Resilience now starts regenerating when Meditation starts and regenerates faster while meditating. Minions also start Resilience regen on Meditation.
[*] Hotkeys are now searchable.
[*] New VFX for Flame Nova and Poison Nova.
[*] Skill Merchant now has a "Currently Usable" button which will only display skills you can use with your current equipment and talents.
[*] Your games can now be set to Offline, Friends, or Public mode.
[*] Added a "Hitstop Intensity" slider to the Gameplay settings menu to customize the amount of hitstop on melee attacks.
[/list]
[h1]New Icons[/h1]
[list]
[*] Vicious Spin
[*] Ruthless Charge
[*] Summon Demon Wolf
[*] Frost Shield
[*] Ice Storm
[*] Chilling Strike
[*] Ice Nova Arrow
[*] Super: Sendatu's Crown
[*] Magic Missile
[*] Explosive Arrow
[*] Fan of Knives
[*] Rain of Arrows
[*] Flash Dagger
[*] Bane Strike
[*] Blood Rage
[*] Meteor
[*] Venombolt
[*] All Boon Effects
[*] Aura Skills
[*] Shout Skills
[/list]
[h1]FIXES[/h1]
Bladecrest now works properly with Tranquility.

Fixed some filter combinations not working at the Skill Merchant.

Fixed a bug where many unintended sources of damage were dealing Resilience damage.

Fixed Troll Lord dealing twice the intended damage to targets in melee range during his shockwave attack.

Fixed Fan of Knives not working with Catastrophic Impacts.

Fixed some issues with player's Resilience bar visibility.

notes.title: Resilience Combat Update
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/RlOersn.gif[/img]

[h1]RESILIENCE[/h1]
The previous hitstun system has been removed and replaced with Resilience. All Hits also damage a target's Resilience. When Resilience reaches 0, the target becomes staggered for a moment and their Resilience resets to full. Tougher creatures have more Resilience. After 4 seconds without taking Resilience Damage, Resilience will quickly regenerate. Attacks blocked by a shield do not affect Resilience.

[i]Dev Note: If you're familiar with Dark Souls' Poise System, this is similar with the addition of Resilience meters being visible to the player.[/i]
[h2]ENEMY AND MINION RESILIENCE[/h2]
[list]
[*] Gain 10% increased Resilience per level
[*] Deal 1% more Resilience Damage with their attacks per level
[*] Enemies gain 50% Total Resilience per additional player in party
[/list]
[h2]RESILIENCE NOTES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Players have 100 Base Resilience.
[*] Player's base Resilience Damage is equal to 5% of their combined base weapon damage. While Dual Wielding, Base Resilience Damage is decreased by 25% (because it's a lot).
[*] Spells inflict much less Resilience Damage
[*] Lightning skills inflict more Resilience Damage
[*] Modifiers to Total Damage also increase Resilience Damage
[*] Modifiers to % Damage Reduction also decrease incoming Resilience Damage (Frost Shield, Adamantine, etc.)
[*] Blockbreakers now deal twice as much Resilience Damage as a normal attack.
[*] Crits increase Resilience Damage by 10%
[*] Supercrits increase Resilience Damage by 20%
[*] Training dummies now have 100 Base Resilience for testing
[*] Enemies that were immune to hitstun now have high Resilience instead.
[/list]
[h1]BALANCE[/h1]
[h2]STATS[/h2]
Hitstun Resistance no longer rolls on gear. Existing mods will be randomly rerolled.
[h2]SKILLS[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Block[/b] - Parries no longer hitstun the target. Instead, parries now reflect the attack's Resilience Damage back to the attacker.
[*] [b]Calamitous Strike [/b]- Charge up an explosive punch that launches you forward, deals up to 300% unarmed damage to enemies in an area and grants you a shield which will block the next attack if a target is hit. Damage and area scale with charge. Inflicts heavy Resilience Damage.
[*] [b]Poison Nova Arrow [/b]- Now applies 2 stacks of Poison, up from 1.
[*] [b]Magic Missile [/b]- Damage per missile reduced from 40% to 35% spell damage.
[*] [b]Dual Wield Standard Attack [/b]- Now deals 75% combined weapon damage, up from 50%.
[*] All skills which inflicted a guaranteed hitstun : Now deals heavy Resilience Damage instead of applying a guaranteed hitstun.
[/list]
[h2]TALENTS[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Balanced [/b]- Resilience Damage received is reduced by 10%.
[*] [b]Expertise [/b]- Your attacks deal 3 additional Resilience Damage.
[*] [b]Pressure Points [/b]- While Unarmed, Melee Hits deal additional Resilience Damage equal to 5% of your critical strike chance. Maximum 10 additional Resilience damage.
[*] [b]Sturdy [/b]- Max Health and Resilience increased by 25%.
[*] [b]Hulking [/b]- Gain 5% Bonus Damage for each 100 Max Health. Physical attacks deal 20% more Resilience Damage.
[*] [b]Alert [/b]- Resilience starts to regenerate 25% sooner and recovers 25% faster.
[/list]
[h1]FIXED[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed Kensai not working.
[*] Potential fix for aberrant target acquisition/threat behavior.
[/list]

notes.title: Supers Update
notes.content:
Supers are now granted automatically once you invest 10 points into a talent tree. The talents for these Supers have been removed from the talent tree and replaced with all new talents.

[h1]NEW TALENTS[/h1]
[list]
[*] Zabaoth T2 - [b]Berserker[/b]: Gain 1% Attack Speed per 2% of health missing.
[*] Alcaeus T2 - [b]Focused Impacts[/b]: Area effects from damaging skills that cost Stamina are 25% smaller and deal 30% more damage.
[*] Sendatu T2 - [b]Improved Flask[/b]: +1 Flask Point
[*] Cerridwen T2 - [b]Mutual Mending[/b] (unchanged): Your flasks also heal your minions for 20% of their maximum health.
[*] Orias T2 - [b]Bulwark[/b]: Max Physical Resistance increased to 80%.
[*] Valkyrion T2 - [b]Diamond Soul[/b]: Max Magic Resistance increased to 80%.
[*] Ehtiras T2 - [b]Soulsplitter[/b]: Melee hits apply Spell Weakness for 4 seconds. Spell Weakness causes targets to take 25% more damage from your spells.
[*] Kirkira T2 - [b]Spell Sniper[/b]: Projectile Spells gain 35% increased range.
[*] Kirkira T1 - [b]Shatterspell[/b]: Spell Hits that don't critically strike grant 1 stack of Shatterspell. Hits gain 10% Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage per stack of Shatterspell. All stacks are removed on Critical Strike.
[*] Verndari T1 - [b]Trapper[/b]: You ignore weapon requirements for Trap skills. Traps arm 50% faster.
[*] Astaroth T1 - [b]Quick Construction[/b]: 100% increased setup speed for Constructs.
[/list]
[h1]OTHER TALENT CHANGES[/h1]
[b]Mana Frenzy[/b]
[list]
[*] Moved to T2
[*] Chance to proc increased from 10% to 15%
[*] Stat bonus increased from 15% to 20%
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]Hunter's Mark[/b]: Moved to T2.
[*] [b]Salvager[/b]: Moved to T2.
[*] [b]Dash[/b]: Stamina cost penalty removed.
[*] [b]Dodge Warp[/b]: Removed.
[/list]
[h1]SUPERS[/h1]
[h2]OVERHAULS[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]New Verndari Super - Divine Arrow[/b]: Call down a Divine Arrow. After a short delay, deals 1000% combined weapon damage over a large area.
[*] [b]Wrath of Ehtiras[/b]: For 10 seconds, gain a shield equal to your combined Max Mana and Stamina. Melee Strikes release a wave of energy which deals 50% combined weapon damage to all targets. Damage from this wave counts as both Spell and Melee damage.
[/list]
[h2]SUPER CHANGES[/h2]
[list]

[h1]NEW[/h1]
[h2]Flask Customization Menu[/h2]
Visit Binder and select the Flask menu at the top of the crafting menu to access Flask customization options.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/adb4a21419d2cd9be035b138825a4c7ddd0b06b8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/951a7e801ba9b39aeea4d2c6051e8cbaea776083.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/4905db52fc33c3a7496e982ef8e05bd380c0deb3.png[/img]

Let's select some Flask Effects!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/faf49315137aa5e64d9f43f6289503d9661e0540.png[/img]

Here we can see our Flask Point meter filling up. This character is an archer, so we're going to rearrange some Flask Effects and grab Wildshot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/d9716ef4584df6e4679a52b28d1a4af6f3d54603.png[/img]

That's it! You can customize each character's Flask as much as you want at no cost. You can use the new Flask icon near your equipment loadout to view your Flask Effects at any time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/8cad6770bf595ccd3a539ebc81d159482a5e79b5.png[/img]

notes.title: Influence Crafting, Loot Improvement, Skill Buffs
notes.content:
Jump to [url=#balance]Balance[/url] 
[h1]NEW CRAFTING MENU[/h1]

Talking to Binder in Town will now open a crafting window which will allow you to quickly craft an item using items from your inventory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/2b59983b27a29545ff07f0924374ed8e3d4ceb6c.png[/img]

Here we've added a chest to start crafting

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/3faabb26c12cf9d8af48e5442fed66ac2b7cb5ab.png[/img]

By clicking on the Endeavor icon, we can immediately use an Endeavor from our inventory on this chest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/2eafddf6bff714685e91e29a03e069a32165ddf5.png[/img]

We can do the same with Fool's Gamble...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/c3bb4a9630578891cabbd28a9ba6f358d5dbf996.png[/img]

with Twist of Fate...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/e37dee14b45da9aaeeeac7ae40881b343b0a8e65.png[/img]

and with Runestones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/360298875a27f38addb8fd7485434b93dc94d1d5.png[/img]

Great! Now we've ruined this chest armor. Let's throw a few more mods on it and then click on the Influence button near the bottom of the crafting menu to switch to Influence Crafting.

[h1]INFLUENCE CRAFTING[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/8bf0cad32814a83631157d41530883821f34103f.png[/img]

So, what is Influence Crafting? Here's a look at Strength Influence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/c72c39b539fde9b0e7b41daca042d73894982db9.png[/img]

We can set a number of Runestone rolls using the "Rolls" selection next to the Influences. In this next example, I've set the number of rolls to 4. This means that 4 Runestones will be applied to our item, and if at any point during those rolls, we get a mod that matches the Strength Influence, that mod will overwrite the non-influence mod. If there is no Influence conflict (two mods either both match the Influence or neither do), the higher level mod will overwrite the lower one. Here's how our chest looks after 4 rolls with Strength Influence.

[b](Click on the influence stone to roll)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/d81676620e4ec69015647ff1ad9ed2147392d4c2.png[/img]

Some resistances and some damage, all mods that match Strength Influence. Notice that these mods are significantly lower level than what would be expected from normal crafting. As you increase the number of rolls, a higher Mod Penalty is applied to the final mods. Using more rolls also consumes Runestones equal to the number of rolls. Let's take a look at another Influence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/936b3b1314a8259e41d64abcc21b579c809f225e.png[/img]

Now let's try another 4 rolls with Dexterity Influence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/719da2d8ef6bce374f5848066157a3209230d96b.png[/img]

All according to plan so far. Let's look at the final Influence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/bd854580394f5550528c9cb2d0f72ff41b0a3cb5.png[/img]

And let's apply 4 rolls of Intelligence Influence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/3690b38985eddcca7a4121ce56866735a17bc9f9.png[/img]

It's important to note that Influence doesn't guarantee any particular kind of mod. We landed Critical Strike Chance here, which isn't part of the Intelligence Influence. This means that over all 4 rolls, no mods from the Intelligence Influence pool rolled in that slot, so the highest mod of the 4 rolls was kept here instead. Let's push up the number of rolls and see if we can get a fully Influenced chest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/7c35094b0c9f9d955f8297195dfe5078fe45e39d.png[/img]

There we go! Pushing the number of rolls up to 10 got us all the mods we wanted, but these mods took a heavy hit to their levels as a result. We could definitely craft something better by reducing the number of rolls and getting lucky, or using raw crafting materials later on.

[h1=balance]BALANCE[/h1]

notes.content:
[h1]NEW[/h1]
[b]New Minion Type - Pact Warrior[/b]: Pact Warriors apply special Pact Effects to you and your minions while active. Only 1 Pact Warrior can be active per player.

[b]New Minion Type - Construct[/b]: Constructs have different weapon requirements than Summons and are affected by different talents. Talents and skills that affect "Minions" affect both Summons and Constructs.

notes.title: Dual Wield Buffs, Permaslow Fix

Unarmed Base Damage increased to 30

Combined Melee Weapon Damage: Combines all equipped melee weapons to determine final damage. This includes unarmed.

These changes should help balance some melee skills that heavily favored two-handed weapons to be equally powerful while dual-wielding. These changes bring up damage while dual-wielding with these skills without affecting current 2H damage.

[*] Chilling Strike
[*] Lacerating Strike
[*] Savage Strike

Now deals 100% combined melee weapon damage (from 150% primary weapon damage).
Now chains to 4 targets (down from 5).
Chain damage reduced from 100% to 50% of the strike's damage.

FIXED
Fixed a bug where your character would become permaslowed on leveling up.

notes.title: Sendatu Tree Rework, Balance Changes, Fixes
notes.content:
[h1]BALANCE[/h1]
Unarmed base damage increased by 25.

[h2]SKILLS[/h2]
[list]
[*] Shout base range reduced from 800 to 750.
[*] Entangle base range reduced from 1500 to 1000.
[/list]
[b]Whirlwind[/b]
[list]
[*] Damage per tick increased from 100% to 115% combined weapon damage.
[*] Stamina cost decreased from 100 to 85 Stamina per second.
[/list]
[b]Flurry[/b]
[list]
[*] Damage per hit increased from 65% to 75%.
[*] Stamina cost decreased from 125 to 100.
[/list]
[b]Ruthless Charge[/b]: Can now interrupt current action.
[b]Serrated Dagger[/b]: Now usable while Unarmed.
[b]Bane Strike[/b]: No longer usable while Unarmed.
[h2]TALENTS[/h2]
[h3]SENDATU[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]New T1 Talent - Transmuter[/b]: Allies affected by any of your Boons also gain 5 Mana Regeneration. You and allies gain 25% more gold from gold pickups.
[*] [b]Alchemist Rework[/b]: Allies affected by any of your Boons also gain 5 Stamina Regeneration. Now grants 25% more flask charge from enemies and pickups (down from 50%). 
[*] [b]Medic Rework[/b]: When an ally is affected by any of your Boons, they also gain 5 Health Regeneration. Resurrection speed doubled.
[*] [b]Talented Healer Rework[/b]: Flask Target becomes an area heal that applies a potion to all nearby friendly targets except you. Applies all applicable potion effects from talents.
[*] [b]Benefactor[/b]: Damaging auras now tick 25% faster (down from 30%).
[*] [b]Broad Influence[/b]: Now increases range by 50% (down from 100%). Now also affects Entanglements.
[*] [b]Mystic Palm Technique[/b]: Removed.
[/list]
[h3]OTHERS[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Kirkira - Dodge Warp[/b]: Now increases stamina cost by 75 (up from 50).
[*] [b]Verndari - Dash[/b]: Now increases stamina cost by 30 (down from 40).
[/list]
[h1]IMPROVED[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a "Sell All" button to the sell popup dialogue box
[/list]
[h1]MISC[/h1]
Boots now roll natural Movement Speed implicits at double mod strength, but Movement Speed mod scaling has been reduced to maintain the same amount of Movement Speed. This matters for a soon to be added talent. Existing boots will have their mod levels automatically updated to the new values.
[h2]NEW ICONS[/h2]
[list]
[*] Leap Smash
[*] Barbaric Stomp (Leap Smash's old icon)
[*] Punch
[/list]
[h1]FIXED[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed Boon Intensity mods displaying incorrect values.
[*] Fixed Screenshake Intensity and HUD Bottom Bar Scale resetting their values upon exiting the options menu.
[*] Fixed being able to set unlimited traps in multiplayer.
[*] Fixed Enemy Upscaling not working.
[*] Fixed more issues with saves.
[/list]

notes.title: 4 New Elemental Aura Skills, Skill Preview
notes.content:
[h1]NEW[/h1]
[h2]4 New Elemental Aura Skills[/h2]

Elemental Auras are Spells and their damage benefits from Heightened Spell talents. They also benefit from the new effect added to Sendatu - Benefactor.

[b]Benefactor[/b]: Now also makes damaging auras tick 30% faster.

[b]Flame Aura[/b]: Gain an aura of flame that deals 75% spell damage per second to nearby enemies, and Burns them for 25% spell damage per second. Burn damage increases by 25% spell damage per second for each second enemies remain in the aura, up to 75% spell damage per second. Lasts until toggled off. Instant cast. Cooldown activates on aura deactivation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/ef561cdbf4db4c79af1c0fe7a7e9118514d01dfc.png[/img]

[b]Frost Aura[/b]: Gain an aura of frost that deals 50% spell damage per second to nearby enemies, and Chills them for 10% per second, up to 30% Chill. Lasts until toggled off. Instant cast. Cooldown activates on aura deactivation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/52f771db281d9fe3b4248278bd1a48e6f5f3f2d0.png[/img]

[b]Lightning Aura[/b]: Gain an aura of lightning that strikes all enemies that spend 1 second in your aura with lightning that deals 75% spell damage. If an enemy is struck 3 times in a row, the third strike deals double damage and creates chain lightning that strikes up to 2 additional targets for 50% of the damage. Lasts until toggled off. Instant cast. Cooldown activates on aura deactivation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/7805e00c04522531096b085f4afed638678a1355.png[/img]

[b]Toxic Aura[/b]: Gain a toxic aura that applies 3 stacks of Poison per second to all nearby enemies. Poison deals 10% Spell Damage per second per stack. Max 20 stacks. Poison lasts for 5 seconds. Lasts until toggled off. Instant cast. Cooldown activates on aura deactivation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/168160ef66ee93705ac03ecc8d5bc47b13e4e1b6.png[/img]

[h1]BALANCE[/h1]
[b]Electrified Trap[/b]
[list]
[*] Initial chain lightning damage increased from 50% to 100% Spell Damage.
[*] Max chains increased from 2 to 3.
[/list]
[h1]IMPROVED[/h1]
Skill Preview: Show Skill Information (Default: Left Ctrl) now shows skill icons on each piece of equipment in your inventory while held down.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/5ad5fd4755b5ea680d55746a4178ca8c61695880.png[/img]

Vicious Spin: New icon
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/b8b94593df464546d6c571e6a9985c401175f222.png[/img]

[h2]Scalable Raids[/h2]
Archives Exterior can now be run at 4 different levels of difficulty. notes.title: Loot Filter Update
notes.content:
[h1]New: Loot Filter[/h1]
Rune Knights now has a loot filter. Items that don't match the filter options you set will not be shown or looted while playing. Re-enabling filter options after items have spawned will reveal them and allow them to be looted. The Loot Filter menu can be accessed by the default keybinding "L", from the pop-out menu in the bottom left corner of the screen while in game, or from the radial menu (middle-mouse button or right thumbstick button), and can be rebound in the Input menu. Loot Filter settings are saved per character.

notes.title: Archer Overhaul
notes.content:
[h1]ITEMS[/h1]
Bows now roll a random Bow skill and can have this skill rerolled via crafting.

Meteor Forge: Fully charged arrows deal 25% increased damage and Ignite nearby targets for 30% weapon damage per second for 3 seconds.

[h1]TALENTS[/h1]
Movement Speed passives have been removed.
Cooldown Reduction passives reduced from 2.5% to 2% per point.

[h2]Verndari Tree Rework[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/376480c38a0a19a52361b134704b3c791199e304.png[/img]

Cooldown Reduction passive added.

[b]New Talent - Wildshot Elixir[/b]: Your potions grant Wildshot for 4 seconds, or for 6 seconds if at full health. Wildshot causes all projectiles to spawn 2 additional, identical projectiles in a spread.

Dev Note: This works with all projectiles, not just arrows. This also works with [url=https://runeknights.fandom.com/wiki/Spire_of_Teurok]Spire of Teurok[/url].

[b]New Talent - Dash[/b]: Your dodge becomes a quick dash. Does not interrupt abilities that allow you to move while channeling.

Dev Note: Dash maintains the same iframes as a normal dodge. This works with the standard bow attack, Explosive Arrow, Whirlwind, Fireball, Blizzard, Magic Missile, Dragonfire, Flame Slash, Ice Storm, etc.

[b]New Talent - Expertise[/b]: Your chance to hitstun is calculated as though you dealt 50% more damage.

Dev Note: [url=https://discord.com/channels/681789344171687943/806889665881440306/833161393926176807]Is Expertise Good?[/url]

[b]New Talent - Swift[/b]: Movement Speed increased by 30.

[b]New Talent - Aspect of the Eagle[/b]: Gain 15% Attack Speed and 15% Cooldown Reduction. Bow passive bonuses also apply to spells.

[b]New Talent - Hunter's Mark[/b]: Consecutive hits on a target apply 1 stack of Hunter's Mark. Max 10 stacks. Hunter's Mark causes the target to take 3% more damage from you per stack. Hitting another target removes the mark. Fully charged arrows apply 5 stacks of Hunter's Mark.

[b]New Talent - Aspect of the Wolf, Part 1[/b]: On hit, manifest an untargetable Spirit Wolf. Max 1 Spirit Wolf. Spirit Wolf attacks 5 times and then cannot be spawned for 5 seconds. The Spirit Wolf does not count as a minion, deals 40% combined weapon damage on hit, and deals damage as if it were you. Aggros to your Hunter's Mark target when applied.

[b]Aspect of the Wolf, Part 2[/b]: Bow passive bonuses also apply while a melee weapon is equipped. Melee passive bonuses also apply while a bow is equipped.

Dev Note: "Deals damage as if it were you" means that hits from the Spirit Wolf are the same as you hitting the target. If you have Envenom up, the wolf is also applying poison. Boons, buffs, on-hit effects, Legendary effects, etc. all apply. Effects that specifically require a melee or spell hit are not applied by the Wolf's hits. notes.title: New Content: Raids
notes.content:
[h1]NEW CONTENT: RAIDS[/h1]
[h2]Raid Wing Unlocked: Akashic Archives - Archives Exterior[/h2]

Players who have completed Act 2 on Commander difficulty will find a new tab available on the world map titled RAIDS. Raid content is balanced for 4-player endgame parties and does not scale down for smaller parties or solo play. Once combat has started, new allies will no longer be able to join. All equipment drops within the raid are Enhanced +3 items. 5 new Legendaries are available exclusively from this fight, and all legendaries not exclusive to other bosses can drop from this fight as well, and are guaranteed to be +3. The RK Discord can be used to help find and coordinate parties.

[url=https://discord.gg/u5yq67Z][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/8a421e69a08d3b85b3bc1d1ca968f8f16947991a.jpg[/img][/url]

[/list]

[/list]

[*] Fixed Summoner enemy's projectile not being blocked by the force field from Weapons Training.
[*] Fixed Ice Storm sometimes not spawning at the correct location
[/list]

notes.title: Host Migration Update
notes.content:
[h1]NEW[/h1]
[h2]Host Migration[/h2]
If the host in a multiplayer game crashes or loses connection, a new host will be selected (based on best connection) and the remaining party members will automatically attempt to rejoin the game, which will be recreated in a similar state.
