notes.title: Massive Melee Update - 5 New Skills, New Talents, Buffs, Improvements, and Fixes
notes.content:
[h1]NICE THINGS[/h1]
[list]
	[*]Completing Meditation now resets all cooldowns.[/*]
	[*]Meditation time to complete reduced from 5 to 4 seconds.[/*]
	[*]You can now link equipment in chat by Ctrl-Clicking it while in a party.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/e0e9a31c72bc404a60e05847c3368583141fc508.png[/img][/*]
[*]Added Ring and Amulet filters to Stash.[/*]
	[*]New Steam Achievements for completing Invasion Levels 50, 75, and 100[/*]
[/list]

[h1]STAMINA CHANGES[/h1]
[list]
	[*]Melee skills now cost Stamina instead of (or in addition to) Mana.[/*]
	[*]All melee skills that strike with a weapon (not a shield) now proc most effects that would proc on Standard Attacks.[/*]
	[*]Dodge Rolls can now be queued.[/*]
	[*]Max Stamina scaling from mods reduced from +3 to +2.5 per mod level[/*]
	[*]Base Stamina Regen reduced from 30 to 20[/*]
	[*][b]Stamina Regen scaling from mods increased from .15 to .25 per mod level, and base amount increased from 0 to 1 (Note: A level 30 mod now provides 8.5 regen, up from 4.5)[/b][/*]
	[*]Dodge Roll stamina cost reduced from 100 to 50[/*]
	[*]Talents which affect Dodge Roll stamina costs have had their values modified proportionally[/*]
	[*]Stamina Regeneration while blocking reduced from 50% to 33%[/*]
[/list]

[h1]SKILLS[/h1]
[h2]NEW SKILLS[/h2]
[list]
	[*]New 2H Melee Skill - Vicious Spin: Spin and deal 200% weapon damage to all nearby enemies. Swords will Bleed targets for the damage dealt over 5 seconds. Axes apply 1 stack of Sunder, causing targets to take 5% more damage from all sources (max 5 stacks). Maces knock back targets.[/*]
	[*]New 2H Melee Skill - Guard Stance: While channeled, 50% of damage is taken from stamina before health and stamina regeneration is slowed.[/*]
	[*]New 1H Melee Skill - Riposte: Use your weapons to parry an incoming attack. Successful parries also deal 150% combined weapon damage to the target. Damage received from parried attacks is reduced by 20% and taken from Stamina before Health.[/*]
	[*]New Melee Skill - Ruthless Charge: Quickly dash forward. On colliding with an enemy, attack for 100% combined weapon damage.[/*]
	[*]New Support Skill - Bestow Mercy: Cast an orb that bestows Mercy to an ally it hits, negating the next attack they receive within 2 seconds.[/*]
[/list]
[h2]CHANGED SKILLS[/h2]
Aggravating Shout Rework: Taunt nearby enemies for 6 seconds and gain 1 stack of Aggravating per target affected. Each stack of Aggravating increases Stamina Regeneration by 5 per second. Elite enemies generate 2 stacks, and Boss enemies generate 3 stacks.

[h3]FUNCTION CHANGES[/h3]
[list]
	[*]Runic Serration now Bleeds for 40% of each hit over 5 seconds (From 20% over 5 seconds).[/*]
	[*]Lacerating Strike now hits all targets in range.[/*]
	[*]Lacerating Strike now uses multiple animations.[/*]
	[*]Shockwave cooldown reduced from 8 to 4 seconds.[/*]
	[*]Shockwave now creates more distance between each AoE when used with the new talent, Catastrophic Impacts.[/*]
	[*]Leap Smash cooldown reduced from 3 to 2 seconds.[/*]
	[*]Quicken Shout and Quicken Aura now have a Boon Intensity Effectiveness of 50%. This means that 50% of Boon Intensity is applied.[/*]
[/list]
[h3]COST CHANGES[/h3]
[list]
[*]All Aura mana costs increased from 30 to 35 per second.[/*]
	[*]Backstab - Now costs 150 Stamina (From 130 Stamina) and requires a 1H Sword equipped[/*]
	[*]Whirlwind - Now costs 100 Stamina per second (From 60 Mana per second)[/*]
	[*]Rapid Fire - Stamina cost reduced from 50 to 25, and is affected by the new Mighty Warrior and Precision Fighter talents[/*]
	[*]Shield Slam - Stamina cost reduced from 100 to 75[/*]
	[*]Siphon Strike - Now costs 75 Mana and 75 Stamina (From 125 Mana)[/*]
	[*]Chilling Strike - Now costs 75 Mana and 75 Stamina (From 125 Mana)[/*]
	[*]Voltaic Thrust - Now costs 100 Mana and 100 Stamina (From 100 Mana)[/*]
	[*]Flash Dagger - Now costs 75 Mana and 75 Stamina (From 100 Mana)[/*]
	[*]Shield Throw - Now costs 75 Mana and 75 Stamina (From 100 Mana)[/*]
	[*]Calamitous Strike - Now costs 125 Stamina at max Charge (From 100 Mana)[/*]
	[*]Poison Nova Arrow - Now costs 75 Mana and 50 Stamina (From 125 Mana)[/*]
	[*]Rooting Arrow - Now costs 150 Mana and 50 Stamina (From 150 Mana)[/*]
	[*]Explosive Arrow - Now costs 125 Mana and 125 Stamina at max Charge (From 200 Mana)[/*]
	[*]Blink Arrow - Now costs 75 Mana and 50 Stamina (From 100 Mana)[/*]
	[*]Rain of Arrows - Now costs 75 Mana and 50 Stamina (From 125 Mana)[/*]
	[*]Ice Nova Arrow - Now costs 100 Mana and 50 Stamina (From 125 Mana)[/*]
	[*]Mystic Arrow - Now costs 100 Mana and 50 Stamina (From 100 Mana)[/*]
	[*]Seeker Barrage - Now costs 125 Mana and 50 Stamina (From 150 Mana)[/*]
[/list]
[h3]MISC. CHANGES[/h3]
[list]
	[*]New icon for Runic Serration.[/*]
	[*]New animations for Firebolt, Frostbolt, and Thunderbolt.[/*]
[/list]
[h1]TALENTS[/h1]
[h2]ZABAOTH[/h2]
[list]
	[*]New T1 Talent - Catastrophic Impacts: Area effects from damaging skills that cost stamina have a 30% larger area.[/*]
	[*]New T1 Talent - Blood and Sweat: Stamina costs reduced by 20%. You take damage equal to half of Stamina spent.[/*]
	[*]New T2 Talent - Mighty Warrior: Damaging skills that cost Stamina consume 25% more Stamina and deal 30% more damage.[/*]
	[*]New T2 Talent - Unstoppable: Receive 15% more damage. Become immune to hitstun.[/*]
	[*]Vampiric Potion moved to T1[/*]
	[*]Unwavering removed[/*]
	[*]Berserker removed[/*]
	[*]Intimidating removed (This effect will return in a new form)[/*]
	[*]Face of Death removed (This effect will return in a new form)[/*]
[/list]
[h2]ALCAEUS[/h2]
[list]
	[*]New T2 Talent - Precision Fighter: Damaging skills that cost Stamina consume 15% less Stamina and deal 15% more damage.[/*]
	[*]Relentless - Health and Stamina restored on kill increased from 30 to 40.[/*]
	[*]Stalker removed[/*]
[/list]
[h2]OTHER[/h2]
[list]
	[*]Heightened Spell and Greater Heightened Spell now only affect skills that cost mana, and increase only the mana cost on those skills.[/*]
	[*]Skills that have both a Mana Cost and Stamina Cost are affected by Mighty Warrior, Precision Fighter, and both Heightened Spell talents.[/*]
	[*]Spellsurge - Movement speed boost decreased from 100% to 50%[/*]
	[*]Inspiring Defense - Boon Intensity reduced from 100% to 75%[/*]
	[*]Telepathic Bond - Boon Intensity reduced from 100% to 75%[/*]
[/list]
[h2]PASSIVES[/h2]
[list]
	[*]All Critical Chance and Critical Damage passives changed to 2.5% per point (some were higher than this, some were lower)[/*]
	[*]All Attack Speed passives changes to 2.5% per point (some were higher than this, some were lower)[/*]
	[*]Cooldown Reduction passives increased from 2% to 2.5% per point[/*]
	[*]Max Stamina passives increased from 10 to 12.5 per point[/*]
	[*]All Resist passives increased from 2.5% to 3.5% per point[/*]
	[*]Magic Find passives reduced from 3% to 2% per point[/*]
	[*]Lower Mana Cost passives increased from 1% to 2% per point[/*]
	[*]Health Regeneration passives increased from 1 to 1.25 per point[/*]
	[*]Boon Intensity passives changed to 5% per point[/*]
[/list]

[h1]ITEMS[/h1]
[list]
	[*]The Ordained - Now doubles the damage of Consecration while you are within it, in addition to its existing effects.[/*]
[/list]

[h1]BALANCE[/h1]
[list]
	[*]Boon Intensity scaling reduced from 1% to 0.75% per mod level, base amount reduced from 4% to 3.25%[/*]
	[*]Increased the drop rate of Crescendos.[/*]
	[*]Slowed the attack speed of most enemies.[/*]
	[*]Reduced the amount of movement speed and attack speed granted to enemies by the Lightning Mage's buff.[/*]
	[*]Increased the animation speed of the player's second 2H melee attack animation.[/*]
[/list]

[h1]IMPROVED[/h1]
[list]
	[*]Player and Enemy Nameplates now scale by distance.[/*]
	[*]Ravager and Avatar bosses will no longer feint attacks.[/*]
	[*]Skill Merchant now lists skills alphabetically.[/*]
	[*]Potential performance improvements.[/*]
[/list]

[h1]FIXED[/h1]
[list]
	[*]Fixed Bow skills not being affected by Heightened Spell talents.[/*]
	[*]Fixed Whirlwind not dealing combined weapon damage while dual wielding melee weapons[/*]
	[*]Fixed a bug where non-existent mod slots would show on jewelry in the shop's buyback menu[/*]
	[*]Fixed Greater Heightened spell increasing mana costs by 30% instead of 25% as stated in the description[/*]
	[*]Fixed Shatter Nova not dealing double damage if enemies were affected by stacking Chill effects.[/*]
	[*]Fixed Mystic Arrow sometimes dealing no damage.[/*]
	[*]Fixed Act Bosses giving significantly more XP than intended.[/*]
	[*]Fixed a bug where Whirlwind would not cast after a Dodge Roll if its hotkey was held down.[/*]
	[*]Fixed Stamina Regeneration buffs from spell effects not being reflected in the stat readout.[/*]
	[*]Fixed characters being able to level beyond 30.[/*]
	[*]Fixed clients in multiplayer not seeing an accurate readout of Mana Shield remaining.[/*]
	[*]Fixed some bugs with Fireball's collision.[/*]
	[*]Fixed many VFX not playing in multiplayer.[/*]
	[*]Fixed Sinister Flare appearing to bounce instead of stick for players who did not cast it.[/*]
	[*]Fix for chat sticking open.[/*]
	[*]Fix for Stamina not regenerating smoothly while meditating.[/*]
	[*]Various UI fixes.[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: New Endgame: Invasions
notes.content:
Invasions - Beta
Once the campaign has been completed on Commander difficulty, a random map will be invaded by powerful monsters. This map will be purple on the World Map. These invasion enemies start at level 35. 

[list]
[*] If the invasion boss is defeated, enemies will give up invading that area, and send more powerful foes to invade a new area. These enemies will be 5 levels higher than the previous invasion. There is no enemy level cap for invasions. 
[*] If all players die during an invasion, enemies will take over that zone and, unimpressed by your resistance, send weaker enemies to invade another zone. These enemies will be 5 levels lower than the previous invasion, to a minimum of level 35.
[*] Invasion enemies have a higher chance to drop enhanced gear and legendaries, which increases further with their level. Invasion bosses drop especially valuable loot.
[*] Invasions are unique per player (not character), and hosts in multiplayer games will be able to bring allies into their invasion.
[*] Invasions are exclusive to Commander difficulty.
[*] If you have already completed the campaign on Commander difficulty, enemies will invade a random zone.
[/list]

Dev notes: This is the quickest functioning version of the system I could put together. Invasions will see significant changes to gameplay in the coming weeks.

BALANCE
Infinite Arena Wave Completion Rewards
[list]
[*] Base Bonus Magic Find increased by 2.5x
[*] Magic Find per wave completed increased by 5x
[/list]

Enemies above level 30 now have bonus magic find applied to their drops equal to 3% per level above 30.

Poison Novas now do an initial Hit of damage.

Fixed Act Bosses sometimes spawning with less health than intended

notes.title: 1-Month Patch Notes Compilation
notes.content:
NEW
New Item Types - Jewelry: Rings and Amulets
•Always drop Crescendo'd
•Always have 2 mods
•Both mods can roll any mod, even those only accessible via Twists of Fate
•Mods roll at 75% strength on Amulets and 37.5% strength on Rings
•Higher rarity drops = higher base mod level instead of more mods, as follows:
    White = -5
    Green = +0
    Blue = +5
    Purple = +10
•Legendary mods still roll +10 and are unaffected by the reduced mod strength effect
•Not sold by shop or available as a quest reward
•More rare than regular gear
•Higher rarities are more rare than on regular gear

Added a Skill Merchant to Town. All regular skills are available for 2,000 gold.

Added hitstop to melee attacks
Adjusted melee animations to compensate for hitstop (This may end up being a slight buff to all melee attack speed).

New Mod - Hitstun Resistance: Reduces your chance of being hitstunned. 
Note: This stacks multiplicatively with Unwavering (Unwavering + 50% Hitstun Resistance = 75% reduced chance to be hitstunned.)

Added a new keybinding "Show Skill Information" (default Left Ctrl), press this while inspecting an item or Dying Wish to show detailed information about the skill it contains.

Cerridwen: Potion of Recall replaced with Mutual Mending - Your potions also heal your minions for 20% of their maximum health.

BALANCE
Infinite Arena Drop Improvements
-Improved the chance of equipment dropping at higher enhancement levels in Infinite Arena. (In Commander, Boss waves will always spawn equipment that is at least +2. These items have a 3% chance per wave completed to instead spawn at +3, increased from 2% per wave completed.)
-Chance for legendary items to drop has been increased by 10% in Infinite Arena.

Increased the drop rate of equipment.

Minion Health can now roll naturally as an implicit mod on Staves and Foci, and on any gear with Twists of Fate.

2-Handed Melee weapons now have a bonus flat chance to inflict hitstun on any melee hit. (Swords - 10%, Axes - 15%, Maces - 20%).

Shield standard attacks now have a 10% bonus chance to inflict hitstun.

Arena/Infinite Arena: Increased the delay between spawns from 1.25 seconds to 1.5 seconds.

-TALENTS
[list]
[*] Zabaoth: Vampiric Potion - Bloodthief duration increased from 4 to 6 seconds.
[*] Ehtiras: Mana Vampire - Standard melee attacks replenish 2.5% of your maximum mana, doubled while wielding a focus.
[*] Ehtiras: Bottled Lightning now enables the use of potions while at full health.
[*] Wrath of Ehtiras - Increased duration from 5 to 6 seconds
[/list]

-SKILLS
Fixed many damaging skills which had their mana cost affected by Heightened Spell and Greater Heightened Spell, but not their damage.

[list]
[*] Magic Missile damage increased from 20% to 30% spell damage.
[*] Increased the maximum fire rate of Magic Missile and the effectiveness of CDR.
[*] Ice Storm radius is now affected by Cataclysmic Casting
[*] Death Aura now deals 30% combined weapon damage per second in addition to its regular damage.
[*] Consecration damage increased from 25% to 30% combined weapon damage per second.
[*] Whirlwind can now spend Spellblade.
[*] Fixed Undying Will not increasing max resists by the correct amount. This is a buff.
[/list]

-ITEMS
Viscera: Now increases the rate of healing over time from lifesteal effects by 20%, in addition to its regular effect. This effect can stack.

Reduced the price of Last Word from 5,000 to 1,500 gold.

IMPROVED
[list]
[*] Dying Wish now displays the skill icon of the stored skill. This makes shopping for new skills much easier!
[*] Improved humanoid ragdolls
[*] Updated Icons for Envenom, Innate Magic.
[*] Reduced the size of skill icons on the main HUD
[*] Improved filtering options for the Skill Merchant. Skills can now be filtered by weapon type required and by 1H or 2H.
[*] Improved the description of some summons to clarify that the summon takes reduced damage, not the player.
[*] Added a timer after spawn that should remove stubborn chat windows.
[*] New charge sounds for Calamitous Strike and Ground Smash
[/list]

FIXED
[list]
[*] Fixed Bloodthief not turning off once you've run out of mana
[*] Fixed some bugs with talent unlocks.
[*] Fixed Bladecrest remaining active while wearing incompatible equipment.
[*] Potential fix for Ravager boss facing the wrong target when using his Rock Throw ability
[*] Potential fix for clients seeing jittery movement in other players
[*] Fixed a bug where Ctrl + Click would not buy 5 of an item
[*] Fixed Ravager boss not playing a hitstun animation
[*] Fix for losing Legendary item effects after being resurrected.
[*] Fixed a bug with overlapping Boons. Now only the highest intensity boon of each type will be applied at a time.
[*] Fixed a bug with boons stacking from the same source
[*] Fixed supers not being added while playing in non-English languages
[*] Potential fix for talents not working while playing in non-English languages
[*] Fix for the World Map not updating enemy level values in non-English languages
[*] Fixed an issue with character name and save data
[*] Fixed an audio issue with the Zabaoth: Revenge talent
[*] Fixed Barbaric Stomp holding you afloat if you cast while in midair
[*] Fixed shop filters not working in non-English languages.
[*] Fixed an issue with Runic Serration SFX volume.
[*] Potential fix for SFX chaos when applying boons.
[*] Fixed Bloodthief gained from Vampiric Potion still draining mana for the caster
[*] Fixed Recruiter affecting Verndari wolf summons
[*] Fixed Verndari wolf summons dying instantly with Volatile Minions
[*] Fixed Death Aura draining Stored Mana which had not been activated for Mana Shield.
[*] Fixed Backstep Volley procing Venomwood's fully-charged effect
[*] Potential fix for enemy Summoner's minions spawning at level 1 in infinite arena
[*] Fixed skills which inflict hitstun not working for clients in multiplayer
[*] Fixed Death Aura remaining active without draining health or even being available to use
[*] Fixed a bug where running out of mana would disable Death Aura
[*] Fixed some bugs with talent point allocation
[*] Potential fix for Ravager boss leaping out of Arena maps
[*] Potential fix for resurrecting/healing after death
[*] Fixed minor bugs with tooltip comparisons.
[*] Fixed a bug which allowed unintended crafting of jewelry
[*] Fixed issues with overlapping taunts
[/list]

notes.title: Christmas Patch Notes Compilation
notes.content:
NEW
[list]
[*] Major performance improvements
[*] Non-scaling maps: Maps now have a set level (visible from the World Map), and will not scale to the player.
[*] New Skill: Envenom - For 6 seconds, all damage applies a stacking poison. Each stack of poison deals 10% combined weapon damage per second.
[*] New Skill: Shield Throw - Throw a mystic copy of your shield. Deals damage equal to 15 x your offhand shield's level and bounces to up to 2 additional targets. If no additional targets are found, damage is increased by 25% per remaining bounce. Damage inflicted counts as a spell if wielding a focus, or a melee hit otherwise.
[*] New Skill: Vanish - Become invisible for 5 seconds. You generate no threat and enemies will attack other targets if possible. Enemies near you may detect you.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Added "Screenshake Intensity" slider to the Gameplay menu in Options.
[*] Talents will now reset if your character has allocated a talent which has been removed from the tree.
[/list]

BALANCE
[list]
[*] Infinite Arena now scales with the highest level player instead of the average party level.
[*] Unstable Runes: Now only the player which spawned the rune may detonate it.
[*] Viscera Axe - Healing now takes place over 5 seconds instead of instantly.
[*] Your minions are now killed when you die.
[*] Increased arrow hitbox size by 30%.
[*] Last Word can now be used on Crescendo'd items.
[*] Enemies will now focus more on targets using Taunt.
[/list]

SKILLS
[list]
[*] Siphon Strike - Reduced heal amount from 100% to 30% of damage dealt.
[*] Siphon Strike - Increased mana cost from 100 to 125.
[*] Super: Wardship of Orias stamina regeneration increased from 15 to 30, max resist cap increased from 80% to 85%, now returns 100% of damage received to attackers.
[*] Dragonfire cooldown reduced from 8 seconds to 4 seconds.
[*] Undying Will now increases all maximum resistances by 1% per 50% Boon Intensity.
[*] Super: Strength of Zabaoth - Now increases total damage by 100%, reduces incoming damage by 20%, and grants immunity to hitstun. Bonus damage removed. This is a buff.
[*] Summon Demon Wolf is now affected by Recruiter.
[*] Summon Demon Wolf cooldown increased from 0.5 to 5 seconds.
[*] Summon Bear max summons reduced from 3 to 1.
[*] Frostblink damage increased from 50% to 100% spell damage. Radius increased by 50%.
[*] Thunderstep damage increased from 75% to 150% spell damage. Radius increased by 50%.
[/list]

TALENTS

[b]Fists of Ruin Overhaul[/b]
[list]
[*] Fists of Ruin now causes your melee attacks, while fully unarmed, to deal 30% damage in a small area around the target, and doubles Bonus Damage in addition to Crit Chance and Crit Damage.
[*] Increased base damage of unarmed strikes.
[*] Calamitous Strike - Now grants a shield that blocks 1 attack per each enemy hit. Lasts for 8 seconds. Reduced cooldown from 8 to 4 seconds. Reduced mana cost from 150 to 100.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Zabaoth: Replaced Iron Will with Intimidating - Your shouts reduce the damage of enemies in range by 10% for 5 seconds.
[*] Cerridwen: Replaced Frostflies with Telepathic Bond - Your shouts also affect your minions outside shout range.
[*] Cerridwen - Recruiter now only affects summon skills granted by your equipped weapons.
[*] Cerridwen - Swarmcaller has been removed and replaced with a new talent: Volatile Minions
[/list]
Volatile Minions: Summons that would exceed the max amount cause an existing summon of the same type to explode, dealing their attack damage + 10% of their current health to all nearby targets.

[list]
[*] Zabaoth: Heavy Hitter - Now gains 10% Bonus Damage per 150 Max Health, from 10% per 100 Health.
[*] Alcaeus: Swapped the positions of Fists of Ruin and Invigoration Potion
[*] Ehtiras: Swapped the positions of Heightened Spell and Bottled Lightning
[*] Kirkira: Swapped the positions of Greater Heightened Spell and Mana Potion
[*] Cerridwen: Swapped the positions of Recruiter and Infusion on the Cerridwen tree
[*] Cerridwen: Forbidden Knowledge now allows the use of Summon Troll Lord.
[*] Verndari: Sniper - Reduced damage bonus from 10% per 1 meter traveled to 2% per 1 meter traveled. Now caps at 50% increased damage.
[*] Kirkira: Dodge Warp - Reduced stamina cost increase from 20 to 10.

CHANGED
[list]
[*] Clarified the description on Runic Serration and Envenom to read "all hits" instead of "all damage".
[*] Summon Troll Lord now creates a portal as intended.
[*] Improved font handling for Japanese language.
[*] Reduced the volume of Death Aura by 50%.
[*] Ravager boss should have an easier time fitting through doors.
[/list]

FIXED
[list]
[*] Sessions not marked as Public will no longer show up in the Find Game menu.
[*] Fixed destructibles still making noise while SFX were muted.
[*] Fixed a bug where Boon Intensity was only working for the caster and host.
[*] Fixed Plague Knights not applying poison to clients.
[*] Fixed Broad Influence not applying Shout effects at double range, despite the shout visual becoming larger.
[*] Fixed shouts playing audio while volume was muted
[*] Fixed summons stutter-stepping
[*] Fixed Wrath of Ehtiras not working after being cast once
[*] Fixed Mana Frenzy not increasing mana regen, but still reducing mana regen after expiring, creating a scenario where Mana Frenzy would eventually stop mana regen completely.
[*] Fixed Lightning Orb not despawning for players who did not cast it
[*] Fixed a bug where rolling while blocking could disable Block completely.
[*] Fixed a bug with dragging and dropping
[*] Potential fix for enemies ignoring minions to get to players using Vanish in arena.
[*] Potential fix for Flame Slash bugs
[*] Fixed a bug where items could be destroyed after closing a trade window.
[*] Fixed merchants not working in non-English languages
[*] Fixed Firebolt's DoT effect not working when cast by clients.
[*] Actual fix for legendaries not working after being resurrected.
[*] Fixed a bug where instant-cast spells could be cast multiple times before going on cooldown.
[*] Fixed a bug where Lightning Orb would do more damage than intended on clients.
[*] Fixed a bug where the mana cost of charge-up skills would not update on the tooltip.
[*] Fixed loot crystals not showing the correct color on clients and sometimes spawning enemies only on the client.
[*] Fixed teleport sounds not playing on clients when teleporting minions.
[*] Fixed a bug where MTX wouldn't apply to shoes.
[*] Fixed some bugs with character equipment at the main menu.
[*] Fixed a bug where Avatar's Reach door would not open if a player was too far from the miniboss.
[*] Fixed some bugs with crafting items in stash.
[*] Potential fix for Ravager boss leaping constantly.
[*] Potential fix for enemies attacking you while dead.
[*] Fixed a bug where Kirkira's Resolve would not be removed from your Supers after removing the talent.
[*] Fixed a bug where legendary weapons would cease to work after being resurrected.
[*] Fixed a bug where knocking the Troll off the bridge to its death on Castle would not give you kill credit for the quest.
[/list]

notes.title: Localization Update and Patch Notes Compliation
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

[b]Rune Knights now supports French, Italian, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, and Simplified Chinese languages.[/b]

[h1]PATCH NOTES COMPILATION[/h1]

[h2]BALANCE[/h2]
Summoning Overhaul
[list]
[*] Added information about certain summons' damage resistance to their skill description.
[*] Reduced damage reduction on Summoned Bear and Demon Wolf, and increased health to compensate.
[*] Increased Demon Wolf's health scaling, final health increase at level 30 of about 13%.
[*] Capped summon damage resistance to 75%.
[*] Cerridwen: Symbiosis - You now receive 5% of damage taken by minions.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Reduced Thunderbolt damage from 75% to 65% spell damage.
[*] Decreased caps on Reduced Mana Cost and Cooldown Reduction from 75% to 50%.
[*] Reduced base CDR per mod from 5% to 3%, reduced scaling per level from .3% to .2%
[*] Blink Arrow now instantly teleports you upon reaching max range. Max height attainable is 500 units.
[*] Removed mana cost on Summon Troll Lord.
[*] Whirlwind now procs "melee attack" effects.
[*] Super: Wrath of Ehtiras damage increased to 100% combined weapon damage per second from 30%, now deals spell damage as intended to proc the Spellblade talent.
[*] Attack Speed gained from Zabaoth: Berserker doubled.
[*] Reduced the amount of enemies that can spawn per encounter on Forest, Icewastes, and Cave maps
[*] Spiders can no longer swarm a target with charge attacks
[*] Summoned Demon Wolf damage reduction increased from 20% to 30%
[*] Thunderbolt projectile speed increased by 30%
[*] Infinite Arena: Doubled the chance of wave completion rewards to roll an additional +1, and increased the quality of loot overall, including legendary drop chances
[*] Increased gold reward from all quests
[*] Added Staff/Focus requirements back to Cerridwen: Summon Troll Lord.
[*] Cerridwen: Swapped the positions of Potion of Recall and Infusion on the tree.
[*] Whirlwind no longer applies spell effects from Legendary items which require "Basic attacks".
[*] Removed 1 spider from the troll encounter in Act 1 Castle.
[*] Increased Summon Demon Wolf mana cost from 75 to 125.
[*] Magic Missile fire rate now affected by Cooldown Reduction.
[*] Flame Dash cooldown increased from 5 to 8 seconds.
[*] A target cannot be hitstunned by Flash Dagger more than once every 6 seconds. A particle effect will show while targets are immune.
[*] Heavy Knights have learned from their spider brethren and now respect the rules of dueling. Only one Heavy Knight can charge a player at a time.
[/list]

Summon Bear Rebalancing
Old values: Cooldown 8 seconds, mana cost 125, base health 300
New values: Cooldown 15 seconds, mana cost 150, base health 200

[h2]IMPROVED[/h2]
[list]
[*] All MTX can now be universally applied to gear, and applies the proper equipment model.
[*] Stash is now filterable, scrollable, and has more expansion available. (Filter functions can be very processor-intensive currently)
[*] Reduced the radius of Rampage's ground slam to more accurately reflect the damage area indicator.
[*] Clarified the effect of some legendary weapons to use the wording "Basic attacks".
[*] Skill icons for Supers now display in red if weapon requirements are not met.
[*] Clarified the weapon requirements for Supers in the talent description.
[*] Reduced the volume of the electricity buff placed on enemies.
[*] Merchant prompts now reappear after closing your inventory - no more moving back and forth to reactivate
[*] Minions now teleport to you on starting meditation.
[*] Updated models and materials of loot crystals.
[*] Added new cursor art to main menu.
[*] Clarified that Heightened Spell and Greater Heightened increase damage and mana cost of all damaging abilities.
[*] When you interrupt one of your abilities with a dodge roll, mana cost is refunded and cooldown is not incurred.
[*] Improved AI pathfinding on Avatar's Reach
[*] Minion and enemy AI and target acquisition improved.
[*] Summoned Bears are no longer able to be pushed by other units.
[*] Summoned Bear and Troll Lord taunts are now continuous and taunt much more reliably.
[*] Ravager boss can now be hitstunned as intended.
[*] Increased the time between Ravager leaps.
[*] Improved the timing and animation speed of 2 hand melee animations to better reflect expected DPS and attack speed values.
[*] Improved Taunt behavior
[*] Improved Feast behavior
[*] Pointer art updated.
[*] Updated icon for Face of Death
[*] Updated equipment slot art while empty.
[*] Characters that die while flying will now fall to earth.
[*] Added screen shake to Leap Smash.
[/list]

[h2]FIXED[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed tutorial bug
[*] Fixed Summon Troll Lord not consuming Super Charge
[*] Fixed crafting item amount in inventory not updating after being used.
[*] Fix for talents not being applied for connected clients.
[*] Fixed Sendatu's Crown not applying Bonus Damage as intended.
[*] Fixed a bug with Act 2 Boss' melee range. 
[*] Fixed items not being removed when selling.
[*] Fixed Whirlwind not dealing damage to enemies.
[*] Fixed mod slot visuals not updating after using Endeavor on an item in your inventory.
[*] Fixed equipment comparison tooltips not updating after equipping a new item.
[*] Fixed Ice Storm projectiles not making a sound on impact.
[*] Fixed Crescendo'd items still being able to be Course Corrected.
[*] Fixed weird portal VFX.
[*] Fixed doors in the Town dungeon not opening for all players.
[*] Fixed a bug where exiting Spam mode would leave items green/red.
[*] Fixed Blizzard interefering with aiming some abilities through it.
[*] Fixed Blizzard dealing more damage than intended for clients in multiplayer.
[*] Fixed sometimes spawning in the dungeon underneath Town.
[*] Fixed Crimson Rush being able to interrupt itself.
[*] Fixed Shield Slam not dealing damage if it interrupted another of your abilities.
[*] Fixed Blizzard not despawning on clients.
[*] Fixed the Legendary Loadout achievement.
[*] Fixed Consecration, Rain of Arrows, Sendatu's Crown, and Flame Dash trails not dealing damage or detecting units.
[*] Potential fix for crazy footstep noises.
[*] Potential fix for Firefly enemies trying to get in your face.
[*] Inventory bug hotfix
[*] Various fixes for Whirlwind and channeling
[*] Uncapping FPS is now functional.
[*] Fixed skill tooltips not updating after changing equipment
[*] Fixed Death Aura SFX
[*] Fixed MTX getting weird
[*] Fixed an exploit where enemies could be killed instantly.
[*] Fixed the Alchemist buff becoming hidden.
[*] Potential fix for quest bugs in multiplayer
[*] Potential fix for Summoner Knight continuing to summon while out of combat
[*] Fix for Legendaries not working in multiplayer
[*] Fix for abilities becoming unusable in multiplayer
[*] Fixed Bladecrest not dealing damage when cast by clients.
[*] Fixed a bug where Anti-Magic shield was increasing the damage of blocked projectiles instead of decreasing it.
[*] Fixed a bug where MTX could appear on your character at the main menu even when there was no item equipped in that slot.
[*] Potential fix for weird taunt behavior
[*] Fixed a bug with trade
[*] Fix for characters breaking apart during Leap Smash and meditation.
[*] Fixed a bug with skill keys after equipping a shield.
[*] Fixed a bug where heavy armor MTX were not applying correctly when wearing caster robes.
[*] Fixed lags in AI moving to a new target or location
[/list]

[h2]CHANGED[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced the volume of Meteor projectiles
[*] Barbarous Stomp renamed Barbaric Stomp
[*] Reduced the number of particle effects on aura buffs
[*] Made some changes to Anti-Aliasing
[*] Leaderboards reset
[*] Can no longer receive new trade requests while a trade request or trade window are open
[/list]

notes.title: 2 Day Patch Notes Compilation, Part 2
notes.content:
[h1]NEW[/h1]
[h2]Infinite Arena Loot Overhaul[/h2]
[h3]Enhanced Equipment Rewards[/h3]
[list]
[*] In Commander difficulty, the minimum gear reward for completing a wave is a +1 item.
[*] The minimum gear reward for completing each boss wave is a +2 item.
[*] +1% chance per wave completed for enhanced gear drops to gain an additional level (up to +3).
[*] Drop Chance Enhancement: Loot drop chances increase for every wave completed. Wave 30 now has the same likelihood of spawning a legendary as killing Act 2's boss.
[*] Enhancement bonuses also apply to legendary drops.
[*] All gear drops at each player's level, so power leveling other players here is viable.
[*] All loot chances and enhancement bonuses are affected by Magic Find.
[/list]

Dual-wielding shields has been added. While dual wielding, you can perform a basic attack with the shield in your primary hand which deals 7-10 base damage per level of the shield. Shields cannot be used as weapons unless you are dual-wielding them. There's some bugs with shield placement on the main hand for the moment, should be fixed soon. Shield attacks are using the 1H melee attack animation until I find something better.

New characters now start with a Level 1 Focus with the Firebolt ability in their offhand.

New Skill: Blink Arrow - Fire an arrow that teleports you up to 2000 units. Passes through enemies. Mana Cost: 100, Cooldown: 12 seconds

[h1]BALANCE[/h1]
[list]
[*] Bow Buffs: Average damage for a level 30 bow increased from ~250 to ~325. Increased average bow attack speed from 0.6 to 0.7. Existing bows are unaffected.
[*] Reduced default movement speed by 4%. (Kiting is fairly easy to do without investment in movement speed. Please provide feedback on how this feels!)
[*] Dodge rolling is no longer possible while airborne.
[/list]

[h1]MINIONS[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved enemy AI target acquisition.
[*] Reduced the time minions wait to start following you after combat.
[*] Increased the distance at which Firefly summons follow you.
[/list]

[h1]MODS[/h1]
[list]
[*] Cooldown Reduction mod scaling reduced to equal about 15% per mod at level 30, down from about 20%
[/list]

[h1]SKILLS[/h1]
[list]
[*] Barbarous Stomp - Increased mana cost from 100 to 125. Increased Cooldown from 8 to 9 seconds.
[*] Rooting Arrow - Cooldown reduced from 16 to 14 seconds. Root duration increased from 3 to 3.5 seconds.
[*] Sinister Flare - Will now attach to surfaces in addition to enemies. (This was a REALLY punishing skill to miss. This should help add some gameplay options and make the skill more forgivable.)
[/list]
The following Super abilities have had their weapon requirements removed:
[list]
[*] Strength of Zabaoth
[*] Summon Troll Lord
[*] Kirkira's Resolve
[/list]

[h1]TALENTS[/h1]
[list]
[*] Orias: Kinetic Absorption has been replaced with Shield Boss - Damage with shield attacks increased by 25%.
[*] Heightened Spell and Greater Heightened Spell now only increase the mana cost of damaging abilities.
[*] Reduced the stamina cost increase on dodge rolling incurred by Backstep Volley from 20 to 10 and added this information to the talent's tooltip where it was missing.
[/list]

[h1]IMPROVED[/h1]
[list]
[*] Dying Wish can now be used on Crescendo'd items. This was an oversight.
[*] Improved the tutorial.
[*] Improved inventory performance.
[*] You can now push multiple minions out of your way at once.
[*] Mana cost and cooldown on tooltips is now updated to reflect the actual cost of the spell after changes from your stats and talents.
[*] Spider movement has been improved.
[*] Strike skills now use proper 1H and 2H animations.
[*] Corrected the description on blink spells to state that you will teleport in the direction you are moving.
[*] Significantly improved AI pathfinding and issues with getting stuck on geometry.
[*] Improved Rampage boss leap AI.
[*] Improved summon AI and tracking during attacks.
[/list]

[h1]FIXED[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed legendary items duplicating when buying them back from the shop.
[*] Fixed a bug where new arena waves could start before the final wave completed.
[*] Fixed an item duplication bug.
[*] Fixed a bug where charged up spells would not fire if charged before the start of combat.
[*] Fixed Shield MTX not working. Shield MTX can now be applied to all 1H weapons in addition to shields.
[*] Fixed active Spell Effects not being removed on death.
[*] Fixed Bloodthief healing for more than intended in multiplayer.
[*] Fixed the Find Game menu.

notes.title: 2 Day Patch Notes Compilation
notes.content:
[h2]NEW[/h2]
Enhanced items (+1 and up) now have a global drop chance in Captain and Commander difficulties. New legendary items can now roll as enhanced.

Dyes can now be used on Crescendo'd items.

A new door has appeared in Avatar's Reach.

Dropped legendaries now have beams of light!

Added a Close button to the chat window.

Chat window now stays visible while shop is open.

[h2]BALANCE[/h2]
[h3]SKILLS[/h3]
Savage Strike animation speed increased by 50%.

Dragonfire range increased. Mana cost now increases over time.

Liberating Shout duration decreased from 6 to 3 seconds, Cooldown increased from 12 to 15 seconds, Movement Speed bonus reduced from 50% to 40%.

[h3]ITEMS[/h3]
REWORK: The Black Vortex
-Now named Firestorm
-New model (pic attached)
-New Legendary effect: Gain Avatar of Fire while channeling Whirlwind.
-Existing "The Black Vortex" items will be updated to the new version.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/d324c4b7d81fe496b03145ec037a7e9461054c38.png[/img]

The Ordained no longer grants Avatar of Fire while standing in your Consecration.

Meteor Forge - Increased the damage of Meteor Forge's special effect from 30% weapon damage to 50% weapon damage. Existing weapons will be updated to the new values.

[h3]STATS[/h3]
2-Handed weapons will now always roll Implicit and Crescendo mods at double strength, instead of just when they drop. This includes Twist of Fate rolls.

Magic Find's "per level" scaling reduced from 5% to 3%.
Reduced Sendatu's Magic Find passive from 5% per point to 3% per point.

[h3]ENEMIES[/h3]
Enemy health increased in multiplayer. Bosses unaffected.

[h2]IMPROVED[/h2]
Loot chests now have a chance to spawn Legendary items.

Improved Town performance - This probably won't be "fixed" for everyone yet, but it will definitely be better.

Changed the wording of talents which allow you to ignore weapon type requirements to be more clear.

[h2]CHANGED[/h2]
Absolution can no longer be used outside of Town.

[h2]FIXED[/h2]
Fixed the semicolon key (;) crashing the entire game 100% of the time. Nice.

Fixed mod values not updating to new patch values. Now you can see your characters get nerfed in real time.

Fixed a bug where Whirlwind could animate only the top half of your body.

Fixed some teleport bugs and exploits in Arena maps.

Fixed some Steam achievements not working.

Fixed Leap Smash breaking characters in half during the leap.

Fixed a bug where meditating as a client could lock you out of your skills.

Fixed a bug where gold collected by clients would not be removed from the world.

Fixed a bug with the shop.

Fixed a bug where massive wolfpacks were possible. RIP wolfbois.

Fixed a bug where the Master volume slider was not functioning.

Fixed Firefly projectiles lingering in place.

Fixed Backspace opening a debugger.

Fixed a bug where the radial menu couldn't be used more than once.

Fixed a bug where allies appeared to be running through water.

Fixed items being accidentally added to stash while the stash was closed.

Fixed melee skill animations slowing down each time you used them.

Fixed a bug where legendary item effects could linger after unequipping the item.

Previously broken Legendary items should now be fixed.

Potential fix for difficulty icon not showing on clients

Potential fix for clients getting locked out of their skills - Let me know if this is still happening!

Potential fix for health bar showing that you still have health after dying.

Potential fix for screen losing color saturation permanently after being resurrected.

notes.title: Legendary Update
notes.content:
New Legendaries, New Crafting Item, Rain of Arrows Skill, COD-style Danger Effects, More Enemy Health in Commander Difficulty, Important Fixes

NEW
[list]
[*] New Legendary Items: 9 new Legendary weapons have been added to the global loot pool. Hunt them down wherever you like.
[*] New Crafting Item: Last Word - Destroys an item and preserves its skill in a Dying Wish, which can apply the skill to another item. Cannot be used to preserve Legendary skills. Only available from the item shop for 5000g.
[*] New Bow Skill: Rain of Arrows - Fire a marking arrow that calls down a hail of arrows where it impacts, dealing 200% weapon damage per second to all enemies in the area. Lasts for 2 seconds.
[*] A new legendary has been added to Act 2's final boss with an extremely low drop rate.
[*] COD-style red screen border when low on health, and the world loses its color when you die
[/list]

BALANCE
[list]
[*] Alcaeus: Bloodfury - Reduced the Attack Speed bonus per stack from 5% to 3%
[*] Enemy health in Commander difficulty increased by ~20%
[*] "Health Multiplier Per Player" boss change from last patch reverted to normal values.
[*] Increased XP value of Act 2 boss.
[*] Shockwave no longer applies Slow.
[/list]

IMPROVED
[list]
[*] Due to PETA complaints, minions are now gently nudged out of your way instead of being punted.
[*] Updated Firebolt VFX.
[*] Updated potion charge pickup model.
[/list]

FIXED
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where aura effects were permanently applied.
[*] Fixed a visual bug where Death Aura's visible radius was not updated by Sendatu: Broad Influnce.
[*] Fixed a bug where legendary effects would sometimes not activate.
[*] Fixed a bug where Death Aura could be used while wearing a helmet.
[*] Fixed a bug where your summons' kills would not count as yours for stats.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could not use Course Corrections on 2H melee weapons if they were in your inventory.
[*] Fixed the placement of some bows.
[*] Fixed more bugs with the trade interface.
[*] Turned off debugging lines for Explosive Arrow.
[*] Renamed the "Spell Damage" passive to "Staff and Focus Damage" for better clarity.
[/list]

notes.title: Resurrection, Immortality, and Death... of Crit.
notes.content:
BALANCE
Crit Chance and Crit Damage from equipment mods has been reduced by 50% :rip: . Crit Chance and Crit Damage from passive talents unaffected.

Supercrit multiplier reduced from 50% to 25%. 
(Crit builds have been obscenely strong for a while. This should keep the game from becoming trivial.) 
-Thanks @akamemura!

Increased the "Health Multiplier Per Player" of bosses by 50%. More players = even tankier bosses than before. Solo play unaffected.

FIXED
Fixed a bug where being resurrected could cause you to become immortal
-Thanks @akamemura, @RoganJosh, and @McOp
Fixed a bug with leaderboards
